title: $λ_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop $λ_0$, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. $λ_0$ achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces HumanVerse, a 500-hour egocentric human loco-manipulation dataset, and a human-to-humanoid pipeline to train λ0, a humanoid foundation model that achieves high success on whole-body loco-manipulation tasks with zero-shot transfer to a real robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了包含500小时第一人称人类移动操控数据的HumanVerse数据集，以及人类到人形机器人的转换流程，训练出λ0人形机器人基础模型，在零样本迁移到真实机器人时实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 类人机器人全身操控需要与物理世界进行协调的全身交互，然而大规模采集机器人演示数据成本高昂。人类演示提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但现有的以自我为中心的类人监督往往忽略 locomotion 和姿态信息，同时实体差异和控制器动力学问题阻碍了末端执行器的精确执行。我们引入了 HumanVerse，一个 500 小时的开放世界人类全身操控数据集，将自我中心视频与同步的身体和手部运动配对。我们的人到类人机器人的流程对齐了相机视角和手臂外观，并离线优化运动参考和控制器输入，以减少末端执行器误差，同时保持全身协调性。我们通过在代表性的全身操控和长距离 locomotion 操控任务上对 Unitree G1 进行零样本迁移验证了该流程，无需目标任务的机器人演示。基于此流程，我们开发了 $λ_0$，一个用于全身 locomotion 操控的类人机器人基础模型，利用与机器人对齐的人类演示为中期训练提供监督。增加全身人类数据持续改进下游任务进展。$λ_0$ 在 SIMPLE 上实现了 90.0% 的成功率，在真实世界 loco-manipulation 任务上实现了 62.5% 的成功率。我们期望这项研究能引导可扩展的全身人类数据收集，以构建能够与物理世界进行更丰富交互的类人机器人基础模型。主页：https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/

title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
summary: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.
tldr: SEAR is a framework and benchmark to evaluate whether frontier language-model agents truly improve robots by writing control code, acting live, or fine-tuning VLA models, across simulated and real tasks. It finds that learning curves depend on task difficulty and budget, that code transfers better than task-specific solutions, and that models differ in effective evolution strategies.
tldr_zh: SEAR 是一个框架和基准测试，用于评估前沿语言模型代理是否真正通过编写控制代码、实时行动或微调 VLA 模型来改进机器人，涵盖模拟和真实任务。研究发现学习曲线取决于任务难度和预算，代码比任务特定解决方案更能迁移，且不同模型的有效进化策略不同。
summary_zh: 前沿语言模型智能体现已能够自主改进机器人：它们编写控制代码、进行测试，并将有效的部分保留为技能与记忆，以供后续任务使用。我们提出SEAR（自我进化智能体机器人学），一个围绕两个问题构建的框架与基准。智能体是否真正在学习，抑或仅仅是在增加尝试次数？其学到的内容是否仍能适用于新任务、新模拟器以及真实机器人？该框架以三种模式运行智能体：编写代码作为策略（代码即策略）、在控制回路中实时执行（智能体即策略）、或作为研究者微调视觉-语言-动作模型（自动研究）。基准测试增设了控制项，以区分保留经验与重复尝试、熟悉任务、特权模拟器状态、更大预算及偶然因素。在七个前沿语言模型、330项模拟任务与五项物理任务、以及超过四年的智能体运行时长中，我们突出三项发现。首先，机器人智能体的学习曲线既取决于总体时间预算，也取决于任务难度相对于模型能力的高低。较难的任务使更长时间的会话更具价值；而在较易任务上，重复短时尝试效果相当。其次，控制代码与共享例程可跨任务与模拟器迁移，而特定于任务的解决方案则不可迁移。在真实机器人上，我们观察到智能体设计的练习场景与新的人类设计场景之间存在性能差距。第三，不同模型以不同方式实现更有效的进化。有些在执行实时操作时表现最佳，另一些则更擅长先编写代码。此外，纯文本模型与同等规模的多模态模型表现相当：感知有助于错误评估，但智能体推理与工具使用可能更为关键。我们发布该基准与代码库，以支持未来研究。

title: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
summary: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.
tldr: GreenWAM is a world foundation model for robotics that, via a shared anatomical action space and joint training, serves both as a high-accuracy world model and a competitive policy across multiple robot embodiments, including real humanoid adaptation.
tldr_zh: GreenWAM 是一个机器人世界基础模型，通过共享解剖动作空间和联合训练，既能作为高精度世界模型，也能作为跨多种机器人形态的竞争性策略，并成功适配到真实人形机器人。
summary_zh: 机器人需要具备两种核心能力：一是构建世界模型，以预测其行为如何改变场景；二是制定策略，以选择具体行动。传统上，模型通常仅为其中一种角色而构建和评估，且每台机器人均以其自有格式记录动作。我们探讨一个关键问题：机器人的世界模型能否在不同本体之间同时服务于这两种角色，以及实现这一目标所需的条件。为此，我们提出GreenWAM——一个面向机器人的世界基础模型，并阐述了生成该模型的方法：(1) 一个共享的解剖学动作空间，以统一的关节坐标描述从双臂机器人到灵巧人形机器人的20个机器人家族；(2) 在这些家族上以视觉模式、动作条件模式和世界动作模式进行联合训练；(3) 将动作专家从生成器中分离出来的策略。作为世界模型，GreenWAM在WorldArena 1.0基准上达到了顶尖的轨迹、深度和三维精度，在所比较的所有世界动作模型和视频生成器中均表现优异。作为策略，它在RoboTwin 2.0排行榜上位居前列，在零样本LIBERO-plus任务中取得了所比较方法中最高的成功率，并在CALVIN和LIBERO基准上与专用视觉-语言-动作策略和世界动作策略相比具有竞争力。我们进一步将GreenWAM适配到真实人形机器人上，其成功率高于从π₀.₅和Cosmos 3 Edge适配的策略，并将其蒸馏为单步策略以实现实时控制。受控实验得出了三项发现：机器人特化能够同时改进世界预测和控制；在适配开始时分离动作专家有助于性能提升；在策略适配过程中保留世界模型模式可保持对场景变化的鲁棒性。

title: ForkCast: Predictive Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Policies via Counterfactual Futures
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform manipulation tasks using camera images and language instructions, but object slip or visual occlusion can disrupt execution. Recovery is typically learned during policy training or delegated to a monitor that triggers a scripted repair after detecting a failure. We introduce ForkCast, a predictive recovery framework that compares counterfactual futures to determine whether and how to intervene in a frozen VLA policy. At each decision point, ForkCast evaluates three candidates: executing the policy's nominal action chunk (Commit), adjusting the camera viewpoint (Reobserve), and replanning the arm trajectory (Replan). A candidate-conditioned world model forecasts the latent outcome of each candidate at a common future horizon, and a shared task-progress head scores the predicted outcomes. By evaluating the policy's own continuation alongside the repair candidates, a single comparison based on task progress determines both whether and how to intervene, without a failure detector, an intervention threshold, or updates to the VLA backbone. On five simulated RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with injected occlusion and object slip, ForkCast increases pooled success from 13.3% for the frozen $π_{0.5}$ policy to 30.0% and transfers to two additional VLA backbones without updating ForkCast. After adaptation on real-robot candidate rollouts, ForkCast also improves success over the base policy under both clean and visibility-limited conditions. Code will be released to benefit the research community.
tldr: ForkCast introduces a predictive recovery framework for frozen VLA policies, using a candidate-conditioned world model to compare counterfactual futures (Commit, Reobserve, Replan) and decide when and how to intervene, improving success under object slip and occlusion in simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: ForkCast 提出了一种针对冻结 VLA 策略的预测性恢复框架，通过候选条件世界模型比较反事实未来（Commit、Reobserve、Replan）来决定是否及如何干预，在模拟和真实机器人任务中的物体滑动和遮挡情况下提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略利用相机图像和语言指令执行操作任务，但物体滑动或视觉遮挡可能中断执行过程。恢复过程通常在策略训练期间学习，或委托给一个监控器，在检测到故障后触发脚本化修复。我们提出ForkCast，一种预测性恢复框架，通过比较反事实未来来决定是否以及如何对冻结的VLA策略进行干预。在每个决策点，ForkCast评估三个候选方案：执行策略的名义动作块（Commit）、调整相机视角（Reobserve）以及重新规划机械臂轨迹（Replan）。候选条件世界模型在共同的未来时间范围内预测每个候选方案的潜在结果，共享的任务进展评分头对预测结果进行打分。通过将策略自身的延续与修复候选方案一同评估，基于任务进展的单一比较即可同时决定是否干预以及如何干预，无需故障检测器、干预阈值或对VLA骨干网络的更新。在五个注入遮挡和物体滑动的模拟RoboTwin 2.0任务中，ForkCast将冻结的π₀.₅策略的池化成功率从13.3%提升至30.0%，并在不更新ForkCast的情况下迁移至另外两个VLA骨干网络。在真实机器人候选轨迹上完成适配后，ForkCast在清洁条件和视线受限条件下均能提高基础策略的成功率。代码将公开发布，以惠及研究社区。

title: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies excel at generalist robotic manipulation but generate actions without explicitly modeling their environmental consequences. World action models (WAMs) incorporate future prediction, yet most rely on costly video generation, while latent alternatives either use predicted futures only as auxiliary targets or infer latent actions from suboptimal visual transitions through costly large-scale video pretraining. We introduce WAVE-0 (World-model-Augmented VLA Execution), a framework that bridges VLAs and WAMs through a lightweight latent world model. By connecting the semantic understanding of pretrained VLAs with explicit future prediction, WAVE-0 allows anticipated action consequences to directly guide action generation. Built on a pretrained VLA, its 257M world model translates VLM-generated latent action plans into predicted future representations that condition the action expert, unifying latent planning, future prediction, and action generation. The world model is trained directly on ground-truth robot actions with a counterfactual ranking objective, requiring neither pixel reconstruction nor large-scale video pretraining. WAVE-0 achieves success rates of 91.47% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 98.7% on LIBERO, along with 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively. On real-world tasks, it improves the success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 38.3% to 73.3%. These results demonstrate strong manipulation performance and generalization across diverse distribution shifts.
tldr: WAVE-0 introduces a lightweight latent world model that augments pretrained VLA policies with future prediction, improving manipulation success and generalization across simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: WAVE-0 提出了一种轻量级潜在世界模型，为预训练的 VLA 策略增添未来预测能力，在仿真和真实任务中提升了操作成功率和泛化性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略在通用机器人操作中表现优异，但其生成动作时并未显式建模动作对环境造成的影响。世界行动模型（WAMs）引入了未来预测机制，然而大多数此类方法依赖成本高昂的视频生成，而潜在替代方案要么仅将预测的未来作为辅助目标使用，要么通过代价高昂的大规模视频预训练，从次优的视觉转换中推断潜在动作。我们提出WAVE-0（世界模型增强的VLA执行），一个通过轻量级潜在世界模型连接VLA与WAM的框架。通过将预训练VLA的语义理解与显式未来预测相结合，WAVE-0使预期的动作后果能够直接引导动作生成。该框架基于预训练VLA构建，其2.57亿参数的世界模型将VLM生成的潜在动作计划转换为预测的未来表征，用以条件化动作专家，从而统一潜在规划、未来预测和动作生成。世界模型直接基于真实机器人动作训练，采用反事实排序目标，既不需要像素重建，也不依赖大规模视频预训练。WAVE-0在RoboTwin 2.0上达到91.47%的成功率，在LIBERO上达到98.7%，在LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro和LIBERO-Para上分别达到88.0%、61.4%和75.0%。在真实世界任务中，它将π₀.₅的成功率从38.3%提升至73.3%。上述结果展示了其在不同分布偏移下强大的操作性能和泛化能力。

title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
summary: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.
tldr: Thinker-WM proposes a unified multimodal world model that jointly models RGB, depth, and robot action through shared representations, supporting multiple embodied AI functions and demonstrating strong performance on world-model benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Thinker-WM提出一种统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享表示联合建模RGB、深度和机器人动作，支持多种具身AI功能，并在世界模型基准上取得领先性能。
summary_zh: 世界模型已成为具身人工智能的一种有前景的范式，然而现有系统在其建模的模态和所支持的功能上往往仍然零散割裂。具体而言，视觉动态、几何结构和可执行动作通常通过分离的接口或下游模块进行耦合，而非在共享的动态模型中被联合表示和演化。在本工作中，我们提出了Thinker-WM，一种统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的中间统一动态变换器（Unified Dynamics Transformer）以及各模态专属的编码器和解码器，联合建模并生成RGB图像、度量深度和机器人动作。该模型在表示层面实现多模态统一：外观、几何和动作被转换为共同的动态表示，并由共享参数联合演化，同时保持其各自的输出结构。相同的参数化支持多种功能，包括联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成以及逆向动力学。为检验共享表示是否捕获了与动作相关的信息，我们引入了一种轻量级运动探针，实验表明冻结的视觉表示中包含可恢复的运动信息。Thinker-WM在异构语料库上进行训练，该语料库包含约2万小时的第一人称视频、1万小时的真实机器人数据和1千小时的仿真数据，其中约4千小时的真实机器人数据带有对齐的深度监督。大量实验表明，该方法在具身世界模型评估中表现出色。Thinker-WM在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad和WorldArena上均排名第一，同时，受控研究进一步证明了在共享表示中动作条件、几何交互和多功能训练的益处。

title: DR-VLA: Learning Human-Like Quadruped Navigation from Egocentric Web Videos via Domain-Invariant Scene Representations
summary: Quadruped robots performing outdoor deliveries must interpret complex scenes, anticipate changes, and navigate in socially compliant ways. Robot demonstrations are costly to collect at the scale needed for generalization. Egocentric web videos offer abundant human navigation experience, but differences in viewpoint and motion make this experience difficult to transfer to robots. We introduce DR-VLA, a Mixture-of-Transformers framework that transfers human navigation experience through a domain-invariant scene representation (DISR). The framework combines vision-language understanding and latent world modeling with a flow-matching action expert. We introduce EgoLynx, comprising 10,000 hours of curated egocentric web video (EgoLynx-Web) and 2,000 clips of teleoperated robot navigation collected during real-world deliveries (EgoLynx-Robot). We pretrain the understanding and world experts on EgoLynx-Web without action labels, then adapt the model to robot observations and train the action expert on EgoLynx-Robot to predict executable trajectories. We also propose the Quadruped Navigation Score (QNS), a pseudo-closed-loop metric combining safety, instruction compliance, comfort, and progress. On the held-out EgoLynx-Robot test split, DR-VLA improves QNS by approximately 5% and reduces open-loop final heading error (FHE) by 14.6%, each relative to the best competing result for that metric. Ablations show that web-video pretraining improves generalization and that the model's key components contribute to performance. As a future-prediction target, DISR outperforms five generic visual representations and yields performance close to task-specific 3D perception without dedicated geometric labels or point clouds for target construction. Trained separately on NAVSIM v1 without web pretraining, DR-VLA achieves 92.1 PDMS, suggesting that the framework also applies to autonomous driving.
tldr: DR-VLA is a Mixture-of-Transformers framework that transfers human navigation experience from egocentric web videos to quadruped robots via a domain-invariant scene representation, improving navigation performance and showing applicability to autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: DR-VLA 是一种混合Transformer框架，通过域不变场景表示将人类导航经验从自我中心网络视频迁移到四足机器人，提升了导航性能，并展示了在自动驾驶领域的适用性。
summary_zh: 四足机器人在执行户外配送任务时，必须理解复杂场景、预判环境变化，并以符合社会规范的方式进行导航。为获得泛化能力所需规模的数据，机器人演示样本的采集成本高昂。第一人称网络视频提供了大量人类导航经验，但视角和运动方式的差异使得这些经验难以迁移至机器人。我们提出DR-VLA，一种基于域不变场景表示（DISR）的Transformer混合框架，用于将人类导航经验迁移至机器人。该框架将视觉-语言理解与潜在世界建模相结合，并配备基于流匹配的动作专家。我们构建了EgoLynx数据集，包含10,000小时精选的第一人称网络视频（EgoLynx-Web）以及2,000段在真实配送场景中采集的遥操作机器人导航片段（EgoLynx-Robot）。我们在无动作标签的EgoLynx-Web上预训练理解专家和世界模型专家，随后将模型适配至机器人观测，并在EgoLynx-Robot上训练动作专家以预测可执行的轨迹。我们还提出了四足导航评分（QNS），一种融合安全性、指令遵循度、舒适性和行进进展的伪闭环评估指标。在留出的EgoLynx-Robot测试集上，DR-VLA将QNS提升了约5%，并将开环最终航向误差（FHE）降低了14.6%，两项指标均优于各自最优的对比方法。消融实验表明，网络视频预训练提升了泛化能力，且模型各关键组件均对性能有所贡献。作为一种未来预测目标，DISR优于五种通用视觉表示，并且在无需专用几何标签或点云构建目标的情况下，其性能接近任务特定的三维感知方法。在NAVSIM v1上单独训练（不进行网络视频预训练）时，DR-VLA达到了92.1的PDMS分数，表明该框架同样适用于自动驾驶领域。

title: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects and destinations during execution. It maintains a shared context containing the active subtask, spatial grounding, and recent observations. An action policy uses this context to generate actions, while a separately trained progress evaluator estimates when to advance to the next subtask. To evaluate whether robots trained on atomic instructions and short trajectories can execute longer subtask sequences, we introduce a benchmark named RMBench-Compose. Orchestra achieves a mean success rate of $68.22\%$ across nine RMBench tasks, outperforming Mem-0 by $26.22$ percentage points. On RMBench-Compose, it achieves an Average Success Length (ASL) of $7.35$ subtasks, $2.46$ times that of HarnessVLA. Across four real-world multi-step tasks, it improves mean ASL by $25.0\%$ over Orchestra using the base $π_{0.5}$ policy. These results show that Orchestra helps robots carry out longer sequences of subtasks while preserving the requested subtask order and acting on the specified objects. Our code and project page are available at https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra.
tldr: Orchestra is an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation to help robots follow long-horizon multimodal instructions, achieving significant improvements in subtask completion on a new benchmark and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: Orchestra 是一种智能体系统，它将任务规划与执行管理从动作生成中分离出来，以帮助机器人遵循长期多模态指令，在新基准和真实世界任务中显著提升了子任务完成能力。
summary_zh: 遵循多步指令的机器人在场景变化时，仍需以正确的顺序对正确的对象执行操作。同时，它还必须持续感知任务进度，并判断何时推进到下一步。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Orchestra，一种将任务规划与执行管理从动作生成中分离出来的智能体框架。Orchestra 将完整的多模态指令分解为有序的子任务，跟踪已完成的步骤，并在执行过程中更新相关对象和目标位置的信息。它维护一个共享上下文，其中包含当前活动子任务、空间定位信息以及最近的观测数据。动作策略利用该上下文生成动作，而一个单独训练的进度评估器则用于估计何时应推进到下一子任务。为了评估仅基于原子指令和短轨迹训练的机器人能否执行更长的子任务序列，我们引入了一个名为 RMBench-Compose 的基准。Orchestra 在九项 RMBench 任务上实现了 $68.22\%$ 的平均成功率，比 Mem-0 高出 $26.22$ 个百分点。在 RMBench-Compose 上，它达到了 $7.35$ 个子任务的平均成功长度（ASL），是 HarnessVLA 的 $2.46$ 倍。在四项真实世界的多步任务中，与使用基础 $π_{0.5}$ 策略的 Orchestra 相比，平均 ASL 提升了 $25.0\%$。这些结果表明，Orchestra 能帮助机器人执行更长的子任务序列，同时保持所要求的子任务顺序，并对指定对象进行操作。我们的代码和项目页面可在 https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra 获取。

title: DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. To improve trajectory generation beyond imitation learning, we apply Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to refine the Action Expert. Extensive experiments show that DriveWLA achieves superior performance in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation. DriveWLA achieves 92.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, demonstrating strong performance among VLM-based and world-model-based planners. Without specific fine-tuning, DriveWLA further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to HUGSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive. These results validate the effectiveness of our unified World-Language-Action modeling, establishing DriveWLA as a generalizable framework for autonomous driving.
tldr: DriveWLA is a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation for autonomous driving, achieving superior performance in open-loop and closed-loop evaluations.
tldr_zh: DriveWLA是一个基于Transformer混合架构的统一世界-语言-动作模型，联合建模语义理解、未来场景动态和轨迹生成，在开环和闭环评估中均实现了优越性能。

title: Physics-Aware Object-Centric SE(3) Forecasting for Real-Time Proactive Dynamic Grasping
summary: Proactive dynamic grasping requires robots to predict the future state at which physical contact will occur, rather than reacting to the currently observed object pose. But what future must the robot predict, and at what level of abstraction? We argue that contact-relevant rigid-body state in SE(3) is a compact task-sufficient abstraction for this problem: it directly determines where and when the robot should establish contact, without requiring visually complete future scenes. This insight leads to a lightweight object-centric forecast-then-select framework that predicts future rigid-body trajectories from short pose histories and uses a reachability-aware interception selector to choose feasible contact states under kinematic and timing constraints. Trained with randomized physics simulation over primitive shapes, the forecaster transfers to real objects once their metric geometry and SE(3) state histories are recovered. Experiments across simulation and real-world dynamic grasping tasks show that our framework improves the average success rate from \(24.5\%\) to \(62.0\%\) in simulation, and from \(15.3\%\) to \(67.3\%\) in real-world catching, conveyor, and turntable interception. The SE(3) forecaster runs in \(15\,\mathrm{ms}\), orders of magnitude faster than dense visual future prediction, enabling real-time contact decision making. Our results suggest that effective proactive grasping does not require imagining the entire future scene. Instead, predicting the compact physical future that determines contact provides an effective and practical abstraction for real-time dynamic grasping.
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight object-centric SE(3) forecasting framework for proactive dynamic grasping, which predicts future rigid-body trajectories and selects reachable contact states, achieving significant success-rate improvements in both simulation and real-world tasks while running in milliseconds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级的以物体为中心的SE(3)预测框架，用于主动动态抓取，通过预测未来刚体轨迹并选择可达接触状态，在仿真和真实任务中显著提升成功率，且运行时间仅为毫秒级。

title: OccWAM: Occupancy World-Action Models with Joint Scene-to-Ego Flow Matching
summary: Occupancy world models provide a structured, metric representation of future driving scenes, making them a promising basis for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing occupancy-aware planners typically couple occupancy prediction and action generation through either hierarchical coupling or parallel multi-task learning. Hierarchical methods use occupancy either as a fully predicted future preceding action generation or as an action-conditioned rollout for trajectory evaluation, whereas parallel multi-task methods predict occupancy alongside planning through a separate branch or auxiliary objective. These interfaces retain either an explicit generation order or a role asymmetry, limiting reciprocal interaction between world prediction and action generation during trajectory formation. We propose OccWAM, an occupancy-native world-action model that jointly generates dense future occupancy and continuous ego trajectories via flow matching conditioned on scene representations. Building on this joint formulation, we introduce scene-to-ego world-action flow matching, a two-stage formulation. The first stage predicts scene-centric occupancy together with an absolute ego trajectory, providing a stable representation of future scene evolution. The same predicted world is then re-indexed into the future ego frames induced by the initial trajectory, where ego motion is represented through adjacent pose increments and a second joint flow refines ego-centric occupancy and motion for action-aligned planning. Unlike video-based world-action models, OccWAM preserves explicit semantic geometry for direct planning reasoning without pixel synthesis. Extensive experiments on Bench2Drive and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in closed-loop driving, open-loop planning, and future occupancy prediction.
tldr: OccWAM introduces an occupancy-native world-action model that jointly generates future occupancy and ego trajectories via a two-stage scene-to-ego flow matching framework, achieving state-of-the-art results on closed-loop driving and planning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: OccWAM 提出了一种以占据图为原生的世界-动作模型，通过两阶段场景到自我流匹配联合生成未来占据图和自我轨迹，在闭环驾驶和规划基准上达到了最先进性能。

title: Training Generalist Navigation Policies via Action Self-Distillation
summary: Language provides a natural interface for humans to specify and reason about goals, but training language-conditioned robotic policies and reasoning typically requires expensive manual annotations. We propose Action Self-Distillation (ASD), a method for learning language-conditioned reasoning for robotic navigation without human-annotated language or reasoning labels. ASD uses an open-source VLM, which contains broad world knowledge and reasoning capabilities, as both a teacher network and a student policy. During training, the self-teacher receives privileged trajectory feedback and infers the underlying navigation goal together with goal-oriented reasoning. The student is then trained to condition on the inferred navigation goal, predict future ego-frame trajectory, and provide a description of the scene semantics, plan, and reasoning, from onboard observations alone. Across 13 challenging indoor and outdoor real-world navigation tasks, our method improves success rate over the strongest baseline by $30\%$ in indoor settings, $30\%$ on multi-stage tasks, and achieves $95\%$ success rate on outdoor tasks, validating that privileged trajectory feedback can enable self-distillation for scalable generalist navigation policies without human annotations.
tldr: This paper introduces Action Self-Distillation (ASD), a method to train language-conditioned navigation policies for real robots without human-annotated labels, using a VLM as both teacher and student to distil goals and reasoning from privileged trajectory feedback, achieving significant success-rate improvements on 13 indoor and outdoor navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出动作自蒸馏（ASD）方法，利用开源VLM同时作为教师和学生网络，在无需人工标注的情况下，从特权轨迹反馈中蒸馏导航目标与推理，训练语言条件下的真实机器人导航策略，在13项室内外任务中显著提升成功率。
summary_zh: 语言为人类提供了一种自然的接口，用以指定和推理目标，但训练基于语言条件的机器人策略与推理通常需要昂贵的人工标注。我们提出动作自蒸馏方法（Action Self-Distillation, ASD），这是一种无需人工标注的语言或推理标签，即可学习机器人导航中语言条件推理的方法。ASD采用一个开源视觉语言模型（VLM），该模型蕴含广泛的世界知识与推理能力，同时作为教师网络和学生策略。在训练过程中，自教师模型接收特权轨迹反馈，并推断底层导航目标以及面向目标的推理过程。随后，学生模型被训练为仅依据车载观测，以推断出的导航目标为条件，预测未来的自我中心帧轨迹，并提供场景语义、规划及推理的描述。在13项具有挑战性的室内外真实世界导航任务中，我们的方法在室内场景下将成功率相较于最强基线提升了30%，在多阶段任务中提升了30%，并在室外任务中达到了95%的成功率，验证了特权轨迹反馈能够在不依赖人工标注的情况下实现可扩展的通用导航策略的自蒸馏。

title: TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency
summary: Textual reasoning before acting has improved vision-language-action (VLA) models, but at the cost of latency: every action conditioned on the reasoning text must wait for autoregressive decoding. We show that actions do not need to wait for or condition on the generated reasoning to benefit from it, because the reasoning supervision already improves the backbone representation. We introduce TacitVLA, a reasoning VLA whose action expert never attends to the reasoning it generates for the current call. On long-horizon tasks where the reasoning text also serves as episodic memory, it can generate each entry during action execution rather than before acting. We evaluate it in a controlled study on four benchmarks spanning manipulation and autonomous driving, memory and non-memory tasks: RoboMME, RMBench, LIBERO, and PhysicalAI-AV. On all four, TacitVLA matches the performance of its explicit-reasoning counterpart at up to 3.4x lower latency, and matches the latency of the same architecture trained without reasoning at up to +17.1% success. In absolute terms, it surpasses the best previously published results on the RoboMME Counting suite (82.7% vs. 66.8%) and RMBench (77.5% vs. 56.5%), and reaches 72.9% on LIBERO-Plus and a 52.5% scene score on the public split of the PhysicalAI-AV closed-loop driving challenge. Project page: https://tacitvla.github.io.
tldr: TacitVLA introduces a reasoning vision-language-action model where actions do not attend to the generated reasoning text, eliminating reasoning latency while matching or exceeding the performance of explicit-reasoning VLAs on manipulation and driving benchmarks.
tldr_zh: TacitVLA 提出了一种推理视觉-语言-动作模型，其动作生成不依赖于已生成的推理文本，从而消除推理延迟，同时在操作和驾驶基准上达到或超过显式推理 VLA 的性能。
summary_zh: 在行动之前进行文本推理已经提升了视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型的性能，但代价是延迟增加：每一个以推理文本为条件的行动都必须等待自回归解码完成。我们证明，行动并不需要等待生成推理结果，也不必以该推理为条件才能从中受益，因为推理监督本身已经改善了骨干网络的特征表示。我们提出了TacitVLA，一种推理型VLA模型，其行动专家在本次调用中从不关注其自身生成的推理内容。在推理文本同时充当情景记忆的长时程任务中，它可以在行动执行过程中生成每条推理条目，而非在行动之前生成。我们在四个跨操作和自动驾驶、记忆型和非记忆型任务的基准上进行了受控研究评估：RoboMME、RMBench、LIBERO和PhysicalAI-AV。在全部四个基准上，TacitVLA在性能上与显式推理对应模型持平，同时延迟降低最高达3.4倍；在与不包含推理训练的同一架构相比时，延迟持平，而成功率提升最高达+17.1%。从绝对值来看，它在RoboMME计数套件上超越了此前最佳已发表结果（82.7%对66.8%），在RMBench上同样如此（77.5%对56.5%），并在LIBERO-Plus上达到72.9%，在PhysicalAI-AV闭环驾驶挑战公开分割上取得52.5的场景得分。项目主页：https://tacitvla.github.io。

title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
summary: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
tldr: ChunkAct introduces action chunking to agentic robotics, compiling LLM memory into executable chunks that run autonomously, reducing LLM calls and tokens while improving task success on LIBERO-Pro.
tldr_zh: ChunkAct将动作分块引入智能体机器人技术，将LLM记忆编译为可自主执行的分块，在减少LLM调用和令牌的同时提高了LIBERO-Pro上的任务成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
具身智能机器人技术将大型语言模型（LLM）智能体嵌入机器人控制回路中，在记忆的引导下整合感知、运动及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）工具，从而无需重新训练即可泛化至新任务。这种泛化能力以效率的大幅下降为代价。每个基元操作都需要一轮基于完整交互历史的LLM推理，因此单个回合的成本随基元数量增加而增长。我们发现此类推理在很大程度上是冗余的：一旦子目标被选定，其后续基元操作便遵循记忆预设的例行流程。为此，我们提出ChunkAct，将动作分块引入具身智能机器人技术。在线阶段，单次调用即可启动一串链式基元操作，自主执行，仅在失败时交还控制权。离线阶段，ChunkAct将记忆编译为这些分块，从而在测试时无需记忆即可执行，规划器仅保留用于需要推理的决策。因此，LLM计算量取决于决策次数，而非基元数量。在LIBERO-Pro基准上，ChunkAct将任务成功率较具身智能机器人领域现有最优方法提升5.0个百分点，同时将LLM调用次数减少2.9倍，输入token减少4.4倍，输出token减少2.3倍。

title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
summary: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce \textbf{LoopWAM}, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67\% to 43.33\%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5\% average success on RoboTwin~2.0 and 49.5\% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20\% to 55.56\%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{Project Page}}
tldr: LoopWAM is a closed-loop world-action model that learns from mixed-quality deployment rollouts, using source-dependent noise sampling and quality-weighted supervision to improve generalist robot policies across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating significant success gains through iterative deployment-training rounds.
tldr_zh: LoopWAM 是一种闭环世界-动作模型，从混合质量的部署数据中学习，利用源相关噪声采样和质量加权监督来提升通用机器人策略，在多个基准上通过迭代部署-训练循环显著提高成功率。
summary_zh: 仅靠扩展专家示范数据，无法让通用机器人策略从实际部署中持续改进。真实环境中的轨迹数据既包含成功案例，也包含次优行为和失败案例：单纯模仿所有记录的动作会强化不良行为，而过滤掉失败样本则会丢弃物理交互及其后果的关键证据。我们提出 **LoopWAM**，一种闭环世界-动作模型，能够直接利用这一完整质量谱系的数据进行学习，其训练数据来自自身及其他已部署策略的采样轨迹。源相关的噪声采样统一了行为学习与动作条件世界建模，而质量引导与质量加权监督则在各质量层级上保留完整的视频监督，并调节动作模仿的强度。视频与动作标记在并行去噪过程中相互作用，使学习到的后果信息能够直接指导动作生成。在RoboChallenge Table30-V2基准上，经过三轮部署-训练循环，成功率从23.67\%提升至43.33\%，提升19.7个百分点，最终得分为56.80。LoopWAM在RoboTwin~2.0上达到94.5\%的平均成功率，在RoboCasa365上达到49.5\%的整体成功率，且无需额外的具身预训练，在三个基准上均取得了与对比方法相比的最优整体结果。在具有挑战性的衬衫折叠任务中，经过单任务后训练后的两轮部署驱动改进，成功率从13.20\%提升至55.56\%。这些结果表明，在多任务学习与单任务后训练两种设置下，LoopWAM均能实现基于混合质量经验数据的闭环改进。\href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{项目主页}}

title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
summary: How should demonstration quality be used during vision-language-action (VLA) pretraining to improve performance after target-task fine-tuning? We compare weighting, filtering, and conditioning across reward definitions and label granularities using 5,000 naturally suboptimal human demonstrations and 24 target tasks. Within each VLA, we match demonstrations and training budgets. Additional comparisons examine pretraining data size and the roles of quality tags during fine-tuning and inference. Across three VLAs, we find that approach-aware episode conditioning improves mean success over plain behavioral cloning; conditioning and filtering favor episode and chunk labels, respectively, on average, with model-dependent reversals; and constant-tag fine-tuning improves mean success after conditioned pretraining with either tagged or untagged inference. We introduce AXIS-Bench to support these controlled comparisons. Built on crowdsourced simulation demonstrations, it provides recorded object and contact states for recomputing quality labels on shared trajectories. Replayable trajectories support workspace-aligned rendering and user-defined real-world target tasks. In our real-world experiment, simulation pretraining raises success from 9.6\% to 31.7\%. Project page: https://axis-bench.github.io/.
tldr: This paper introduces AXIS-Bench, a benchmark and empirical study on quality-aware VLA pretraining, comparing weighting, filtering, and conditioning approaches across multiple VLAs and demonstrating that simulation pretraining with quality conditioning significantly improves real-world task success.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AXIS-Bench，一个关于质量感知VLA预训练的基准和实证研究，比较了多种VLA上的加权、过滤和条件化方法，并证明了带质量条件化的仿真预训练能显著提高真实世界任务成功率。
summary_zh: 在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）预训练过程中，应如何利用示范质量以提升目标任务微调后的性能？我们基于5,000条自然次优的人类示范和24个目标任务，对不同奖励定义和标签粒度下的加权、过滤与条件化方法进行了比较。在每个VLA中，我们匹配示范与训练预算。进一步的比较考察了预训练数据规模以及质量标签在微调和推理阶段的作用。在三种VLA中，我们发现，相较于普通行为克隆，注重方法的分幕条件化能够提升平均成功率；条件化与过滤分别倾向于分幕标签与分块标签，平均而言存在模型依赖的逆转现象；在带标签或不带标签的推理条件下，恒定标签微调能够在条件化预训练后提升平均成功率。我们引入AXIS-Bench以支持这些受控比较。该基准基于众包仿真示范构建，提供记录的物体与接触状态，以便在共享轨迹上重新计算质量标签。可回放的轨迹支持工作空间对齐渲染及用户定义的真实世界目标任务。在我们的真实世界实验中，仿真预训练将成功率从9.6%提升至31.7%。项目主页：https://axis-bench.github.io/。

title: AutoAgent0: An Agentic Runtime for Safe Closed-Loop Driving
summary: Safe autonomous driving requires more than accurate planning at a single frame: it demands reliable closed-loop execution in dynamic environments. Although end-to-end driving policies have advanced rapidly, the accumulated closed-loop errors, especially in unseen scenarios, can push vehicles into states from which the same policy struggles to recover. We address the challenge by treating closed-loop driving safety as a test-time execution problem. We introduce AutoAgent0, an agentic runtime and harness framework that augments existing driving experts with complementary detection skills, rule-based action verification, and feedback-driven recovery. To address inaccurate scene perception, an independent detection module constructs scene context using complementary perception skills, and a rule-based verifier checks proposed trajectories against this context before execution. When the nominal trajectories are unreliable, the orchestrator of the runtime activates Recovery Planning, where an agentic loop constructs alternative action proposals from action primitives and iteratively refines them using verification feedback. This design combines independent scene assessment with feasibility checks and online recovery, addressing both perception errors and the limited recovery capabilities of individual experts. Evaluations on Fail2Drive and NavSafe-$\infty$ demonstrate improved closed-loop robustness over single-expert execution in long-tail and safety-critical scenarios. These results demonstrate that runtime supervision can improve closed-loop robustness across multiple driving experts without retraining the underlying policies.
tldr: AutoAgent0 is an agentic runtime that enhances closed-loop driving safety by adding perception, rule-based verification, and iterative recovery planning around existing driving policies, improving robustness in long-tail scenarios without retraining.
tldr_zh: AutoAgent0 是一个智能体运行时，通过添加感知、基于规则的验证和迭代恢复规划来增强现有驾驶策略的闭环安全性，无需重新训练即可提高长尾场景中的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 安全自动驾驶不仅需要在单帧图像中实现精确规划，更要求在动态环境中具备可靠的闭环执行能力。尽管端到端驾驶策略已取得显著进展，但累积的闭环误差——尤其是在未见场景中——可能将车辆推入同一策略难以恢复的状态。我们通过将闭环驾驶安全视为测试时执行问题来应对这一挑战。我们提出AutoAgent0，一个智能体运行时与支撑框架，通过补充性检测技能、基于规则的行动验证和反馈驱动的恢复机制，增强现有驾驶专家系统的能力。为解决场景感知不准确的问题，独立的检测模块利用互补感知技能构建场景上下文，规则验证器在执行前将提议轨迹与此上下文进行比对校验。当名义轨迹不可靠时，运行时编排器激活恢复规划模块，其中智能体循环从行动原语构造替代行动方案，并利用验证反馈进行迭代优化。该设计将独立场景评估与可行性检查及在线恢复相结合，同时应对感知误差和单个专家系统恢复能力有限的问题。在Fail2Drive和NavSafe-$\infty$上的评估表明，在长尾和安全关键场景中，该方法的闭环鲁棒性优于单一专家执行。这些结果证明，运行时监督能够在无需重新训练底层策略的情况下，提升多种驾驶专家系统的闭环鲁棒性。

title: Interaction Latents as Actions for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to coordinate not only where to move, but also how contact and force should evolve throughout an interaction. Yet most robot policies represent actions primarily as motion trajectories, using tactile signals as inputs or auxiliary prediction targets without explicitly encoding contact dynamics in the action representation. We propose ILA (Interaction Latents as Actions), which uses decodable interaction latents that jointly capture the evolution of motion, contact, and force application as policy action units, providing a shared representation for action generation, evaluation, and offline improvement. We learn these latents through visually conditioned joint action-tactile reconstruction with a time-conditioned implicit decoder. Using them as flow-matching generation targets supports post-training of pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs), as well as training flow-matching policies from scratch. A shared decoder maps generated latents to executable actions. For offline improvement, we learn a tactile-conditioned expert reference model from interaction latents encoded from expert demonstrations. The resulting expert-consistency rewards guide weighted learning from successful rollouts, while observation-compatible expert references guide correction of low-reward predictions from failed rollouts. Across three policy families, ILA improves success rates averaged over four real-world tasks by 21.0-36.5 percentage points relative to tactile-conditioned direct-action baselines. Ablations highlight the benefit of encoding contact evolution in action targets beyond tactile conditioning, while the same latent space supports expert-guided offline improvement. Project website: https://mrsecant.github.io/ILA/.
tldr: This paper introduces ILA, which uses decodable interaction latents jointly modeling motion, contact, and force as action units to improve contact-rich manipulation policies, including post-training VLAs and world action models, and enabling offline improvement via expert-consistency rewards.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ILA，使用可解码的交互潜变量联合建模运动、接触和力作为动作单元，以改进接触丰富的操作策略，包括对VLA和世界动作模型的后训练，并通过专家一致性奖励实现离线改进。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作要求机器人不仅要协调移动的位置，还要协调接触和力在整个交互过程中应如何演变。然而，大多数机器人策略主要将动作表示为运动轨迹，将触觉信号用作输入或辅助预测目标，而未在动作表示中显式编码接触动力学。我们提出ILA（交互潜变量作为动作），使用可解码的交互潜变量作为策略动作单元，联合捕捉运动、接触和力施加的演变，为动作生成、评估和离线改进提供共享表示。我们通过视觉条件下的联合动作-触觉重建和时间条件下的隐式解码器来学习这些潜变量。将它们用作流匹配生成目标，支持对预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）进行后训练，也支持从头训练流匹配策略。共享解码器将生成的潜变量映射为可执行动作。对于离线改进，我们从专家示范编码的交互潜变量中学习触觉条件下的专家参考模型。由此产生的专家一致性奖励指导从成功 rollout 中进行加权学习，而观察兼容的专家参考则指导对低奖励预测（来自失败 rollout）的修正。在三个策略家族中，相对于触觉条件下的直接动作基线，ILA在四个真实世界任务上的平均成功率提高了21.0-36.5个百分点。消融实验凸显了在动作目标中编码接触演变（超越触觉条件化）的益处，而相同的潜空间也支持专家引导的离线改进。项目网站：https://mrsecant.github.io/ILA/。

title: ForceWAM: Decoupling Future and Response Learning from Demo and Play Data for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Expert demonstrations show how to complete contact-rich tasks, but provide limited coverage of how interaction forces respond to different actions. Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. To fully leverage these two types of data, we introduce ForceWAM, a force world action model that decouples knowledge of task-compatible interaction outcomes from knowledge of how local actions change contact. A world model learns from successful demonstrations to jointly predict future video and six-axis force/torque trajectories. Together, these futures describe the expected evolution of motion and contact during the task. A separate inverse dynamics model (IDM) learns from both task and play, mapping current observations and recorded visual-wrench futures to their associated robot actions. Play data thus provide knowledge of force responses for goal-directed execution. At deployment, the IDM reactively translates generated futures into actions, reusing them with fresh wrench feedback between world-model updates. Across real-robot force-regulated sliding, box flipping with and without disturbances, and ring placement, ForceWAM achieves $85$-$95\%$ mean success, surpassing world-modeling and reactive baselines. Our experiments further show that adding task-agnostic play data improves success by $15$-$45$ percentage points, demonstrating its value for learning contact-rich execution. Project page and code are available at https://force-wam.github.io/.
tldr: ForceWAM decouples future prediction from inverse dynamics, learning from both expert demonstrations and task-agnostic play data to enable force-regulated contact-rich manipulation on real robots, achieving high success rates.
tldr_zh: ForceWAM 将未来预测与逆动力学解耦，从专家示范和任务无关的玩耍数据中学习，以实现真实机器人上的力控接触丰富操作，取得了较高的成功率。
summary_zh: 专家演示展示了如何完成接触密集任务，但关于交互力如何响应不同行动的覆盖范围有限。与任务无关的随意操作数据提供了更广泛的接触动力学经验，而无需指定任务目标。为充分利用这两类数据，我们引入了ForceWAM，一种力世界动作模型，将任务兼容交互结果的知识与局部动作如何改变接触的知识解耦。世界模型从成功的演示中学习，联合预测未来的视频和六轴力/力矩轨迹。这些未来状态共同描述了任务过程中运动和接触的预期演变。独立的逆动力学模型（IDM）同时从任务数据和随意操作数据中学习，将当前观察和记录的视觉-力未来状态映射到相应的机器人动作。随意操作数据因此为以目标为导向的执行提供了力响应的知识。在部署时，IDM反应性地将生成的未来状态转化为动作，并在世界模型更新之间利用新的力反馈重用这些动作。在真实机器人的力调节滑动、带扰动和无扰动的箱子翻转以及圆环放置任务中，ForceWAM实现了85%-95%的平均成功率，超越了世界建模和反应式基线方法。我们的实验进一步表明，添加与任务无关的随意操作数据将成功率提高了15-45个百分点，证明了其在学习接触密集执行方面的价值。项目页面和代码可在 https://force-wam.github.io/ 获取。

title: Contact Trajectory Prompting: In-Context Transfer of Contact-Rich Behaviors from a Single Demonstration
summary: In-context robot learning enables robots to acquire new behaviors from demonstrations without test-time parameter updates. However, visual and kinematic specifications alone may not distinguish contact-rich behaviors that share similar motions but require different interaction intensities or patterns. We propose Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP), a framework for one-shot transfer of contact-rich manipulation behaviors. CTP encodes motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered contact trajectory prompt that captures their temporal evolution and specifies the desired physical interaction behavior. During execution, the policy uses online sensory feedback to retrieve interaction-relevant information from the prompt, conditioning closed-loop action generation on the demonstrated contact behavior. Across real-world wiping, rotation, and insertion tasks on objects excluded from training, CTP achieves 78.7% overall success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 13.0 percentage points. Changing only the reference demonstration enables CTP to follow contact specifications for both intensity and direction, including an intermediate wiping force level and clockwise or counterclockwise cap rotation. These results demonstrate that contact trajectories serve as effective behavioral specifications, extending in-context robot learning beyond motion imitation to physical interaction transfer. Project website: https://ctp-robotics.github.io/project_page.
tldr: This paper introduces Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP), a framework that encodes motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered prompt, enabling in-context transfer of contact-rich manipulation behaviors to new objects with improved success rates and the ability to specify interaction intensity and direction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了接触轨迹提示（CTP）框架，将单个演示中的运动和接触信息编码为有序提示，实现接触丰富操作行为在新物体上的上下文内迁移，提高了成功率，并能指定交互强度和方向。
summary_zh: 上下文机器人学习使机器人能够从示范中获取新行为，而无需在测试时更新参数。然而，仅凭视觉和运动学规格可能无法区分接触丰富的行为——这些行为具有相似的运动轨迹，但需要不同的交互强度或模式。我们提出了接触轨迹提示（CTP），一种用于接触丰富操作行为一次性迁移的框架。CTP将来自单个示范的运动和接触信息编码为有序的接触轨迹提示，该提示捕捉其时间演变并指定所需的物理交互行为。在执行过程中，策略利用在线感觉反馈从提示中检索与交互相关的信息，将闭环动作生成条件化于示范的接触行为。在训练未见物体上的真实世界擦拭、旋转和插入任务中，CTP实现了78.7%的整体成功率，比最强评估基线高出13.0个百分点。仅更改参考示范即可使CTP遵循强度和方向上的接触规格，包括中间擦拭力水平以及顺时针或逆时针瓶盖旋转。这些结果表明，接触轨迹作为有效的行为规格，将上下文机器人学习从运动模仿扩展到物理交互迁移。项目网站：https://ctp-robotics.github.io/project_page。

title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robot policies are expected to generalize across deployment environments, including variations in the robot itself: cameras are bumped and remounted, calibrations drift, controllers run at different rates, and end-effector pads wear down. We present LIBERO-RIG, a benchmark that perturbs only the robot's hardware and setup while holding every LIBERO task fixed. The benchmark spans eleven perturbation axes, including camera mounting and optics, camera-to-arm calibration, actuation gain, control rate, proprioceptive noise, base pose, table height, and gripper pads. Each axis has five severity levels, yielding 210 conditions across the four LIBERO suites. We evaluate nine recent vision-language-action models using 500 episodes per condition and substantiate each finding with rigorous statistical tests. Pooled success falls from 0.932 to 0.767 at the middle severity and 0.509 at the highest severity. Performance degradation varies substantially across perturbation axes and action interfaces, and training on visual perturbations does not mitigate faults that leave camera images unchanged. We release the benchmark together with manifests specifying the fixed perturbation parameters for each episode.
tldr: This paper introduces LIBERO-RIG, a benchmark that systematically perturbs robot hardware setups to evaluate the robustness of vision-language-action (VLA) models, finding that current models significantly degrade with setup variations and that visual perturbation training does not transfer to non-visual faults.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LIBERO-RIG，一个系统性地扰动机器人硬件设置以评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型鲁棒性的基准，发现当前模型在设置变化下性能显著下降，且视觉扰动训练无法迁移到非视觉故障。
summary_zh: 机器人策略预期需在多种部署环境中泛化，包括机器人自身的各类变化：摄像头被碰撞并重新安装、标定漂移、控制器以不同速率运行、末端执行器衬垫磨损等。我们提出LIBERO-RIG，一个仅扰动机器人硬件与设置、同时保持所有LIBERO任务不变的基准测试。该基准覆盖十一个扰动维度，包括摄像头安装方式与光学特性、摄像头与机械臂之间的标定、执行增益、控制频率、本体感觉噪声、基座位置、工作台高度以及夹爪衬垫。每个维度设有五个严重等级，涵盖四个LIBERO套件共计210种条件。我们使用每种条件500个回合评估了九种近期视觉-语言-动作模型，并通过严格的统计检验验证了每项发现。总体成功率在中等级别扰动下从0.932下降至0.767，在最高级别扰动下降至0.509。性能下降幅度在不同扰动维度和动作接口之间存在显著差异，而对视觉扰动的训练并不能缓解摄像头图像未受变化时的故障。我们随基准一同发布清单，其中详细规定了每个回合的固定扰动参数。

title: WorldOracle: Benchmarking Action-Conditioned World Models against Real-World Executions
summary: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We will release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard.
tldr: WorldOracle is a benchmark for evaluating action-conditioned world models by comparing their predicted rollouts against paired real-world executions, covering physical state correctness, spatial alignment, key interaction fidelity, and multi-view coherence across manipulation episodes.
tldr_zh: WorldOracle 是一个用于评估动作条件世界模型的基准，通过将预测的 rollout 与配对的真实世界执行进行比较，涵盖物理状态正确性、空间对齐、关键交互保真度和多视角连贯性。
summary_zh: 我们推出了WorldOracle，这是一个专门设计的基准测试，旨在对照配对真实世界执行情况来评估基于动作的条件世界模型（ACWMs）。给定相同的初始观测和低级动作序列，WorldOracle检验预测的模拟结果是否复现了真实世界中发生的情况，包括物理后果和任务状态转换。我们从四个互补维度对模型进行评估：物理状态正确性、交互空间对齐、关键交互区域保真度以及多视角动作一致性。为支持这一评估，我们精心构建了覆盖不同交互动态和体现形式的真实世界训练与评估套件。评估套件包含长时间、多片段的情节，既有成功也有失败的执行案例，从而能够对多样化的动作结果和行为分布进行评估。对七个代表性ACWM的实验揭示了模型各自的长处与失败模式。WorldOracle为衡量和推进基于动作的操控世界建模提供了系统化的基础。我们将公开发布数据集、评估代码及排行榜。

title: EgoMatrix: Physically Faithful Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Egocentric Human Videos
summary: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation data. However, two challenges limit their use as reliable training data: accurate hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB and high-quality robot demonstrations, especially visual observations. We present EgoMatrix, an end-to-end data engine that converts monocular egocentric human videos into bimanual dexterous trajectories and paired robot observation videos, with the trajectories directly replayable on real robots. It reconstructs HOI with emphasis on relative geometry and contact rather than exact metric scene recovery, then uses retargeting and reinforcement learning (RL) to reproduce the demonstrated tasks in simulation. We jointly render robot hands and objects from these simulated trajectories to produce physically faithful observations synchronized with state and control records. Rendering the same trajectories in diverse, task-compatible backgrounds expands paired training data while preserving robot-object motion and contact. Across TACO, OakInk2, and self-collected data, EgoMatrix achieves 54.84% end-to-end success in simulation versus 14.52% for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction reaches state-of-the-art performance on most metrics of the two public benchmarks. Qualitative results show more faithful hand-object interactions than prior methods, while feature-space analysis shows closer alignment with real-robot observations than GPT-6 Astra. Our project page is available at https://spikew726.github.io/EgoMatrix/.
tldr: EgoMatrix converts egocentric human videos into physically faithful, replayable bimanual dexterous robot demonstrations by reconstructing hand-object interactions with emphasis on relative geometry and contact, then using retargeting and RL in simulation to generate paired robot observation videos and diverse backgrounds, enabling real-robot deployment.
tldr_zh: EgoMatrix将第一人称人类视频转换为物理上忠实且可在真实机器人上重放的双臂灵巧操作演示，通过强调相对几何和接触的手物交互重建，并在仿真中利用重定向和强化学习生成配对的机器人观察视频及多样背景，实现真实机器人部署。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类视频为机器人远程操作提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，用于收集灵巧操作数据。然而，两个挑战限制了它们作为可靠训练数据的应用：从单目RGB图像中准确重建手-物交互（HOI），以及生成高质量的机器人演示，尤其是视觉观察。我们提出了EgoMatrix，一个端到端的数据引擎，将单目自我中心人类视频转换为双臂灵巧轨迹和配对的机器人观察视频，且轨迹可直接在真实机器人上回放。它重建HOI时侧重于相对几何和接触，而非精确的度量场景恢复，然后使用重定向和强化学习（RL）在仿真中复现所演示的任务。我们联合渲染来自这些仿真轨迹的机器人手和物体，生成与状态和控制记录同步的物理保真观察数据。在不同且任务兼容的背景中渲染相同轨迹，扩展了配对训练数据，同时保持了机器人-物体运动和接触的一致性。在TACO、OakInk2和自采集数据上，EgoMatrix在仿真中实现了54.84%的端到端成功率，而最强基线仅为14.52%。重建在两个公开基准的大多数指标上达到了最先进水平。定性结果显示，与先前方法相比，手-物交互更加忠实，而特征空间分析显示，与GPT-6 Astra相比，与真实机器人观察的对齐度更高。我们的项目页面可在https://spikew726.github.io/EgoMatrix/访问。

title: EqC: Equilibrium Energy Control for Introspective Lifelong Robot Learning
summary: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.
tldr: EqC introduces an energy-based framework for lifelong robot learning, using refinement geometry to detect policy competence and trigger expert interventions that expand autonomous capability over time, integrated with diffusion and VLA policies.
tldr_zh: EqC 提出了一种基于能量的终身机器人学习框架，通过细化过程的几何特征检测策略能力边界，触发专家干预并逐步扩展自主操作范围，适用于扩散策略和 VLA 策略。
summary_zh: 长期机器人的自主性不仅依赖于有效的动作生成：策略必须识别其行为何时不再得到充分支持，并利用辅助进行改进。我们提出了平衡能量控制（EqC），这是一种围绕显式条件能量景观构建的内省式终身机器人学习框架。EqC将生成式动作细化视为寻求平衡的优化过程，而细化过程的几何结构则揭示了生成的行为是否与所学景观保持一致。这一能力信号使得能量门控DAgger得以实现，其中持续的能量一致性违反会触发专家接管，并将由此产生的恢复轨迹聚合用于后续的策略更新。EqC自然集成到扩散Transformer策略和基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中。在仿真和真实世界的双臂操作中，EqC在匹配或提升控制性能与鲁棒性的同时，能够在策略能力边界附近实现及时干预。一项真实世界研究进一步表明，这些干预如何逐步扩展自主处理的情境范围，为从静态生成式控制器向自我改进机器人系统提供了一条切实可行的路径。

title: Steertuning Policies from a Few Human Videos
summary:
Current recipes for robot learning require massive amounts of robot demonstrations to obtain robust and adaptive policies. In this work, we introduce Steertuning, a system that enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from 5 human demonstrations in under 5
  Steertuning consists of two parts. (1) We pretrain a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on our egocentric human dataset, which consists of 100 hours of densely annotated random interactions. This pretraining makes Steertuning robust to background differences and enables spatial and object generalization when deployed on new tasks. (2) Given 5 demonstrations of a new task, we finetune our model for only 2 minutes (2000 training updates) and steer the policy's actions during reverse sampling using the demonstration whose observation is closest to that of the deployment environment. Together with a carefully designed data processing pipeline for embodiment transfer, this enables Steertuning to achieve a 71% success rate across 12 tasks in 12 new environments, ranging from lab settings to kitchens in new homes. The entire process, from data collection for a new task to robot policy deployment, takes less than 5 minutes. Our full dataset, model weights, codebase, and robot videos will be made available at our website: https://steertuning.github.io.
tldr: Steertuning pretrains a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on 100 hours of egocentric human video, then fine-tunes on 5 human demonstrations per task in 2 minutes to deploy on real robots, achieving 71% success across 12 tasks in new environments.
tldr_zh: Steertuning在100小时自我中心人类视频上预训练一个4亿参数的扩散策略，然后对每个任务的5个人类演示微调2分钟，部署到真实机器人上，在12个新环境中的12个任务上实现了71%的成功率。
summary_zh: 现有机器人学习方案通常需要大量机器人演示数据，才能获得稳健且自适应的策略。在本研究中，我们提出Steertuning系统，使机器人能够在少于5条人类演示数据的情况下，于新环境中学习新任务，且整个过程不超过5分钟。Steertuning由两个部分组成：（1）我们在自建的以自我为中心的人类数据集上预训练了一个4亿参数的扩散策略模型，该数据集包含100小时密集标注的随机交互。这一预训练使Steertuning对背景差异具有鲁棒性，并在部署到新任务时实现空间与物体的泛化。（2）给定新任务的5条演示数据，我们仅需对模型进行2分钟（2000次训练更新）的微调，并在反向采样过程中，利用与部署环境观测最接近的演示来引导策略动作。结合精心设计的、用于具身迁移的数据处理流程，Steertuning在12个新环境（涵盖实验室场景及新家庭厨房等）中的12项任务上实现了71%的成功率。从新任务的数据采集到机器人策略部署的整个流程，耗时不到5分钟。我们的完整数据集、模型权重、代码库及机器人演示视频将发布在项目网站：https://steertuning.github.io。

title: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
summary:
World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.
  We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.
  We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.
tldr: This paper introduces UniW(A)M, a unified mixture-of-experts framework built on diffusion Transformers that co-trains world models and world-action models, sharing physical dynamics across interfaces while preserving task-specific capabilities, and demonstrates superior performance in real-world manipulation and world modeling benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UniW(A)M，一种基于扩散Transformer的专家混合统一框架，协同训练世界模型和世界动作模型，共享物理动态同时保留各接口的特定能力，并在真实世界操作和世界建模基准上展现了优越性能。
summary_zh:
世界模型（WMs）与世界-动作模型（WAMs）分别聚焦于未来世界预测与可执行动作生成。尽管这两类模型均从具身轨迹中学习共享的物理动力学与交互语义，但它们通常被孤立训练，从而限制了预测与控制之间的知识复用。因此，核心挑战在于构建一个统一的学習框架，既能共享这些动力学知识，又能保留每种范式所需的独特建模能力。

我们提出UniW(A)M，一种基于扩散Transformer的专家混合世界-(动作)模型，统一了动作条件世界建模与多种WAM变体。共享专家捕获共同动力学，而原子能力专家跨接口复用，使每个接口保持自身的条件路径。在部署阶段，一个即插即用的自适应接口路由器（PAIR）从目标任务块场景的小规模子集中学习，为每个执行块选择适合的WAM接口，在保持骨干网络冻结的同时，平衡任务成功率与执行效率。

我们在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0以及三项真实世界操作任务上评估了UniW(A)M，其在真实世界中实现了88.3%的平均成功率，而最强基线的成功率为76.7%。在WorldArena上，该模型在所有三项任务中均引领动作条件世界建模。AC-WM协同训练对所有动作接口的动作生成均有贡献，且PAIR将分布外（OOD）成功率从63.3%提升至76.7%。

title: RadarGSOcc: Doppler-Aware 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction Using 4D Radar Tensor with Geometric-Semantic Feature Extraction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is crucial for autonomous driving, but camera-based methods degrade in low-light conditions and LiDAR-based methods are sensitive to adverse weather. 4D radar is more robust, yet its sparsity and the high cost of radar tensor processing limit its use. We propose Radar Geometric-Semantic Occupancy Prediction (RadarGSOcc), an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, including Doppler information, with a deformable attention-based geometric refinement module as its key component. We also introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built on the K-Radar dataset with refined LiDAR-based annotations. RadarGSOcc predicts 15 classes within a 51.2m range and achieves 38.2% IoU, 7.6% mIoU, and 25.5% weighted mIoU, outperforming RadarOcc by 17% relative (25.5 vs. 21.9) in weighted mIoU while using fewer parameters and lower computation. It substantially improves truck prediction while trading off car accuracy, outperforms camera-based approaches, and narrows the gap with LiDAR-based methods. To assess robustness without per-frame ground truth in adverse weather, we further propose a novel proxy metric, Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL), under which 4D radar proves a reliable and efficient modality for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. The dataset and code will be publicly available.
tldr: RadarGSOcc proposes an efficient 4D radar-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction framework for autonomous driving, introducing a new K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark and a robustness proxy metric, achieving strong performance with fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: RadarGSOcc 提出了一种基于4D雷达的高效3D语义占据预测框架，用于自动驾驶，并引入了新的K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准和鲁棒性代理指标，在更少参数下取得了优异的性能。
summary_zh: 三维语义占用预测对于自动驾驶至关重要，但基于相机的方法在低光照条件下性能下降，而基于激光雷达的方法对恶劣天气敏感。4D雷达更为稳健，然而其稀疏性及雷达张量处理的高成本限制了其应用。我们提出雷达几何-语义占用预测（RadarGSOcc），一种高效框架，通过分别提取几何与语义特征（包括多普勒信息）直接处理4D雷达张量，其关键组件为基于可变形注意力的几何精化模块。我们还引入了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准，这是首个使用4D雷达张量进行三维语义占用预测的大规模基准，基于K-Radar数据集构建，并采用精化的激光雷达标注。RadarGSOcc在51.2米范围内预测15个类别，实现了38.2%的IoU、7.6%的mIoU和25.5%的加权mIoU，在加权mIoU上相对RadarOcc提升了17%（25.5对比21.9），同时使用更少的参数和更低的计算量。它大幅提升了卡车预测性能，同时在小汽车精度上有所取舍，优于基于相机的方法，并缩小了与基于激光雷达方法的差距。为了在缺乏逐帧真值的恶劣天气下评估鲁棒性，我们进一步提出一种新的代理指标——基于环境的KL散度（EBKL），在该指标下，4D雷达被证明是一种可靠且高效的三维语义占用预测模态。数据集和代码将公开发布。

title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.
tldr: ACCRUE introduces a continual off-policy RL framework for robot foundation models, carrying actor-critic networks across tasks to accelerate learning with near-zero forgetting, demonstrated in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: ACCRUE 提出了一种用于机器人基础模型的持续离策略强化学习框架，跨任务携带演员-评论家网络以加速学习并几乎不遗忘，在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练使机器人基础模型（RFM）超越了其演示能力，但实际部署提出了更高要求：在保留既有行为的同时高效学习新任务。在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）之上现有的持续RL方法虽能缓解遗忘，却依赖在线策略更新，前向迁移能力有限；而离线策略方法虽能提升单任务样本效率，却未能解决跨任务的学习者持久性问题。我们提出ACCRUE，一种持续离线策略RL框架，在任务间携带轻量级演员与评论家网络，使每个阶段都能复用先前RL获得的行为与价值知识。继承的评论家仅基于当前任务转换进行适应，并指导当前任务的演员学习，同时通过将演员蒸馏至少量保留片段上的缓存目标来保持既有行为。固定视觉特征确保继承的学习者及其经验回放与基础策略更新兼容。在仿真及真实机器人硬件上的接触丰富装配序列中，ACCRUE加速了后续任务学习，遗忘近乎为零，并将真实机器人训练时间显著减少31.0%至68.5%。

title: MemoryVLN: From Ego-Aware Memory Representation to Cross-Context Memory Reuse in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MemoryVLN}, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. During memory construction, \emph{Long Sequence Compression} employs forgetting-curve-inspired temporal sampling to preserve dense recent evidence and sparse yet representative distant observations under a limited token budget. \emph{Ego-Aware Memory Representation} further integrates 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses, allowing each memory to encode both what was observed and where it was observed. During memory management, \emph{Hierarchical Memory Bank} maintains in-episode and context-level memories through cross-context warm-start and confidence-controlled write-back. \emph{Memory Enhancement} then retrieves the Top-$K$ relevant memories according to the current navigation state and fuses them with the current visual tokens. Together, these mechanisms transform raw navigation history into compact, spatially grounded, selectively retrievable, and reusable navigation experience. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin (i.e., 2\% and 6.5\% in successful rate).
tldr: MemoryVLN introduces a memory-driven navigation system with long-sequence compression, ego-aware memory representation, hierarchical memory banks, and memory enhancement to address context-length and spatial alignment issues in Vision-Language Navigation, achieving notable improvements on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MemoryVLN 提出了一种记忆驱动的导航系统，通过长序列压缩、自我感知记忆表示、分层记忆库和记忆增强来解决视觉语言导航中的上下文长度和空间对齐问题，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在具身视觉语言导航（VLN）中展现出强大潜力，然而在长程轨迹中，其性能因上下文长度限制、冗余的历史观察以及跨时间空间对齐不稳定而下降。这些问题使得既难以压缩长导航历史，又难以可靠地复用过去的空间经验。为解决上述局限，我们提出\textbf{MemoryVLN}，一个围绕记忆构建与管理构建的统一记忆驱动导航系统。在记忆构建阶段，\emph{长序列压缩}采用基于遗忘曲线的时序采样，在有限的token预算下保留密集的近期证据以及稀疏但具有代表性的远期观测。\emph{自我中心记忆表示}进一步整合2D语义token、3D几何token和6D智能体位姿，使每条记忆既能编码观测内容，也能编码观测位置。在记忆管理阶段，\emph{分层记忆库}通过跨上下文热启动和置信度控制的写回机制维护情节内记忆与上下文级记忆。随后，\emph{记忆增强}根据当前导航状态检索Top-$K$相关记忆，并将其与当前视觉token融合。这些机制共同将原始导航历史转化为紧凑、空间锚定、可选择性检索且可复用的导航经验。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，相较于最先进的基线方法，本方法在成功率上分别取得了2\%和6.5\%的显著提升。

title: PACT: Posture-Aligned Co-Design Technique for Hand Configuration and Retargeting in Multi-Finger Imitation Learning
summary: The fidelity of teleoperated demonstrations used for imitation learning is determined by how faithfully a robot hand can replicate the operator's posture. The posture retargeting law that the robot will execute is typically selected only once the hardware has been finalized, and conventional hand designs often neglect human-like grasping postures. We introduce PACT, an optimization based on human grasping postures that jointly optimizes the mechanical parameters of a 17-servo robot hand (link lengths, joint offsets, mounting angles, and base placements) and its nonlinear posture retargeter (a linear human-to-robot joint map, per-joint posture-IK weights, and damping). The optimization enforces full-finger correspondence (MCP, PIP, DIP, and tip of each finger) to human poses from the DexYCB dataset, and is constrained by servo interference, assembly clearances, and flat-hand protrusion, so the resulting design can be physically assembled. We fabricate the PACT Hand and validate it through teleoperation experiments and an imitation-learning demonstration. The hand reproduces all human hand keypoints with a kinematic RMSE of 3.9 mm, compared to 12.8 mm for the LEAP Hand baseline, and keeps all fingertips within 10 mm on every grasping posture, while the baseline achieves this for only 21.6% of the poses. Under matched per-joint torque limits, it lifts twice the baseline payload, 2 kg against 1 kg, and deforms a held paper cup seven times less, reaching a deformation level comparable to a human hand. It also achieves an 86% grasping success rate on YCB daily objects, compared to 64% for the baseline. Finally, as a demonstration, an imitation-learning policy trained on demonstrations collected with the PACT Hand achieved a 75% success rate at held-out placements in a can pick-and-place task. Project page: https://pact-hand-2027.github.io
tldr: PACT jointly optimizes a 17-servo robot hand’s mechanical design and posture retargeter against human grasping data, yielding a physically assembled hand that outperforms a baseline in kinematic fidelity, payload, deformation, and grasping, and supports imitation learning policies.
tldr_zh: PACT 通过联合优化 17 伺服机器人手的机械参数和姿态重定向器，使其更贴近人类抓取姿态，制造出的手在运动学精度、载荷、形变和抓取成功率上均优于基线，并支持模仿学习策略。
summary_zh: 远程操作演示的保真度（用于模仿学习）取决于机器人手能够多忠实地复现操作者的手部姿态。机器人将执行姿态重定向法则通常仅在硬件最终确定后才被选定，而传统的手部设计往往忽视了类人的抓取姿态。我们提出了PACT，一种基于人类抓取姿态的优化方法，该方法联合优化了一只17伺服机器人手的机械参数（连杆长度、关节偏移、安装角度和基座位置）及其非线性姿态重定向器（一个线性的人手到机器人关节映射、每个关节的姿态逆运动学权重以及阻尼）。该优化强制要求全手指对应关系（每个手指的MCP、PIP、DIP和指尖）与DexYCB数据集中的手部姿态一致，并受到伺服干扰、装配间隙和平掌凸出度的约束，从而使最终设计能够被物理装配。我们制造了PACT手，并通过远程操作实验和一次模仿学习演示对其进行了验证。该手复现所有人手关键点时的运动学均方根误差为3.9毫米，而LEAP手基线的误差为12.8毫米；并且在每个抓取姿态下所有指尖均保持在10毫米以内，而基线仅在21.6%的姿态下达到这一要求。在匹配的每关节扭矩限制下，它的负载能力为基线的两倍，即2公斤对1公斤；并且使所握持纸杯的变形量降低七倍，达到与人类手相当的变形水平。在YCB日常物体上的抓取成功率为86%，而基线为64%。最后，作为一项演示，一个使用PACT手采集的演示数据训练的模仿学习策略，在罐头拾取-放置任务的未见过摆放位置上达到了75%的成功率。项目页面：https://pact-hand-2027.github.io

title: Intent-guided Adaptive Stiffening for Visuomotor Policies under Unknown Resistance
summary: Manipulation tasks such as unscrewing a cap or sliding a part in contact with a surface require imposing force along a high-friction direction: the robot must overcome a resistance rather than yield to it. Generative visuomotor policies predict the motion for such tasks but not the authority needed to realize it, and that authority is bounded by the impedance controller beneath them: when the resistance exceeds what a compliant controller can exert under a bounded tracking error, the task is unattainable however accurate the prediction is. The required amount cannot be anticipated either, since it depends on a contact state the observation does not reveal. In this paper, we propose a residual stiffening layer placed underneath an unmodified policy. Resistance is recognized, without force sensing, from the mismatch between the motion the policy commands and the motion the robot realizes, and a four-mode supervisor raises the stiffness along a single direction read off the policy's own action chunk, retains it while the task progresses and releases it afterwards. The layer needs no compliance labels, no retraining and no re-collected demonstrations. On two real tasks, unscrewing a bottle cap and pushing a T-nut along a T-slot groove against non-homogeneous friction, evaluated at six resistance levels of which two were withheld from the demonstrations, the layer raises the success rate from 52% to 90% while producing 61% less peak off-axis force than a uniformly stiff controller at the same resistance.
tldr: This paper introduces a residual stiffening layer for visuomotor policies that adapts impedance in real-time based on the mismatch between commanded and realized motion, enabling manipulation under unknown resistance without force sensing or retraining. The method improves success rates on real-world tasks like bottle-cap unscrewing and T-nut pushing across various resistance levels.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于视觉运动策略的残差刚度层，根据指令运动与实际运动的差异实时调整阻抗，无需力传感或重新训练即可应对未知阻力。该方法在真实任务（如开瓶盖、T型螺母推动）中提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 操控类任务，如拧开瓶盖或沿表面推动部件进行接触滑动，要求沿高摩擦方向施加力：机器人必须克服阻力，而非屈服于它。生成式视觉运动策略能够预测此类任务中的运动，却无法预测实现该运动所需的驱动力，而这种驱动力受制于其底层的阻抗控制器：当阻力超出柔顺控制器在有限跟踪误差下所能施加的力时，无论预测多么准确，任务都无法完成。所需的力的大小也无法预先估计，因为它取决于观察数据无法揭示的接触状态。在本文中，我们提出了一种置于未经修改的策略下方的残余刚度增强层。该层无需力传感，仅通过策略指令的运动与实际执行的运动之间的偏差来识别阻力，并由一个四模式监督器沿策略自身动作块所指示的单一方向提高刚度，在任务推进期间维持该刚度，并在任务结束后释放。该层无需顺应性标注、无需重新训练、也无需重新采集示范数据。在两项实际任务中——拧开瓶盖和沿T型槽推动T型螺母以克服非均匀摩擦——我们在六种阻力水平下进行评估，其中两种阻力水平未包含在示范数据中。结果表明，该层将成功率从52%提升至90%，同时在相同阻力下产生的峰值离轴力比均匀刚度控制器低61%。

title: Benchmarking Interaction-Oriented Aerial Mobility across Heterogeneous Environments
summary: Aerial mobile manipulation requires unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to traverse heterogeneous environments such as indoor and outdoor domains, and connect navigation with subsequent physical interaction within the same trajectories. Existing aerial benchmarks are typically confined to single-environment settings, limiting evaluation of agents across continuous environmental transitions. When interaction is evaluated, agents are often initialized near the target, leaving the transition from navigation to interaction largely unassessed. This work introduces CrossFly, a benchmark for long-horizon interaction-oriented aerial mobility across heterogeneous environments. CrossFly contains 15K trajectories across more than 20 reconstructed scenes under a unified simulation and evaluation framework, covering Indoor, Outdoor, and Indoor$\leftrightarrow$Outdoor trajectories. It further introduces Interaction Readiness Rate (IRR) to assess whether terminal navigation states provide suitable conditions for downstream interaction without assuming a specific manipulation policy. Experiments with five representative aerial vision-language-action (VLA) agents and the proposed CrossFly-Agent show that Indoor$\leftrightarrow$Outdoor settings are more challenging than single-environment settings, with the highest success rate reaching 9.7% on unseen scenes. A downstream manipulation case study further validates the relevance of interaction-oriented arrival to subsequent physical interaction. We hope CrossFly helps advance aerial embodied intelligence toward unified mobility and physical interaction in heterogeneous environments.
tldr: CrossFly is a benchmark for long-horizon interaction-oriented aerial mobility across heterogeneous indoor/outdoor environments, evaluating five VLA agents and introducing the Interaction Readiness Rate metric. It shows that cross-environment navigation-to-interaction trajectories are challenging, with the best success rate at 9.7% on unseen scenes.
tldr_zh: CrossFly是一个用于跨异构室内/室外环境的长时间交互式空中移动基准，评估了五种VLA智能体并引入了交互就绪率指标。它表明跨环境导航到交互的轨迹具有挑战性，在未见场景中最佳成功率仅为9.7%。
