summary_zh: 空中移动操作要求无人机（UAV）在室内与室外等异构环境中穿行，并在同一轨迹内将导航与后续物理交互相衔接。现有空中基准通常局限于单一环境设定，限制了对智能体在连续环境转换中的评估。在评估交互时，智能体往往被初始化于目标附近，导致从导航到交互的转换过程在很大程度上未被考察。本工作提出CrossFly，一个面向异构环境中长时程、以交互为导向的空中移动基准。CrossFly在统一仿真与评估框架下，涵盖超过20个重建场景中的15K条轨迹，覆盖室内、室外以及室内↔室外三类轨迹。该基准进一步引入交互就绪率（IRR），用于评估终端导航状态是否为下游交互提供合适条件，而无需预设特定操作策略。基于五种代表性空中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）智能体及所提出的CrossFly-Agent的实验表明，室内↔室外设定较单一环境设定更具挑战性，在未见场景中的最高成功率达到9.7%。下游操作案例研究进一步验证了以交互为导向的到达状态对后续物理交互的相关性。我们希望CrossFly能够推动空中具身智能在异构环境中实现统一移动与物理交互的进步。

title: CoSMO: Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation
summary: Safe autonomous navigation requires not only geometric obstacle avoidance but also semantic awareness. Different object categories demand different safety clearances, and the set of relevant categories may expand as the robot explores novel environments. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich semantic representations for building maps of unknown scenes, yet their confidence scores are poorly calibrated, making raw predictions unreliable for safety-critical planning. Conformal prediction (CP) can provide coverage guarantees, but existing methods assume a fixed label set and stationary data, limiting their use in open-world settings. We propose Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation (CoSMO), a semantic safety mapping framework that transforms VLM embeddings into calibrated coverage sets and safety-aware obstacle dilations over a dynamically expanding hazard vocabulary, even under distribution shift. Experiments on the Matterport3D (MP3D) dataset show that CoSMO reduces semantic collisions by 61.6% relative to a geometry-only baseline, while maintaining formal coverage guarantees even under delayed expert feedback. Real-world experiments on a quadruped robot further demonstrate generalization by achieving long-run empirical coverage of 90.73% against the 90% target. Project website: https://yangming911.github.io/cosmo-page/.
tldr: CoSMO integrates conformal prediction with VLM embeddings to build open-vocabulary semantic safety maps for robot navigation, providing calibrated coverage guarantees and reducing semantic collisions in both simulated and real-world quadruped experiments.
tldr_zh: CoSMO将保形预测与视觉语言模型嵌入相结合，为机器人导航构建开放词汇的语义安全地图，在仿真和真实四足机器人实验中提供校准的覆盖保证并减少语义碰撞。
summary_zh: 安全自主导航不仅需要几何层面的障碍物规避，还需具备语义理解能力。不同类别的物体对应不同的安全间距要求，且随着机器人在陌生环境中探索，相关类别集合可能动态扩展。视觉语言模型（VLM）为构建未知场景地图提供了丰富的语义表征，但其置信度分数校准不良，使得原始预测难以可靠地用于安全关键型规划。共形预测（CP）能够提供覆盖保证，但现有方法假设标签集固定且数据分布平稳，限制了其在开放世界场景中的适用性。我们提出了面向开放世界安全机器人导航的共形语义建图方法（CoSMO），该框架能够将VLM嵌入转换为校准后的覆盖集合，并在动态扩展的危险词汇表上实现安全感知的障碍物膨胀处理，即便在分布偏移情况下依然有效。在Matterport3D（MP3D）数据集上的实验表明，相较于仅依赖几何信息的基线方法，CoSMO将语义碰撞率降低了61.6%，同时在专家反馈延迟的情况下仍保持形式化的覆盖保证。在四足机器人上的真实世界实验进一步验证了其泛化能力，在90%目标覆盖率下实现了90.73%的长期经验覆盖率。项目网站：https://yangming911.github.io/cosmo-page/。

title: OneDemo: Unified Policy Learning and Data Generation from a Single Demonstration
summary: Learning robot policies from demonstrations is often limited by the cost of collecting diverse, high-quality expert data. While an appealing alternative is to expand a single successful demonstration into a diverse set of successful trajectories, existing augmentation methods typically rely on manually designed transformation rules or complex trajectory planning, requiring substantial task-specific engineering and human effort. We introduce OneDemo, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to edit a single successful demonstration for new task configurations. We formulate demonstration editing as a structured reinforcement learning problem, in which an editor learns, from sparse task-success rewards, both when to transition between object-centric trajectory segments and how to geometrically adapt each segment. The learned editor serves both as a task policy and as a reusable demonstration generator. Across 15 Meta-World tasks, OneDemo reaches a 92.7% success rate within 53.7k environment interactions on average. Across 9 DexMimicGen tasks, it generates successful demonstrations with a 98.4% average success rate, and BC-RNN policies trained on the generated data achieve 99.6% average success at matched dataset scale. These results show that learning to edit a single successful demonstration provides a structured and effective basis for both policy learning and scalable demonstration generation.
tldr: OneDemo introduces a reinforcement learning framework that learns to edit a single demonstration into diverse successful trajectories for new task configurations, serving both as a task policy and a demonstration generator, achieving high success rates across Meta-World and DexMimicGen benchmarks.
tldr_zh: OneDemo提出了一种强化学习框架，学习将单个演示编辑为针对新任务配置的多样化成功轨迹，既作为任务策略又作为演示生成器，在Meta-World和DexMimicGen基准上取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 从示范中学习机器人策略通常受限于收集多样化、高质量专家数据的成本。尽管一个颇具吸引力的替代方案是将单个成功的示范扩展为一系列多样化的成功轨迹，但现有的增强方法通常依赖人工设计的变换规则或复杂的轨迹规划，这需要大量针对具体任务的专业工程和人力投入。我们提出了OneDemo，一种强化学习框架，旨在学习编辑单个成功示范以适应新的任务配置。我们将示范编辑形式化为一个结构化的强化学习问题，其中编辑器从稀疏的任务成功奖励中学习，既要掌握在物体中心轨迹段之间何时进行切换，也要掌握如何对每一段进行几何适应。学习到的编辑器既充当任务策略，又充当可复用的示范生成器。在15个Meta-World任务中，OneDemo平均在53.7千次环境交互内达到了92.7%的成功率。在9个DexMimicGen任务中，它生成的示范平均成功率达到98.4%，且基于生成数据训练的BC-RNN策略在匹配数据集规模下实现了99.6%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，学习编辑单个成功示范为策略学习和可扩展的示范生成提供了结构化且有效的基础。

title: Beyond Planning: Differentiable Control-in-the-loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved remarkable progress by planning trajectories directly from raw sensor data. Yet the step from planning to control still relies on hand-tuned tracking controllers that block the gradient path from vehicle motion back to the network. This gap stems from non-differentiable vehicle dynamics, aliased supervision from coarsely sampled expert labels, rate mismatch between high-rate control and low-rate re-planning, and vehicle model discrepancies between training and deployment. This paper proposes DIVA (Differentiable Identified Vehicle dynamics for end-to-end Autonomous driving) to close this gap. An identified actuator-level vehicle model is embedded in the training loop of the end-to-end driving network, forming a differentiable chain from perception to vehicle states. A learning-based control decoder replaces the external controller and is supervised on the rolled-out vehicle states, bypassing the aliased control-input labels. A rate-consistent control-input parameterization reconciles the heterogeneous sampling rates and enables asynchronous execution with a 3.8 ms control-only cycle. On-policy re-identification and an online disturbance observer address training-time distribution shift and deployment-time model mismatch respectively. On the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark, DIVA achieves a driving score of 86.7, surpassing the widely adopted state-of-the-art approach by 3.3 points while nearly halving mean jerk and reducing brake switching by 64%, and maintains superior path tracking accuracy under significant vehicle model mismatch at deployment.
tldr: DIVA embeds a differentiable identified vehicle dynamics model and a learning-based control decoder into the end-to-end driving training loop, closing the planning-to-control gap and improving closed-loop driving performance.
tldr_zh: DIVA 将可微分的车辆动力学模型和学习型控制解码器嵌入端到端驾驶训练循环中，弥合规划到控制的差距，并提升闭环驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶通过直接从原始传感器数据规划轨迹，已取得了显著进展。然而，从规划到控制的过渡仍然依赖于手工调参的跟踪控制器，这阻断了车辆运动反向传播至网络的梯度路径。这一差距源于不可微的车辆动力学、粗采样专家标签导致的混叠监督、高频率控制与低频率重规划之间的速率不匹配，以及训练与部署阶段车辆模型的不一致。本文提出DIVA（面向端到端自动驾驶的可微分辨识车辆动力学模型）以弥合这一差距。一个经辨识的执行器级车辆模型被嵌入端到端驾驶网络的训练循环中，形成从感知到车辆状态的可微分链路。基于学习的控制解码器取代外部控制器，并在展开的车辆状态上进行监督，从而绕开混叠的控制输入标签。一种速率一致的控制输入参数化方法调和了异构采样频率，并支持3.8毫秒纯控制周期的异步执行。在线策略重辨识与在线扰动观测器分别应对训练时的分布偏移与部署时的模型不匹配。在闭环Bench2Drive基准测试中，DIVA的驾驶得分为86.7，比广泛采用的最新方法高出3.3分，同时平均冲击度几乎减半，制动切换减少64%，并在部署中车辆模型显著失配的情况下仍保持优越的路径跟踪精度。

title: Force Sensor-Based Picking Pattern Analysis and Two-Jaw Gripper Design for Cherry Tomato Robotic Harvesting in Greenhouse
summary: Robotic harvesting of cherry tomatoes in greenhouses remains challenging due to dense fruit clusters, delicate skin, and the need for gentle yet effective detachment. This study presents a force-data-driven framework for autonomous cherry tomato harvesting that integrates six-axis force/torque sensing, a bio-inspired compliant gripper, and deployment on a mobile robotic platform. A wearable ATI six-axis force/torque sensor mounted on the index finger captured kinetic signatures of three elemental picking patterns (gripping, twisting, and lateral pulling) across 150 manual trials (50 per pattern) in laboratory and greenhouse settings. Gripping required a peak normal force of 3.92 and 0.45 N, twisting produced a dominant torque of 19.20 2.10 Nmm about the pedicel axis with minimal truss disturbance, and pure lateral pulling alone was insufficient for reliable detachment. These measurements informed a novel fingertip-localised Finray gripper, with compliant TPU 95A Finray geometry restricted to the fruit-contact region and a rigid PLA body, emulating the dual-stiffness human fingertip. A Dynamixel XM430-W350 servomotor under current-based torque control applies the measured gripping force and a 45° wrist twist. Finite element analysis showed a maximum von Mises stress of 0.24 MPa under the 3.92 N load, below the bruising threshold of cherry tomato skin. Integrated on a UR5 arm and Clearpath Husky A200 base, the system was validated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and in 50 autonomous trials at the SILAL commercial greenhouse, Abu Dhabi, UAE. The hybrid grip-twist-pull strategy achieved an 86.0% picking success rate, 2.3% fruit damage, and an 8.4 s cycle time per fruit, outperforming vacuum (66.3%), rotating (70.1%), clamping (76.0%), and suction-cutting (52.4%) end-effectors. These results demonstrate preliminary feasibility under the tested facility and cultivar conditions
tldr: This paper presents a force-data-driven framework for autonomous cherry tomato harvesting, integrating six-axis force/torque sensing, a bio-inspired compliant Finray gripper, and a mobile robotic platform, achieving an 86.0% picking success rate with low fruit damage in real greenhouse trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于力数据驱动的自主樱桃番茄采摘框架，集成了六轴力/力矩传感、仿生柔性Finray夹爪和移动机器人平台，在真实温室试验中实现了86.0%的采摘成功率和低果实损伤。
summary_zh: 温室中樱桃番茄的机器人采摘仍面临诸多挑战，主要表现为果实簇密集、果皮娇嫩，以及需要轻柔而有效的分离方式。本研究提出了一种基于力数据驱动的樱桃番茄自主采摘框架，该框架集成了六轴力/力矩传感、仿生柔性夹爪，并部署于移动机器人平台。研究在实验室和温室环境中，通过佩戴于食指的可穿戴ATI六轴力/力矩传感器，捕捉了三种基本采摘模式（抓取、扭转和侧向拉拔）在150次人工试验（每种模式50次）中的动力学特征。抓取所需峰值法向力为3.92 N（标准差0.45 N）；扭转在果柄轴方向上产生主导扭矩19.20 N·mm（标准差2.10 N·mm），且对果穗扰动极小；单纯侧向拉拔不足以实现可靠分离。上述测量结果为新型指尖局部化Finray夹爪的设计提供了依据，该夹爪采用符合性TPU 95A Finray几何结构，仅限分布于果实接触区域，配合刚性PLA主体，模拟人体指尖的双刚度特性。在基于电流的力矩控制下，Dynamixel XM430-W350伺服电机施加所测量的抓取力，并实现45°手腕扭转。有限元分析表明，在3.92 N载荷下最大von Mises应力为0.24 MPa，低于樱桃番茄果皮的损伤阈值。该系统集成于UR5机械臂和Clearpath Husky A200移动底盘，在NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真环境及阿联酋阿布扎比SILAL商业温室的50次自主采摘试验中进行了验证。混合“抓取-扭转-拉拔”策略实现了86.0%的采摘成功率、2.3%的果实损伤率，以及每果8.4 s的循环时间，优于真空式（66.3%）、旋转式（70.1%）、夹持式（76.0%）和吸切式（52.4%）末端执行器。上述结果初步证明了该框架在所测试的设施和品种条件下的可行性。

title: Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
summary: We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation. The results can be best seen in our supplemental video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4).
tldr: This paper presents a real-time framework for stylized legged locomotion that disentangles style from functional control via an example-driven diffusion model, enabling independent velocity and style control on simulated and physical humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种实时框架，通过示例驱动的扩散模型解耦风格与功能控制，在仿真和实体人形机器人上实现速度与风格的独立控制。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于表现力丰富的腿部运动的实时框架，能够独立控制速度与风格。与现有的数据驱动控制器通常需要显式风格标签进行训练不同，我们的方法高效利用大规模非结构化运动数据，并能够泛化到未见过的风格。通过一种定制的采样策略，我们将风格与功能性运动解耦，用于训练一个风格编码器，其输出条件化一个自回归扩散模型。在推理阶段，用户提供一个风格参考片段和一个操纵杆速度指令，扩散模型随即生成由强化学习控制器跟踪的运动学参考。为提高用户可控性和风格化强度，我们提出了注意力偏置机制和速度指令修正策略。我们在基于物理的人形角色仿真及实体机器人上验证了该方法，展示了鲁棒的实时控制和连续风格调节能力。详细结果请参见补充视频（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4）。

title: SkipWorld: Latent Skip Planning with Distilled World Models for Efficient Visual Navigation
summary: World-model-based visual navigation enables action planning by predicting future states under candidate trajectories. However, long-horizon rollout remains challenging: models are often trained with ground-truth visual histories but deployed in closed-loop prediction, and evaluating many candidates with step-by-step rollout is computationally expensive. We propose SkipWorld, a latent skip planning framework for efficient visual navigation. SkipWorld introduces three components: (i) Latent AutoRoll, which trains a world model to recursively roll out future states in latent space, reducing the mismatch between training and closed-loop inference; (ii) SkipDistill, which distills the latent autoregressive model into a skip world model that directly predicts long-stride future latent states; and (iii) Skip-then-Refine Planning, a dual-model coarse-to-fine planner that first filters candidate trajectories with the skip model and then reranks selected candidates with the stronger autoregressive model. This design preserves accurate trajectory evaluation while reducing redundant rollout computation. Experiments on RECON, HuRoN, SCAND, and TartanDrive show that, compared with NWM, SkipWorld reduces the average ATE by 4.2% and RPE by 2.7%, while decreasing planning time by 62.4% with a 2.7-fold speedup.
tldr: SkipWorld introduces a latent skip planning framework with distilled world models to efficiently perform visual navigation, reducing planning time by 62.4% while improving accuracy.
tldr_zh: SkipWorld 提出了一种基于蒸馏世界模型的潜在跳跃规划框架，用于高效视觉导航，在提高准确率的同时将规划时间减少 62.4%。
summary_zh: 基于世界模型的视觉导航通过预测候选轨迹下的未来状态来实现动作规划。然而，长时程推演仍面临挑战：模型通常使用真实视觉历史进行训练，却在闭环预测中部署，且逐步推演评估大量候选轨迹的计算成本高昂。我们提出SkipWorld，一种用于高效视觉导航的潜在跳步规划框架。SkipWorld包含三个组件：(i) Latent AutoRoll，训练世界模型在潜在空间中递归推演未来状态，减少训练与闭环推理之间的不匹配；(ii) SkipDistill，将潜在自回归模型蒸馏为跳步世界模型，直接预测大步长的未来潜在状态；(iii) Skip-then-Refine Planning，一种双模型由粗到精的规划器，首先使用跳步模型过滤候选轨迹，然后使用更强的自回归模型对筛选后的候选轨迹进行重排序。该设计在保持轨迹评估准确性的同时，减少了冗余的推演计算。在RECON、HuRoN、SCAND和TartanDrive上的实验表明，与NWM相比，SkipWorld将平均ATE降低了4.2%，RPE降低了2.7%，同时规划时间减少了62.4%，实现了2.7倍的加速。

title: ForeTac: Predictive Contact Guidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Visually similar actions can produce contact loss, jamming, slippage, or irreversible damage, while tactile feedback may arrive after a critical transition. Contact-rich manipulation therefore requires generative policies to anticipate and evaluate whether candidate actions will produce desirable contact outcomes, then adjust action generation before execution. We present ForeTac, a predictive contact-guidance framework organized as a represent-predict-evaluate-guide loop. ForeTac encodes the current tactile state, predicts the tactile consequences of a candidate action sequence, and evaluates the predicted trajectory using a contact-quality objective learned from successful and failed physical interactions. At deployment, its gradient propagates through the tactile predictor to guide action generation while the pretrained model parameters remain frozen. We evaluate ForeTac on four real-robot tasks (planar and curved-surface wiping, card swiping, and fragile-object grasping) with diffusion and flow-matching policies. Across these tasks, ForeTac raises the average task success rate from 36.3% to 71.3% and the average contact success rate (CSR) from 20.0% to 66.3% compared with vision-only Diffusion Policy. Component analyses support the tactile representation and action-conditioned foresight, and show that predicted touch preserves contact-quality ordering. Project page: https://foretac.github.io/.
tldr: ForeTac is a predictive contact-guidance framework that encodes tactile state, predicts tactile consequences of candidate actions, and evaluates them with a learned contact-quality objective to guide generative robot policies, improving task and contact success rates on four real-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: ForeTac 是一个预测性接触引导框架，通过编码触觉状态、预测候选动作的触觉结果，并使用学习的接触质量目标来评估，从而引导生成式机器人策略，在四个真实机器人操作任务上提高了任务和接触成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉上相似的动作可能导致接触丢失、卡阻、滑移或不可逆损伤，而触觉反馈往往在关键状态转变之后才到达。因此，接触丰富的操作任务需要生成式策略，以预测并评估候选动作是否能产生理想的接触结果，并在执行之前调整动作生成。我们提出了ForeTac，一种预测性接触引导框架，其组织为“表征-预测-评估-引导”循环。ForeTac编码当前触觉状态，预测候选动作序列的触觉后果，并利用从成功与失败物理交互中习得的接触质量目标函数来评估预测轨迹。在部署时，其梯度通过触觉预测器传播以引导动作生成，而预训练模型参数保持冻结。我们在四项真实机器人任务（平面与曲面擦拭、卡片滑动以及易碎物体抓取）上评估了ForeTac，并采用扩散策略与流匹配策略。实验结果表明，与仅依赖视觉的扩散策略相比，ForeTac将平均任务成功率从36.3%提升至71.3%，将平均接触成功率（CSR）从20.0%提升至66.3%。组件分析验证了触觉表征与动作条件预测的有效性，并表明预测触觉能够保持接触质量排序。项目页面：https://foretac.github.io/。

title: LynxScenes: A Large-Scale Real-World Benchmark for Outdoor Wheel-Legged Robot Perception, Navigation, Imagination and Reconstruction
summary: Wheel-legged robots operating in outdoor spaces shared with humans require accurate perception, socially compliant navigation, future-scene reasoning, and scene reconstruction. However, existing datasets typically support these capabilities in isolation and rarely provide dense spatial and behavior-level supervision on real wheel-legged platforms. We introduce LynxScenes, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark collected with a LYNX M20 wheel-legged robot. It contains approximately 100K 30-s navigation clips spanning 833.6 h and 3,294.7 km, with 3.0M annotated frames. The synchronized recordings include four fisheye cameras, dual LiDARs, IMU, odometry, and robot states. Annotations comprise 20.82M oriented 3D boxes across 27 categories, 13.89M road-structure annotations, and 20 navigation instructions organized into three layers and aligned with continuous future trajectories. LynxScenes supports four complementary tasks: instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction, BEV-based perception of 3D objects and road structures, future scene prediction, and multi-view scene reconstruction. For trajectory prediction, we further introduce a log-replay-based pseudo-closed-loop evaluator that measures safety, progress, and instruction compliance beyond trajectory imitation. Extensive evaluations across representative navigation, perception, world-model, and reconstruction methods reveal substantial remaining challenges in close-range outdoor robot navigation. The dataset and evaluation toolkit are planned for public release.
tldr: LynxScenes introduces a large-scale real-world benchmark for outdoor wheel-legged robots, comprising 100K navigation clips with multimodal sensor data and annotations for perception, navigation, world modeling, and reconstruction, plus a pseudo-closed-loop evaluator for trajectory prediction.
tldr_zh: LynxScenes 提出了一个大规模户外轮腿机器人真实世界基准，包含 10 万段导航片段及多模态传感器数据和标注，支持感知、导航、世界模型和重建任务，并引入了用于轨迹预测的伪闭环评估器。
summary_zh: 轮腿机器人在与人类共享的户外空间中运行时，需要具备精确的感知能力、符合社会规范的导航能力、未来场景推理能力以及场景重建能力。然而，现有数据集通常仅单独支持上述能力，且很少在真实轮腿平台上提供稠密的空间级和行为级监督。我们提出了LynxScenes，一个基于LYNX M20轮腿机器人采集的大规模真实世界数据集与评测基准。该数据集包含约10万段时长30秒的导航片段，总计833.6小时、3,294.7公里，配有300万帧标注数据。同步记录包含四个鱼眼相机、双激光雷达、惯性测量单元、里程计及机器人状态信息。标注内容包括27个类别的2,082万个定向三维框、1,389万个道路结构标注，以及按三层组织并与连续未来轨迹对齐的20条导航指令。LynxScenes支持四项互补任务：指令条件轨迹预测、基于鸟瞰视角的三维物体与道路结构感知、未来场景预测，以及多视角场景重建。对于轨迹预测，我们进一步引入了一种基于日志回放的伪闭环评估器，可超越轨迹模仿，在安全性、行进进度及指令遵循度方面进行衡量。对代表性导航、感知、世界模型和重建方法的广泛评估揭示了近距离户外机器人导航中仍存在的重大挑战。该数据集及评估工具包计划公开发布。

title: LADDER: A Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Benchmark
summary: General-purpose robot manipulation policies learn short-horizon skills effectively, but degrade rapidly on long-horizon tasks. Existing benchmarks cannot isolate failures because task horizon is either too short or entangled with scene and object variations. We propose LADDER, a long-horizon robot manipulation benchmark scaling from 1 to 10 subgoals within the same environment over three suites (SimplerEnv-Long, RobotArena-$\infty$-Long, and RoboLab-Long), 145 tasks, eight categories, two embodiments, and 2,024 simulated episodes per system. We evaluate two orchestration paradigms: text subgoals for learned low-level policies (VoLo) and tool selection orchestration (CaP-X, GPT-Policy, PSP-Agent, TiPToP). Given the full instruction directly, low-level policies achieve 85.4% on single-subgoal tasks, but drop to near zero on extended tasks. While orchestration remedies this, it remains bounded by physical execution errors of the low-level policy rather than high-level planning and achieves only ~25%. Tool selection orchestration with GPT-Policy on GPT-6 Astra significantly outperforms learned-policy methods, but incurs significant time and cost budget and succeeds only ~62%. Real-world experiments across two embodiments confirm the collapse of the low-level policy and the gain from orchestration. Project website: https://ladder.insait.ai
tldr: LADDER introduces a long-horizon robot manipulation benchmark spanning 1-10 subgoals across 145 tasks, showing that low-level policies collapse on extended tasks while orchestration methods bound performance by physical execution errors.
tldr_zh: LADDER 提出了一个长时程机器人操作基准，涵盖 1-10 个子目标的 145 个任务，表明底层策略在扩展任务上性能崩溃，而编排方法的性能受物理执行误差限制。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人操作策略能够有效学习短时域技能，但在长时域任务上性能迅速退化。现有基准测试无法隔离失败原因，因为任务时域要么过短，要么与场景和物体变化相耦合。我们提出LADDER，一个长时域机器人操作基准，在相同环境中将子目标数量从1扩展到10，涵盖三个套件（SimplerEnv-Long、RobotArena-$\infty$-Long和RoboLab-Long）、145个任务、八种类别、两种本体，以及每个系统2,024个模拟回合。我们评估了两种编排范式：面向学习型底层策略的文本子目标方法（VoLo）和工具选择编排方法（CaP-X、GPT-Policy、PSP-Agent、TiPToP）。在直接给定完整指令的情况下，底层策略在单子目标任务上达到85.4%的成功率，但在扩展任务上降至接近零。虽然编排方法能够缓解这一问题，但其性能仍受限于底层策略的物理执行误差，而非高层规划能力，仅能达到约25%的成功率。基于GPT-6 Astra的GPT-Policy工具选择编排方法显著优于学习型策略方法，但代价是高昂的时间和成本开销，且成功率仅为约62%。跨两种本体的真实世界实验证实了底层策略的性能崩溃以及编排方法带来的收益。项目网站：https://ladder.insait.ai

title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
summary: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail. Project page: https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/
tldr: This paper proposes rectified generative replay (R2-WAM) for data-free continual learning of world action models, using the WAM itself to regenerate past task rollouts and a task-completion evaluator plus action-observation consistency filter to reduce forgetting without access to real training data. It demonstrates over 90% relative forgetting reduction on LIBERO benchmarks and real robot tasks, nearly matching experience replay.
tldr_zh: 本文提出矫正生成回放（R2-WAM），实现世界动作模型的无数据持续学习：利用模型自身自回归生成过往任务轨迹，并通过任务完成评估器与动作-观测一致性过滤减少遗忘，无需访问真实数据。在LIBERO基准和真实机器人任务上，遗忘相对降低90%以上，接近经验回放性能。
summary_zh: 基于预训练视频生成模型构建的世界动作模型（WAMs）能够快速适应新的机器人任务，但在顺序微调过程中会遗忘先前学到的任务。经验回放（ER）通过复现先前任务的数据来缓解此类遗忘，然而在机器人领域，这些数据往往不可获取——策略仅以权重形式部署，其训练数据并不随之共享。在本研究中，我们探讨WAM是否能够通过重新生成自身过往经验来实现无数据持续学习。我们的关键观察是，WAM确实能够自回归地重新生成先前学习任务的完整轨迹，并通过回放这些轨迹来缓解遗忘。然而，回放这类原始生成轨迹的效果仍远不及回放真实数据，我们将此归因于两个问题。首先，WAM无法识别任务完成状态，在任务结束后会持续生成无目的的动作。其次，在开环生成条件下，生成的动作会逐渐偏离生成的观测状态。针对这两个问题，我们提出修正生成回放方法（R$^2$-WAM），该方法通过智能体评估器在任务完成时截断生成的轨迹，并过滤掉动作与观测在物理上不一致的轨迹。在四个LIBERO基准套件和五个真实世界任务上，R$^2$-WAM相较于顺序微调将遗忘降低了90%以上，且在不访问任何先前任务数据的情况下几乎达到了与经验回放相当的性能。我们的进一步分析揭示，WAM中的遗忘主要集中在逆动力学建模上：被遗忘的WAM仍能生成视觉上合理的先前任务观测，但其生成的动作已失效。项目页面：https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/

title: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
summary: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.
tldr: TRACE is a framework for efficiently transferring a pretrained humanoid whole-body controller to a new embodiment by injecting kinematic priors, distilling encoder representations, and using low-rank reinforcement learning with a two-phase curriculum, achieving significant GPU savings and high success on real robots.
tldr_zh: TRACE 是一个将预训练的人形全身控制器高效迁移到新实体的框架，通过注入运动学先验、蒸馏编码器表示并使用两阶段课程的低秩强化学习，在真实机器人上实现了显著的GPU节省和高成功率。
summary_zh: 人类行为基础模型（BFMs）能够实现多样化的全身控制，但由于运动学与动力学失配，将预训练控制器迁移至新本体仍具挑战性。我们提出TRACE，一种高效的跨本体适配框架，在将反馈控制特化到目标机器人的同时，保留预训练运动表征。TRACE首先将运动学先验注入输入和输出投影层，并对齐名义关节动力学，以减小本体失配并支持稳定微调。随后，它将编码器蒸馏与低秩强化学习相结合，在紧凑且经质量筛选的动作集上进行训练，并采用两阶段课程先在建立稳定跟踪，再细化困难动作。我们将TRACE应用于将从宇树G1迁移至宇树H2，使用1000万帧运动数据，在单张RTX PRO 6000 GPU上训练约八小时，其GPU小时成本不足从头训练SONIC的0.1%。在高度缩放跟踪准则下，适配后的控制器在67，953个评估动作上达到96.08%的成功率。真机演示涵盖动态运动跟踪与全身遥操作，所采集的演示数据支持后续视觉-语言-动作策略的后训练。这些结果证明了预训练人形控制器在不同体型与动力学特性的机器人之间进行实际复用的可行性。

title: ReEnvision: Future-Guided Selective Action Repair for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires robust execution over sequences of interdependent actions. Existing methods typically handle execution deviations by replanning the remaining action chunk or correcting actions step by step as new observations arrive. However, a local deviation may affect only a few actions under distribution shift, yet replanning regenerates the entire chunk from an unfamiliar state, potentially introducing errors into otherwise valid actions. Step-wise correction may react too late, as it does not explicitly anticipate how the deviation affects subsequent actions. We propose ReEnvision, a future-guided selective action repair framework that updates a joint future-action belief using execution feedback. It then learns how the resulting belief revision affects each unexecuted action. The resulting belief revision enables selective repair of only the affected actions within a cached action chunk, preserving valid actions and reserving full replanning for severe deviations. On CALVIN, L-CALVIN, and RLBench, ReEnvision achieves 86.6% 5-step success, improves 10-step success from 56% to 63%, and reaches an average success rate of 88.8%, respectively. On five real-world manipulation tasks, it achieves an average success rate of 82.8%. Controlled repair experiments further demonstrate the benefits of localizing affected actions and preserving valid ones during execution.
tldr: ReEnvision introduces a future-guided selective action repair framework for long-horizon manipulation, updating a joint future-action belief with execution feedback to repair only affected actions in a cached action chunk, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on CALVIN, L-CALVIN, RLBench, and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: ReEnvision 提出了一种未来引导的选择性动作修复框架，通过执行反馈更新联合未来动作信念，仅修复缓存动作块中受影响的动作，在 CALVIN、L-CALVIN、RLBench 和真实世界任务上取得了领先的成功率。
summary_zh: 长期机器人操作需要在多个相互依赖的动作序列中实现稳健执行。现有方法通常通过重新规划剩余动作块，或在新观测到达时逐步纠正动作来处理执行偏差。然而，局部偏差可能仅在分布偏移下影响少数动作，而重新规划会从未知状态重新生成整个动作块，可能将错误引入原本有效的动作中。逐步纠正可能反应过迟，因为它未能明确预见偏差对后续动作的影响。我们提出ReEnvision，一种基于未来引导的选择性动作修复框架，利用执行反馈更新联合未来动作信念，并学习由此产生的信念修正对每个未执行动作的影响。所得到的信念修正能够对缓存动作块中仅受影响的动作进行选择性修复，保留有效动作，并将完整重新规划保留用于严重偏差情形。在CALVIN、L-CALVIN和RLBench上，ReEnvision实现了86.6%的5步成功率，将10步成功率从56%提升至63%，并分别达到平均88.8%的成功率。在五项真实世界操作任务中，它实现了82.8%的平均成功率。受控修复实验进一步证明了在执行过程中定位受影响动作并保留有效动作的益处。

title: WoVR+: World Model as Reliable Simulator for Versatile VLA Policy Optimization with RL
summary: Action-conditioned world models can reduce costly real-robot interaction in reinforcement learning for Vision-Language-Action models (VLA-RL), but hallucinations can mislead policy optimization. Extending them to richer VLA interfaces and long-horizon tasks raises challenges in spatiotemporal and cross-modal consistency, exploration-reliability balance in RL, and compounding rollout errors. We present WoVR+, extending WoVR's hallucination-aware WM-RL framework by redesigning the learned environment and imagined interaction protocol: A VLA-interface-aligned world model provides multi-view prediction and proprioceptive updates while mitigating hallucinations. Chunk-wise noise preserves flow-based policy exploration while limiting prediction-degrading action jitter. For long-horizon tasks, stage-local imagined training combines stage-entry resets, stage-specific rewards, local horizons, and controllable sampling to shorten generated prefixes and balance training across stages. WoVR+ improves success over SFT by 21.09% and 16.7% on RoboTwin and 6 real-robot tasks. Long-horizon phone-packaging success rises from 30% to 75%. Videos are available at https://youmo445.github.io/WoVR_Plus.github.io/.
tldr: WoVR+ presents a hallucination-aware world model framework for VLA reinforcement learning, improving policy optimization with chunk-wise noise and stage-local training for long-horizon tasks, demonstrated on RoboTwin and real robots.
tldr_zh: WoVR+提出了一种针对VLA强化学习的幻觉感知世界模型框架，通过分块噪声和阶段局部训练提升策略优化，并在RoboTwin和真实机器人上验证了效果。
summary_zh: 基于动作的条件世界模型可以在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA-RL）的强化学习中减少昂贵的真实机器人交互，但幻觉可能会误导策略优化。将其扩展到更丰富的VLA接口和长期任务中，会在时空一致性、跨模态一致性、强化学习中的探索-可靠性平衡以及复合回滚误差方面带来挑战。我们提出了WoVR+，通过重新设计学习环境和想象交互协议，扩展了WoVR的幻觉感知WM-RL框架：一个与VLA接口对齐的世界模型提供多视角预测和本体感觉更新，同时减轻幻觉。分块噪声在保持基于流的策略探索的同时，限制了导致预测退化的动作抖动。对于长期任务，阶段局部想象训练结合了阶段入口重置、阶段特定奖励、局部视界和可控采样，以缩短生成的前缀并平衡各阶段的训练。WoVR+在RoboTwin和6个真实机器人任务上分别比SFT提高了21.09%和16.7%的成功率。长期手机包装成功率从30%提高到75%。视频可在https://youmo445.github.io/WoVR_Plus.github.io/ 查看。

title: Agentic Robot Creation through Generation, Verification, and Revision
summary: Can an AI agent turn high-level user intent into a functioning robot and teach it how to behave? We study this question from two complementary aspects: embodiment and behavior creation. For embodiment creation, we investigate how well current multimodal models capture mechanical requirements, and introduce computational metrics for evaluating generated designs before fabrication. For behavior creation, we present Roboforge, an agentic framework that turns task specifications into executable policies through motion generation, policy learning, and execution-grounded revision. Given a robot embodiment and task, the agent generates a reference motion, configures the learning objective, and trains a policy. Crucially, motion remains in the loop: rollout feedback can revise the reference motion, reward, or both. We evaluate a generated embodiment across multiple MLLMs and behavior creation across four diverse robots against reward-refinement and one-shot motion baselines. Our computational metrics expose recurring mechanical failures in generated designs, while behavior experiments show that execution-grounded refinement improves task-level behavior and execution quality. Finally, we fabricate an agent-generated Gorilla and directly deploy learned behaviors on the physical robot.
tldr: This paper introduces Roboforge, an agentic framework that generates robot embodiments and executable policies from task specifications, using computational metrics for design evaluation and execution-grounded revision for policy refinement, and demonstrates physical deployment of learned behaviors on a fabricated Gorilla robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Roboforge框架，可根据任务描述自动生成机器人形态和执行策略，利用计算指标评估设计，并通过基于执行的修订优化策略，最终在制造的机器猩猩上实现物理部署。

title: Which Trajectory Is Safer? Combining Rule and Learning for Safety Evaluation
summary: Collision rate remains a dominant metric for evaluating autonomous driving trajectory safety, but its binary nature obscures substantial safety differences among collision-free trajectories. Existing surrogate-safety metrics provide finer-grained assessments, yet often trade off physical interpretability against adaptivity to interaction context. We introduce FutureRisk, a continuous metric that quantifies the latent future risk of a trajectory by how closely and persistently its realized interactions approach unsafe states. At its core, our Context-Adaptive Risk Model (CARM) combines a context-dependent safety-time distribution with an independently supervised critical-event-time distribution. Its safety criterion is bounded around a closed-form physical prior, while a bounded residual provides additional adaptation without abandoning this physical anchor. Experiments on DeepAccident and Bench2Drive show that FutureRisk achieves stronger agreement with native collision labels than existing surrogate-safety measures, discriminates risk among collision-free trajectories, and transfers zero-shot across datasets. Comparisons across four planners further show that FutureRisk reveals safety differences hidden by binary collision outcomes. Together, these results establish FutureRisk as a fine-grained, interpretable, and context-adaptive metric for trajectory safety evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/Xuewen2025/safety-evaluation.
tldr: FutureRisk introduces a continuous, context-adaptive metric for evaluating autonomous driving trajectory safety, combining a physical prior with learned residuals to better discriminate risk among collision-free trajectories.
tldr_zh: FutureRisk 提出了一种用于评估自动驾驶轨迹安全性的连续、上下文自适应指标，结合物理先验与学习残差，以更好地区分无碰撞轨迹之间的风险差异。

title: Beyond the End-Effector: Learning Whole-Arm Contact Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector's task. The robot's kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer's input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io
tldr: This paper introduces WACL, a hierarchical framework for learning whole-arm contact manipulation from a few bare-hand human demonstrations. It uses robot-agnostic semantic representations and a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer to ground contacts on the arm, enabling generalization to new end-effector constraints without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WACL，一种从少量徒手人类演示中学习全身接触操作的分层框架。它利用与机器人无关的语义表示和准静态表面接触优化器将接触定位到手臂上，从而无需重新训练即可泛化到新的末端执行器约束。

title: Beyond Safe Execution: Safe Online Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving with Value Calibration and Adaptive Guidance
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables driving policies to adapt to changing deployment conditions, but requires safe exploration throughout training. Safety filtering alone does not ensure stable policy improvement or reduced dependence on corrections. We propose Safe Online Adaptive Refinement (SOAR-Flow), a framework for safe and stable online fine-tuning of offline-initialized Flow-based driving policies. A control barrier function (CBF)--model predictive control (MPC) filter corrects potentially unsafe actions before execution. To support stable policy updates, we introduce Gaussian-return-aware value calibration based on calibrated Q-learning (Cal-QL), using recorded behavior returns and predicted return variability to smooth conservative critic updates and mitigate policy degradation. Paired corrective learning teaches feasible action adjustments, while an intervention-to-go predictor encourages decisions requiring fewer future corrections. Its predictions also regulate guidance strength, allowing recovery supervision to weaken as predicted dependence decreases. Together with gradually reduced calibration regularization, this supports continued task improvement while preserving hard execution constraints. We analyze conditions for safe execution at control steps and diminishing auxiliary learning influences. We evaluate SOAR-Flow in simulation and on an uncrewed ground vehicle (UGV). The results demonstrate improved driving performance and reduced reliance on safety corrections during protected online fine-tuning. The demonstration video and project overview are available at https://lzqw.github.io/SOAR-Flow/.
tldr: SOAR-Flow introduces a framework for safe online fine-tuning of flow-based driving policies by integrating a CBF-MPC safety filter, Gaussian-return-aware value calibration, and adaptive corrective guidance to improve performance while reducing safety interventions.
tldr_zh: SOAR-Flow 提出了一种用于驾驶策略安全在线微调的框架，结合了 CBF-MPC 安全滤波器、基于高斯回报的价值校准和自适应纠正指导，以提高性能并减少安全干预。

title: DexStitch: Learning and Composing Dexterous Skills from Human Videos via Contact-Aware Robotic Inpainting
summary: A long-horizon manipulation task consists of primitive skills and the transitions connecting them. Learning skills that can be executed in sequence requires supervision for both, which is costly to collect on a robot. Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations, but transferring them to robots requires extracting robot-compatible observations and actions together with their skill structure. We present DexStitch, a framework that cuts long-horizon human videos into skills and transitions, converts them into aligned robot observation-action-skill data, and stitches the learned skills into a requested sequence. A skill classifier first segments the videos into manipulation skills and transitions. DexStitch then converts the human demonstrations into robot observations and actions while retaining their corresponding skill labels. During conversion, per-finger human-object contacts guide dexterous hand retargeting and robotic inpainting, preserving contact geometry and finger-object occlusion ordering. To stitch the learned skills into a sequence, a shared skill-conditioned policy is pretrained on the resulting synthetic data and finetuned on a mixture of synthetic data and a small set of single-skill teleoperation episodes. Conditioning on the current and next skills guides each transition toward the following skill, while predicted skill progression enables closed-loop switching. On a held-out session, the classifier agrees with manual annotations on 92.4% of frames. Across four household skills, DexStitch achieves 80.0% single-skill success and 77.5% sequence success.
tldr: DexStitch segments long-horizon human videos into skills and transitions, converts them into synthetic robot observation-action-skill data using contact-aware dexterous hand retargeting, and trains a shared skill-conditioned policy that achieves high success on both single skills and sequences.
tldr_zh: DexStitch将长程人类视频分割为技能和过渡段，通过接触感知的灵巧手重定向将其转换为机器人观测-动作-技能数据，并训练共享的技能条件策略，在单技能和序列任务上均取得高成功率。

title: I3L: Iterative Interactive Imitation Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
summary: Policies trained offline from teleoperated demonstrations can degrade outside their training distribution. This gap is particularly acute in long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation, where long horizons amplify compounding errors and coordinated arm, torso, and base motion makes exhaustive demonstration coverage impractical. We introduce I3L, an integrated hardware and learning system that combines whole-body correction with iterative policy refinement to address this last-mile reliability gap. Its low-cost, open-source JoyLo+ interface uses policy-tracking leader arms and touch-triggered takeover to enable coordinated corrections across the body parts, while iterative deployment and retraining allow operators to target failures of the updated policy. We evaluate I3L across three robot embodiments and eight simulated and real-world tasks, including four long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation experiments show that four-round HG-DAgger achieves the highest final success on both tasks. Under this protocol, I3L improves autonomous success over the base policies by an average of 68.3 percentage points and achieves at least 90% success on every task, outperforming demonstration-only training by 35.6 percentage points on average with the same number of training trajectories. Averaged across tasks, takeover duration per episode decreases by 72% over four rounds. Together, these results show that I3L helps close the last-mile gap between offline training and reliable deployment and provides practical insights into collecting and using corrections for long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation. Videos, visualizations, and appendix are at https://i-3l.github.io/.
tldr: I3L introduces an integrated hardware and learning system using whole-body corrections and iterative policy refinement (HG-DAgger) to close the last-mile reliability gap in long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation, outperforming demonstration-only training across simulated and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: I3L提出了一种集成硬件和学习系统，通过全身修正和迭代策略优化（HG-DAgger）来弥合长时程全身移动操作中的最后差距，在模拟和真实世界任务中优于仅演示训练。

title: The Human--VLA Communication Gap: What Humans Leave Implicit and What Policies Cannot Recover
summary: A robot may know how to perform a task yet fail when a human asks for it naturally. We study this human--VLA communication gap by separating an \emph{information gap}, where task semantics, grounding, or event structure remain unresolved, from a residual \emph{execution gap}, where even a fully specified task depends on how it is organized and invoked. To do this, we characterize how people naturally express demonstrated objectives and evaluate controlled variants of the same physical tasks, with detailed analysis on $π_{0.5}$ and consistent trends on $π_0$-FAST and Cosmos3-Edge. Our study reveals that humans increasingly compress instructions as tasks grow, relying more on contextual grounding and implicit execution structure. Current policies are misaligned with this behavior: they tolerate grounding dependence relatively well, but struggle when task semantics or event structure must be reconstructed. Even after the information gap is resolved, execution remains sensitive to command granularity and invocation state. These findings identify concrete targets for human-centered policy learning and interfaces that better bridge natural human objectives to robot behavior. Project website: https://commgap.github.io/.
tldr: This paper investigates the gap between natural human instructions and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy execution, identifying information and execution gaps that cause failures even for well-known tasks, and suggesting targets for human-centered policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了自然人类指令与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略执行之间的差距，识别了导致即使是熟悉任务也无法完成的信息差距和执行差距，并为以人为中心的策略学习提出了改进方向。

title: Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning typically treats every demonstration state as equally important, optimizing a behavior-cloning objective uniformly across the dataset. Yet not all states are created equal: in a small number of critical states, even a slight deviation from the expert action can lead to a failure, while in many other states such errors are recoverable and inconsequential. We formalize state criticality in imitation learning as the worst-case degradation in downstream value induced by a bounded perturbation of the expert action at a given state. We then propose SCRIM, a practical State CRIticality Measure that estimates this quantity by training an adversarial disturbance policy and a value critic around a fixed imitation policy. SCRIM assigns each demonstration state a score reflecting how vulnerable the task outcome is to small, policy-relevant action errors. We show that these scores can be used to reweight behavior-cloning losses, improving imitation at consequential states and increasing overall task performance. We further show that SCRIM enables data curation by selecting compact, high-value subsets of demonstrations that preserve performance while substantially reducing the amount of training data. We evaluate SCRIM across various simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, and demonstrate that SCRIM improves policy training, enables efficient data selection, and provides interpretable insights into which moments in a demonstration are most critical for task success. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/
tldr: This paper introduces SCRIM, a state criticality measure for imitation learning that estimates the worst-case degradation in task value from perturbing expert actions, enabling loss reweighting and data curation to improve robotic manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SCRIM，一种用于模仿学习的状态关键性度量方法，通过估计扰动专家动作对任务价值的最坏影响，实现损失重加权和数据筛选，从而提升机器人操作策略的性能。

title: PrT-Flow: Probability-Tractable Flow Matching for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion models and Flow Matching can represent flexible distributions over robot actions, but many reinforcement learning algorithms also require the probability of each action. We introduce PrT-Flow (Probability-Tractable Flow Matching), which computes probability density while retaining multimodal, multi-step action generation. Its Jacobian-Tractable Transformer (JTT) makes each sampling step invertible and enables efficient computation of its Jacobian determinant. We train these finite steps with Conditional Euler-step Training (CET), which supervises their displacement over one step during sampling rather than their instantaneous velocity. We prove that, under certain assumptions, CET has the same minimizers as fitting the Euler-solver updates of Flow Matching. PrT-Flow achieves 96% success on Robomimic Lift after 300 epochs of imitation learning, matching the diffusion policy reference, and 96% success on OGBench Cube-Triple after 600k online steps. These results demonstrate that invertible networks with tractable probability densities can learn effective robot policies and support SAC-style actor-critic training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sunlight-zero/PrT-Flow .
tldr: PrT-Flow introduces a probability-tractable flow matching method with an invertible Jacobian-Tractable Transformer for reinforcement learning, enabling density computation while maintaining multimodal action generation and achieving strong success rates on Robomimic and OGBench benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PrT-Flow 提出了一种具有可逆 Jacobian-Tractable Transformer 的概率可计算流匹配方法，用于强化学习，在保持多模态动作生成的同时计算概率密度，并在 Robomimic 和 OGBench 基准上取得了优异的成功率。
summary_zh: 扩散模型和流匹配能够表示机器人动作上的灵活分布，但许多强化学习算法还需要每个动作的概率。我们提出了PrT-Flow（概率可计算的流匹配），它在保留多模态、多步动作生成能力的同时计算概率密度。其雅可比可计算Transformer（JTT）使每个采样步骤可逆，并能高效计算其雅可比行列式。我们使用条件欧拉步训练（CET）来训练这些有限步，该训练监督采样过程中单步的位移，而非瞬时速度。我们证明，在特定假设下，CET与拟合流匹配的欧拉求解器更新具有相同的最小化器。PrT-Flow在Robomimic Lift上经过300轮模仿学习后达到96%的成功率，与扩散策略基准相当，并在OGBench Cube-Triple上经过60万次在线步骤后达到96%的成功率。这些结果表明，具有可计算概率密度的可逆网络能够学习有效的机器人策略，并支持SAC风格的演员-评论家训练。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Sunlight-zero/PrT-Flow 获取。

title: Acting Through Registers
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) use generative visual representations to condition robot actions, yet how these representations organize action-relevant information remains poorly understood. We identify persistent high-norm spatial outliers in WAM representations and find that their action relevance persists even after normalization and K/V projection attenuate their extreme magnitude. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RegisterWAM, which adds learnable non-spatial registers to the world model and uses them directly for action conditioning. Registers alone do not fully eliminate spatial outliers; pairing them with observation flow-matching (FM) loss supervision suppresses spatial outliers while concentrating high-norm responses in registers. Beyond this reorganization, observation FM loss supervision also improves action learning without registers, motivating an additional noised-observation FM objective that learns current-scene recovery from corrupted inputs. The resulting model achieves 81.64\% success on LIBERO-Plus without additional embodied pretraining data or foundation models, reaches 93.0\% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, and improves real-world manipulation performance.
tldr: This paper introduces RegisterWAM, a World Action Model that uses learnable registers for action conditioning and observation flow-matching loss to suppress spatial outliers, improving action learning and achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RegisterWAM，一种世界动作模型，利用可学习的寄存器进行动作条件化，并通过观测流匹配损失抑制空间异常值，从而改善动作学习，在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作中取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）利用生成式视觉表示来约束机器人动作，然而这些表示如何组织与动作相关的信息仍缺乏深入理解。我们在WAM表示中识别出持续存在的高范数空间离群点，并发现即使归一化和K/V投影削弱了其极端量级，这些离群点的动作相关性依然存在。基于这一观察，我们提出了RegisterWAM，该方法向世界模型添加可学习的非空间寄存器，并将其直接用于动作约束。仅凭寄存器并不能完全消除空间离群点；将其与观测流匹配（FM）损失监督相结合，可抑制空间离群点，同时将高范数响应集中于寄存器中。除了这种重组效应外，观测流匹配损失监督还能在无寄存器的情况下改善动作学习，这促使我们引入了一个额外的带噪声观测流匹配目标，用于从受损输入中学习当前场景恢复。最终模型在LIBERO-Plus上取得了81.64%的成功率，且无需额外的具身预训练数据或基础模型；在RoboTwin 2.0上平均成功率达到93.0%，并提升了真实世界的操作性能。

title: From Pixels to Executable Physics: Behavior-Grounded World Models for Embodied Action Consequence Prediction
summary: In outdoor environments, varying terrain and contact conditions can cause identical action commands to produce different motion outcomes for quadruped robots. Predicting these outcomes is essential for reliable navigation and informed path selection. Existing video world models can generate visually plausible futures, yet often struggle to capture robot dynamics and terrain interactions, leading to overly optimistic predictions of action outcomes. We present DR-WM, a physically consistent world model that incorporates robot-terrain contact dynamics to predict the consequences of quadruped actions. Starting from an initial RGB image, our method reconstructs scene geometry and integrates dense, dimensionless priors over terrain contact properties, calibrated using real-world action-response data. The resulting terrain model supports the simulation of physics with spatially varying contact properties such as friction. Given the initial state of the robot and candidate action sequences, we simulate its future motion and use the resulting camera trajectories and rendered geometry to guide the training of a video world model. The generated future observations are then used to update the terrain reconstruction, enabling iterative model rollouts without additional real-world images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DR-WM substantially outperforms geometry-only baselines and baselines with uniform physical parameters on key physical metrics characterizing action outcomes, while achieving the best performance among the evaluated baselines. These physically grounded predictions support more informed action selection: across 90 challenging scenarios, an 8B vision-language model augmented with DR-WM outperforms an unassisted 32B vision-language model on five of six evaluation metrics.
tldr: DR-WM is a physically consistent world model that reconstructs terrain geometry and contact properties to predict quadruped action outcomes, using rendered trajectories to guide video world model training and improve action selection with VLMs.
tldr_zh: DR-WM 是一种物理一致的世界模型，通过重建地形几何和接触属性来预测四足机器人动作结果，并利用渲染轨迹指导视频世界模型训练，以增强 VLM 的行动选择能力。
summary_zh: 在户外环境中，地形变化与接触条件的差异可能导致四足机器人执行相同动作指令却产生不同的运动结果。预测这些结果对于实现可靠的导航和明智的路径选择至关重要。现有的视频世界模型能够生成视觉上合理的未来帧，但往往难以捕捉机器人动力学与地形交互的细节，导致对动作结果的预测过于乐观。我们提出DR-WM，一种物理一致的世界模型，它融合了机器人-地形接触动力学，用以预测四足动作的后果。该方法从初始RGB图像出发，重建场景几何，并整合基于真实世界动作-响应数据校准的、密集的无量纲地形接触属性先验。由此生成的地形模型支持对具有空间变化接触属性（如摩擦力）的物理仿真。给定机器人初始状态和候选动作序列，我们仿真其未来运动，并利用由此产生的相机轨迹和渲染几何指导视频世界模型的训练。随后，生成的未来观测用于更新地形重建，从而在不需额外真实图像的情况下实现迭代模型展开。大量实验表明，DR-WM在表征动作结果的关键物理指标上显著优于仅基于几何的基线和采用均匀物理参数的基线，并在所有评估基线中取得最佳性能。这些物理基础扎实的预测支持更明智的动作选择：在90个具有挑战性的场景中，结合DR-WM的8B视觉-语言模型在六项评估指标中有五项优于未辅助的32B视觉-语言模型。

title: Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos
summary: Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.
tldr: This paper introduces a single-pass framework that predicts dense physical fields from multi-view deformation videos to estimate material parameters for deformable-object manipulation, achieving fast inference and improved accuracy over optimization-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种单次前向框架，通过多视角形变视频预测密集物理场来估计可变形物体操作的材料参数，相比基于优化的方法实现了快速推断和更高的准确性。
summary_zh: 估算可用于仿真的材料参数，对于可变形物体的操控至关重要，但也颇具挑战性，因为材料属性仅能通过物理响应间接体现。我们提出了一种基于物理场桥接的材料推断方法，这是一种单次前馈框架，利用密集的物理响应将多视角RGB形变视频与材料本构类型分类及连续参数回归相连接。与需要逐场景重建、在线调参或仿真在环优化的逆物理方法不同，我们的模型首先预测力/接触掩膜、投影运动流场和投影应力响应图，再基于这些物理场进行材料推断，从而减少对外观或类别捷径的依赖。我们构建了DeformFieldBench，一个包含3DGS MPM学习环境的基准数据集，涵盖100种物体形状和五种具有力学信息加载模式下的5000组仿真，并提供密集的像素对齐物理监督。我们的方法在所有四个连续参数上取得了最优中位误差，将应力热点召回率从0.0762提升至0.5121，并在对未见物体的同仿真器回放中达到0.8676的SSIM和36.82 dB的PSNR。在与协议匹配的GSO评估中，推断和未来状态预测约需30秒，而逐场景优化则需要15至120分钟。该方法在五个真实世界序列中也展现出可测量的回放一致性。上述结果表明，密集物理场可作为实现快速材料推断的有效桥梁，同时跨仿真器和真实世界测试也揭示了当前仍存在的领域差距与可辨识性问题。

title: TacSpin: Tactile Tracking of In-Gripper Object Rotation on SO(3) via Axis-Magnitude Estimation
summary: Tracking object motion within a gripper provides essential feedback for robotic manipulation. However, limited contact coverage and uneven deformation make tactile estimation challenging. In this study, we present TacSpin, a method that tracks in-gripper object rotation on SO(3) using only two vision-based tactile sensors. The key idea is to estimate the axis and magnitude of the rotation response separately, rather than fitting a rigid-body model by least squares. Each finger's response is further refined with contact-boundary cues. The two fingers are then fused according to their agreement. On standard objects, TacSpin achieves lower mean checkpoint errors. Qualitative demonstrations on real-world objects, using calibration transferred from a standard sphere, illustrate tracking under different contact geometries.
tldr: TacSpin uses two vision-based tactile sensors to estimate in-gripper object rotation on SO(3) by separately estimating the axis and magnitude of rotation, refining with contact-boundary cues, and fusing responses from two fingers.
tldr_zh: TacSpin 利用两个基于视觉的触觉传感器，通过分别估计旋转轴和旋转幅度，并结合接触边界线索和双指融合，实现对夹爪内物体旋转的 SO(3) 跟踪。
summary_zh: 在夹持器内跟踪物体运动，为机器人操作提供了关键反馈。然而，有限的接触覆盖范围和不均匀的形变使得基于触觉的估计颇具挑战性。本研究提出了一种名为TacSpin的方法，该方法仅利用两个基于视觉的触觉传感器，即可在SO(3)上跟踪夹持器内物体的旋转。其核心思想是分别估计旋转响应的轴和大小，而非通过最小二乘法拟合刚体模型。每个手指的响应进一步利用接触边界线索进行细化。随后，根据两个手指的一致性进行融合。在标准物体上，TacSpin实现了更低的平均检查点误差。在真实世界物体上的定性演示，利用了从标准球体迁移而来的标定，展示了不同接触几何条件下的跟踪效果。

title: EgoCPT: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Ego-Centric Video with Contact-Aware Optimization
summary: While expert demonstrations on real robots are difficult to collect, human ego-centric videos are easy to collect and abundant on the internet. However, learning dexterous manipulation policies from human videos remains challenging---one of the most important challenges being the difficulty of reconstructing physically grounded robot trajectories due to the large embodiment gap. In this paper, we propose EgoCPT, a novel paradigm for learning high-quality retargeted dexterous hand trajectories directly from an ego-centric video, which can then be deployed directly on real robots. The only inputs to our method are an ego-centric RGB video and a reference hand pose trajectory, which can be easily obtained through off-the-shelf software or specialized cameras during recording. Our method is particularly robust to noisy hand poses attributed to our novel contact-aware optimization framework, which iteratively optimizes the contact points between the robot hands and objects. Across five manipulation tasks, our method achieves overall success rates of 67.3% on noisy EgoDex hand-pose reconstructions and 92.0% on high-quality TACO reconstructions collected using motion-capture hardware, outperforming multiple baselines on both benchmarks.
tldr: EgoCPT learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single ego-centric human video by using a contact-aware optimization framework to retarget noisy hand poses into physically grounded robot trajectories, achieving high success rates on real-robot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EgoCPT 通过接触感知优化框架，从单段第一视角人类视频中学习灵巧操作策略，将嘈杂的手部姿态重定向为物理可行的机器人轨迹，在真实机器人基准上取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 虽然从真实机器人上收集专家演示数据较为困难，但人类自我中心的视频易于获取且在互联网上数量丰富。然而，从人类视频中学习灵巧操作策略仍然面临挑战——其中最重要的挑战之一在于，由于具身差异较大，难以重建具有物理基础的机器人轨迹。在本文中，我们提出了EgoCPT，一种新颖的范式，能够直接从自我中心视频中学习高质量的重定向灵巧手轨迹，并可直接部署于真实机器人上。我们方法的唯一输入是一段自我中心RGB视频和一条参考手部姿态轨迹，这些可通过现成软件或录制过程中的专用摄像头轻松获取。我们的方法对手部姿态噪声具有较强鲁棒性，这得益于我们新颖的接触感知优化框架，该框架迭代优化机器手与物体之间的接触点。在五项操作任务中，我们的方法在带有噪声的EgoDex手部姿态重建上实现了67.3%的总体成功率，在通过动作捕捉硬件收集的高质量TACO重建上实现了92.0%的成功率，在两个基准测试中均优于多个基线方法。

title: Box-WAM: Box Trajectories as Compact State Representations for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) are a category of policy models that ex- plicitly predict both actions and future world states. They have been shown to outperform action-only models across various robotic manipulation tasks. How- ever, representing the future with full-frame video prediction can be computation- ally expensive during both training and inference. This raises a central question: what compact state representation preserves the planning and supervision bene- fits of future prediction? In this paper, we propose BoxWAM, which replaces dense future frames with oriented bounding box trajectories of task-relevant ob- jects. By explicitly imagining object-centric future motion, our method provides a lightweight prediction target that captures the key physical changes induced by robot actions. We show that box trajectory prediction substantially reduces com- putational cost while improving action prediction performance, suggesting that object-centric compact states can serve as an efficient alternative to video-based world action modeling for robotic manipulation. Result videos can be found on https://box-wam.github.io
tldr: Box-WAM introduces oriented bounding box trajectories of task-relevant objects as compact state representations for world action models, reducing computational cost while improving action prediction performance in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: Box-WAM 提出使用任务相关对象的定向边界框轨迹作为世界动作模型的紧凑状态表示，在降低计算成本的同时提高了机器人操作中的动作预测性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）是一类能够显式预测动作及未来世界状态的策略模型。研究表明，在多种机器人操作任务中，该类模型优于仅预测动作的模型。然而，使用全帧视频预测来表示未来状态，在训练和推理过程中均会带来较高的计算成本。这引出了一个核心问题：何种紧凑状态表示既能保留未来预测所带来的规划与监督优势？本文提出BoxWAM，以任务相关物体的有向包围盒轨迹替代稠密的未来帧。通过显式想象以物体为中心的未来运动，我们的方法提供了一种轻量级的预测目标，能够捕捉机器人动作所引发的关键物理变化。实验表明，盒轨迹预测在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了动作预测性能，这表明以物体为中心的紧凑状态可作为机器人操作中基于视频的世界动作建模的高效替代方案。结果视频可在 https://box-wam.github.io 查看。

title: YUBI-Real2Sim: 3DGS Scene Verification for Reliable Policy Evaluation
summary: Evaluating VLA policies on real robots is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce, making real-to-sim simulation essential for scalable evaluation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables rapid real-to-sim scene generation, the reconstruction quality required for reliable policy evaluation remains unquantified. In particular, policies relying on wrist-mounted fisheye cameras (e.g., YUBI handheld gripper data) are heavily exposed to visual artifacts (holes, floaters) in wide-angle views, directly degrading task performance. To address this, we present YUBI-Real2Sim, a unified framework for 3DGS-based scene reconstruction and real-to-sim policy evaluation under dual fisheye wrist views. We develop an integrated pipeline combining 200-degree fisheye camera capture, 3DGS training, 3D foundation models for object modeling, and MuJoCo-based physical simulation, reproducing the observed real-world policy ordering in eight of nine scene-task comparisons. Using this framework, we construct a benchmark across two bimanual robot platforms, three scenes, three tasks, and dual pi0.5-based policies. This systematically measures real-to-sim rank agreement and evaluates policy sensitivity against counterfactual 3DGS artifacts (ceiling holes, floaters, warping) and capture disturbances. We further analyze whether novel-view quality scores can indicate policy-ranking reliability under a scene-held-out evaluation protocol. The results show task-dependent performance and limitations of quality-based reliability prediction, highlighting the need to assess reconstruction quality when using Real2Sim for policy evaluation. These results do not yet establish a generally reliable scene-acceptance rule. Project Page: https://yubi-real2sim.airoa.io.
tldr: YUBI-Real2Sim introduces a 3DGS-based real-to-sim framework with dual fisheye wrist cameras for reliable VLA policy evaluation, quantifying the impact of reconstruction artifacts and proposing a benchmark across bimanual robots and tasks.
tldr_zh: YUBI-Real2Sim提出了一个基于3DGS的双鱼眼腕部相机实到仿真框架，用于评估VLA策略，量化重建伪影的影响，并构建了双手机器人基准。
summary_zh: 评估视觉语言动作（VLA）策略在真实机器人上的表现成本高昂、耗时且难以复现，这使得“真实到仿真”（real-to-sim）的模拟方法对于可扩展评估至关重要。尽管3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术能够快速生成真实到仿真的场景，但可靠策略评估所需的场景重建质量尚未得到量化。尤其是依赖腕部鱼眼相机（如YUBI手持夹爪数据）的策略，在广角视角下极易受到视觉伪影（如空洞、漂浮物）的影响，从而直接降低任务性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了YUBI-Real2Sim，一个基于3DGS的统一框架，用于在双鱼眼腕部视角下进行场景重建和真实到仿真的策略评估。我们开发了一套集成流程，涵盖200度鱼眼相机采集、3DGS训练、基于3D基础模型的目标建模以及基于MuJoCo的物理仿真，在九个场景-任务对比中成功复现了观察到的真实世界策略排序（八项一致）。利用该框架，我们构建了一个跨两个双臂机器人平台、三个场景、三个任务及基于pi0.5的双策略评估基准。该基准系统地衡量了真实到仿真的排序一致性，并针对反事实3DGS伪影（如天花板空洞、漂浮物、形变）及采集扰动评估了策略敏感性。我们进一步分析了在新场景留出评估协议下，新视角质量评分能否作为策略排序可靠性的指示指标。结果表明，性能具有任务依赖性，且基于质量的可靠性预测存在局限性，这凸显了在使用Real2Sim进行策略评估时，评估重建质量的必要性。目前的结果尚未确立普遍适用的场景接受准则。项目主页：https://yubi-real2sim.airoa.io。

title: Can a Frontier VLM Serve as a Robot Policy for Memory-Dependent Manipulation?
summary: We use a frozen frontier vision-language model, GPT-6-Astra, directly as the robot policy on RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 memory-dependent manipulation tasks spanning temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory. The model keeps the whole episode in context and outputs every end-effector waypoint and gripper command, with no RoboMME-specific training. On the 800 test episodes it succeeds in 92.1%, above the previously reported human score of 90.5%, which was obtained with an oracle skill interface, and far ahead of the best leaderboard entry (60.8%) and of a hierarchical system that pairs the same model with a RoboMME-trained policy (79.1%). It matches or exceeds the human score on 13 of the 16 tasks. Its 63 failures concentrate in two tasks and are mostly premature completions and mistimed or unintended button presses. These results blur the usual division between long-horizon planning, memory and end-effector control, and raise the question of how much of this stack a single general-purpose model can take over in embodied systems. Project website: https://embodied-astra.github.io. Code, prompts and all episode logs: https://github.com/jackbjed/embodied-astra-robomme.
tldr: A frozen frontier VLM, GPT-6-Astra, is used directly as a robot policy for 16 memory-dependent manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art success (92.1%) without any task-specific training, matching or exceeding human performance on most tasks.
tldr_zh: 将冻结的尖端视觉语言模型 GPT-6-Astra 直接作为机器人策略，用于16项记忆依赖的操作任务，无需特定训练即取得92.1%的成功率，在多数任务上匹配或超越人类表现。
summary_zh: 我们直接采用冻结前沿视觉-语言模型GPT-6-Astra作为机器人策略，应用于RoboMME基准测试，该基准包含16项依赖记忆的操作任务，涵盖时间记忆、空间记忆、物体记忆和程序记忆。该模型将整个情节保持在上下文中，并输出每个末端执行器路点及夹爪指令，且无需针对RoboMME进行专门训练。在800个测试情节中，其成功率达到92.1%，高于此前报道的通过神谕技能接口获得的人类得分90.5%，远超排行榜最佳成绩（60.8%），也优于将同一模型与RoboMME训练策略配对的分层系统（79.1%）。在16项任务中，该模型在13项上达到或超过人类得分。其63次失败集中于两项任务，主要是过早完成以及按钮按下的时机不当或误触。这些结果模糊了长期规划、记忆和末端执行器控制之间的传统界限，并引发了一个问题：在具身系统中，一个通用模型能够接管该技术栈中的多大比例。项目网站：https://embodied-astra.github.io。代码、提示词及所有情节日志：https://github.com/jackbjed/embodied-astra-robomme。

title: Phase-Conditioned Affordance Fields for SE(3)-Equivariant Visuomotor Policies
summary: SE(3)-equivariance provides a useful geometric inductive bias for visuomotor policies, encoding that actions covary with rigid transformations of the observation. However, existing SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies build this bias on a global equivariance assumption that treats the entire observation as governed by a single rigid transformation, which breaks down in real-world manipulation tasks where the task-relevant region changes across different objects. We address this by learning a phase-conditioned affordance field (PAF) over the observed point cloud, a per-point score that the SE(3)-equivariant policy uses in two complementary ways. Its score-weighted centroid serves as a learned, phase-conditioned anchor that canonicalizes the observation and the action around the active region, replacing the fixed gripper-frame reference, and the score itself is appended as a per-point feature. This introduces a local geometric inductive bias, while preserving the policy's global SE(3) equivariance. We validate on multiple MimicGen tasks under varying spatial randomization, and PAF consistently improves the success rate of the underlying policy. On multi-object real-robot tasks, PAF outperforms baselines and keeps its lead under lighting variations.
tldr: This paper introduces Phase-Conditioned Affordance Fields (PAF), which learn per-point affordance scores to anchor SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies around task-relevant regions, improving manipulation success across varying spatial randomizations and real-robot multi-object tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了相位条件化可供性场（PAF），通过学习逐点可供性分数将SE(3)等变视觉运动策略锚定到任务相关区域，在多种空间随机化和真实机器人多物体任务中提高了操作成功率。
summary_zh: SE(3)-等变性为视觉运动策略提供了一种有用的几何归纳偏置，编码了动作随观察的刚体变换而协同变化的特性。然而，现有的SE(3)-等变视觉运动策略将这种偏置建立在全局等变性假设之上，该假设将整个观察视为由单一刚体变换支配，这在真实世界的操作任务中会失效，因为任务相关区域在不同物体之间会发生变化。我们通过在学习到的点云上引入相位条件化可供性场（PAF）来解决这一问题，该场为每个点提供一个得分，SE(3)-等变策略以两种互补方式使用该得分。其得分加权质心作为一个学习得到的、相位条件化的锚点，用于围绕活动区域对观察和动作进行规范化，取代固定的夹爪框架参考，同时该得分本身也被附加为逐点特征。这引入了一种局部几何归纳偏置，同时保留了策略的全局SE(3)等变性。我们在多种空间随机化条件下的多个MimicGen任务上进行了验证，PAF持续提高了底层策略的成功率。在多物体真实机器人任务中，PAF优于基线方法，并在光照变化下保持其领先优势。

title: LiDAR-based Humanoid Navigation in Dynamic, Non-Convex Environments via Spatio-Temporal Safe Corridors
summary: Navigating humanoid robots through dynamic, non-convex environments requires tightly coupling onboard perception with footstep planning and dynamic locomotion control. Existing methods frequently discard complex free space through simplified convex obstacle bounds and fail to account for real-time dynamic occupancy predictions. This paper presents a real-time framework for humanoid navigation that directly constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors from LiDAR-based particle representations and couples them with Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based planning and Whole Body Control (WBC) to enable navigation around and within moving non-convex structures without restrictive geometric assumptions. Simulations on the Digit humanoid yield a 96% success rate in navigating around and inside moving non-convex obstacles in a 24 by 24 m^2 arena. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed iterative polytope generation significantly outperforms single-iteration baselines in narrow corridors, while evaluations demonstrate robustness to clutter, sensor noise, control delays, and force perturbations.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time LiDAR-based navigation framework for humanoid robots that constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors to handle dynamic, non-convex obstacles, achieving high success in simulations with the Digit humanoid.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LiDAR的人形机器人实时导航框架，通过构建时空安全走廊来处理动态非凸障碍物，在Digit人形机器人仿真中实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 在动态、非凸环境中导航类人机器人，需要将机载感知与落脚点规划和动态运动控制紧密耦合。现有方法常通过简化的凸障碍边界丢弃复杂的自由空间，且未能考虑实时动态占用预测。本文提出一种实时类人导航框架，直接从基于激光雷达的粒子表示构建时空安全走廊，并将其与基于线性倒立摆（LIP）的规划及全身控制（WBC）相结合，从而在无需严格几何假设的情况下，实现绕行及穿越移动的非凸结构。在Digit类人机器人上的仿真实验中，该框架在24米×24米的区域内绕行及穿越移动非凸障碍的成功率达到96%。消融研究证实，在狭窄走廊中，所提出的迭代多面体生成方法显著优于单次迭代基线方法；同时，评估结果表明该方法对杂乱环境、传感器噪声、控制延迟及外力扰动具有鲁棒性。

title: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
summary: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.
tldr: ABot-ER introduces a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that jointly masters perception, planning, and execution via an agentic data-model co-evolution engine and task-conditioned low-rank residual adaptation, achieving state-of-the-art results across twelve benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ABot-ER提出一个统一的具身推理基础模型，通过智能体数据-模型协同进化引擎和任务条件低秩残差适配，在感知、规划与执行三大能力上实现SOTA性能。
summary_zh: 我们推出ABot具身推理（ABot-ER），一个统一的具身推理基础模型，打破了具身推理中广度与深度之间的张力。具身智能要求对感知、规划和执行三者的联合掌握，然而在这一范围内调和通用性与专精性仍然是一个开放挑战。在单一统一模型中，ABot-ER在全部三种能力上拥有专家级深度，涵盖感知中的空间、场景和时间推理；规划中的长时程行动组织；以及执行中的点定位与可供性。智能体数据-模型自进化引擎持续根据模型不断变化的能力状态调整数据策略。任务条件自适应训练策略利用任务令牌在共享骨干网络上激活轻量级低秩残差，将更新与异构输出格式分离，同时保留共享的具身知识。在对涵盖三种核心能力和五个能力维度的十二个基准系统评估中，ABot-ER在统一参数框架内，于感知、规划和执行方面均取得整体最先进的性能，表明在统一具身推理中广度与深度可以共存。

title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.
tldr: This paper introduces LongForcing, a distillation method that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts for autoregressive video diffusion world models, reducing drift and improving long-horizon rollout quality in text-to-video and action-conditioned interactive generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LongForcing，一种将教师监督扩展到学生自回归长序列推演的知识蒸馏方法，用于视频扩散世界模型，通过延长监督视野减少漂移，提升文本到视频及动作条件交互生成的长时间稳定性。
summary_zh: 自回归视频扩散模型已成为长视野世界推演的基础架构。然而，当这些模型被扩展至远超其训练窗口的时长时，会出现渐进式漂移：视觉质量退化、运动变得不连贯、物体身份在生成帧被递归用作上下文的过程中逐渐崩塌。我们研究了监督视野差距：短视野蒸馏使得后续推演状态缺乏直接监督。我们证明，匹配短窗口边际分布并不必然决定长视野行为，而更长的在线策略轨迹则会延迟揭示训练中的失败。这促使我们在长视野世界模型中实施大规模时间流形匹配。基于这一洞察，我们提出了LongForcing，一种将教师监督扩展到学生长自推演过程的蒸馏方法。LongForcing保留了短视野教师强迫和因果常微分方程蒸馏阶段，同时在最终分布匹配阶段将实际分数教师替换为扩展视野的双向教师。该长视野教师利用标准分布匹配公式对学生扩展自推演过程进行监督，无需修改学生架构或增加推理成本。我们在文本到视频生成和交互式动作条件世界模型上评估了LongForcing，取得了85.52的VBench质量得分，并在第一人称消融实验中将WorldRoamBench 60秒动作得分提升了23.9分。定性压力测试进一步采样了长达24小时的交互式推演，远超训练视野。这些结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督规模是迈向长视野世界模型的务实一步。项目网站和代码见https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing。

title: FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.
tldr: FlowSim proposes a rendering-free closed-loop simulation method that directly predicts latent representations for end-to-end driving evaluation, eliminating image-space rendering and re-encoding, and improving speed and efficiency while preserving downstream behavior.
tldr_zh: FlowSim提出了一种无渲染的闭环仿真方法，直接预测端到端驾驶系统的潜在表示，免去图像空间渲染和重新编码，提升速度与效率，同时保持下游行为一致性。
