summary_zh: 闭环评估端到端（E2E）驾驶系统通常依赖于生成传感器观测数据，并通过感知编码器对其进行再处理，这带来了大量的计算开销，以及模拟与真实传感器观测之间的仿真到现实差距。本文提出了一个更为根本的问题：在端到端驾驶系统的闭环评估中，图像空间仿真是否必要？我们提出FlowSim，一种免渲染的仿真范式，直接从先前的潜在表示和目标帧符号化场景条件预测内部潜在表示。随后，预测得到的潜在表示由原始冻结的下游模块处理，从而消除了图像渲染和感知重编码。显式的跨帧代理关联提升了潜在状态转移预测和滚动稳定性，而可变时域仿真则能够在共享的真实锚点基础上进行长期预测，而无需累积中间滚动误差。在nuScenes和NavSim上的实验表明，FlowSim在下游行为上与图像空间仿真相当，且在源到参考的一致性方面，在多种仿真时域及稠密和稀疏潜在表示下通常优于图像空间仿真。通过直接预测潜在表示，FlowSim的两种实例在每一步仅需0.04至0.06秒完成仿真，远快于与其比较的图像空间仿真方法。这些结果确立了FlowSim作为传统图像空间仿真方法的一种高效且实用的替代方案。

title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
summary: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.
tldr: EgoExplorer introduces a 100-hour wearable vision-motion-touch dataset of human loco-manipulation with a Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline to reconstruct whole-body motion, finger articulation, and tactile signals, enabling multimodal generation and humanoid retargeting in simulation.
tldr_zh: EgoExplorer 提出了一个100小时的可穿戴视觉-运动-触觉人体移动操作数据集，并开发了校准-完善-约束流程以重建全身运动、手指关节和触觉信号，支持多模态生成和仿真中的人形机器人重定向。
summary_zh: 从人类演示中学习人形机器人全身操控，其核心在于观察运动、姿态与物体交互在任务推进过程中如何协同演化。为在不同环境中大规模采集数据，轻量化、可穿戴的采集系统成为优选方案。然而，现有数据集仅能提供这种协同关系的局部视角。为此，我们提出EgoExplorer——一个基于可穿戴系统构建的、包含100小时视觉-运动-触觉观测数据的人形全身操控观测库。该数据集聚焦专业活动场景，其连续录制将第一人称视角视频与重建的全身运动、精细手指关节运动及触觉观测对齐，并配有步级描述。为在稀疏身体传感条件下实现上述覆盖，我们开发了“标定-补全-约束”流水线。具体而言，可复用的标定步骤在运动推断前固定受试者几何参数与传感器安装位置，从而将安装偏移与关节运动解耦；随后，时间先验用于补全未观测到的关节运动；分层约束则促进测量一致性、时间连续性与几何一致性——这些属性仅靠运动合理性无法保证。与基于追踪器拟合的参考数据相比，该方法将身体点误差相对于最强基线降低了71.9%；匹配评估还显示手部稳定性与接触估计均有提升。初步研究探索了多模态生成与条件控制，以及结合全身控制的人形机器人重定向仿真。

title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence
summary: Coding agents can construct executable programs and revise them through feedback, offering a foundation for embodied control without target-task fine-tuning. Through a programmatic robot interface, the agent observes the scene, executes control programs, and adapts them to the resulting physical state, serving as the closed-loop policy. However, this within-episode adaptation does not automatically preserve experience across scenes. Our trajectory analysis shows that agents spend interaction and inference budgets establishing effective operations and identifying their preconditions, while fresh agents cannot reuse these discoveries. This motivates EmbodiedEvo, a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons. Experience is acquired on one Playground scene per task, then frozen for independent agents in unseen scenes, without updating model weights. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.
tldr: EmbodiedEvo introduces a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable Skills and Lessons, enabling closed-loop embodied control without fine-tuning and achieving state-of-the-art scores on RoboDojo-Sim.
tldr_zh: EmbodiedEvo 提出了一种自进化编码智能体，将物理反馈提炼为可复用的技能和经验教训，无需微调即可实现闭环具身控制，并在 RoboDojo-Sim 上取得了领先成绩。
summary_zh: 编码智能体能够构建可执行程序，并通过反馈对其进行修正，从而无需针对目标任务进行微调即可实现具身控制的基础。通过程序化机器人接口，智能体观察场景、执行控制程序，并根据由此产生的物理状态对其进行调整，充当闭环策略。然而，这种回合内自适应并不能自动跨场景保留经验。我们的轨迹分析表明，智能体会耗费交互与推理预算来建立有效操作并识别其前置条件，而新启动的智能体无法复用这些发现。这促使我们提出EmbodiedEvo——一种自我进化的编码智能体，它将物理反馈提炼为可复用的代码技能（Skills）和诊断性经验（Lessons）。经验在每个任务的一个Playground场景中获取，随后被冻结，供未见场景中的独立智能体使用，而无需更新模型权重。在RoboDojo-Sim上，EmbodiedEvo取得了44.48的平均得分和37.82%的成功率，超越了所有官方验证结果。配对测试显示，在依赖记忆的任务上增益最大，协调程序得到了成功复用，而精细接触控制仍然困难。来自更强模型的经验也能提升较弱执行器的表现：Astra的经验使Sol和Luna的成功率分别比无经验时提升了8.86和5.50个百分点。与原始交互历史相比，技能与经验在任务性能相当的情况下，执行成本降低了53.0%。

title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (L0-L5) for Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), where robots use physical experience to improve both their capabilities and their improvement procedures. It surveys existing methods and identifies research gaps, concluding that no current method fully achieves Physical RSI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了物理递归自我改进（Physical RSI）的L0-L5框架，其中机器人利用物理经验来改进其能力和改进流程。文章综述了现有方法并指出了研究空白，结论是当前没有方法完全实现Physical RSI。
summary_zh: 机器人执行任务的自主性日益增强，但其改进仍主要依赖人类驱动。本研究探讨了物理递归自我改进（Physical RSI），即通过物理经验引导机器人能力及其改进程序的持久更新，从而使后续改进在不同任务中更加有效。物理RSI面临噪声观测、连续动力学、高代价试验及不可逆后果等挑战。我们提出了一个L0-L5框架，用以区分能力层与元层的更新，以及任务内与跨任务的收益，其中L5专指经独立验证的递归收益。我们考察了现有方法，涵盖自适应机制调整与模型训练，以及控制执行和连续更新的安全与控制机制。分析表明，尽管自我改进已取得显著进展，但所调查的文献尚未展示符合我们框架定义的物理RSI。我们确定了可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保障和基准测试方面的研究重点，勾勒出一条使机器人能够自主改进学习方式并同时确保安全性的路径。物理RSI的GitHub代码库可在 https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI 获取。

title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
summary: It has been difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to quickly create and iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io
tldr: RoboSimStudio is an interactive toolkit that enables humans and coding agents to rapidly create and refine real2sim simulations of robot manipulation tasks by making physics solver and contact model choices explicit and editable.
tldr_zh: RoboSimStudio 是一个交互式工具包，通过使物理求解器和接触模型的选择显式且可编辑，帮助人类和编码代理快速创建并迭代优化机器人操作任务的真实到仿真模拟。
summary_zh: 对机器人与其所操控物体之间相互作用的物理过程进行精确建模一直颇具挑战，这涉及接触力学、耦合接触动力学、变形、刚度及摩擦等方面。我们提出了RoboSimStudio（RSS），一个交互式工具包，它将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择明确化并可编辑，使人类用户和编码智能体都能基于观察到的物理行为快速创建并迭代优化仿真。我们利用开源的Newton物理仿真系统实现了RSS，并描述了在人类引导下的real2sim实验，涵盖（1）视觉评估、（2）力反馈和（3）智能体驱动的Real2Sim2Real。代码、视频及更多信息可在项目网站获取：https://robosimstudio.github.io

title: RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories
summary: Evaluating robot policies before deployment typically requires producing new trajectories through real-world execution, simulators, or learned world models. These rollout-based approaches impose infrastructure requirements; simulator and world-model evaluators additionally face prediction errors that can compound over the evaluation horizon. In this paper, we study off-policy evaluation as an alternative to rollout-based robot-policy evaluation methods. Specifically, we introduce RoboFQE, an evaluator that estimates the discounted expected return of a target policy from offline robot trajectories without estimating a behavior-policy density, combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model and learned terminal success annotation to bridge the gap between standard OPE benchmarks and continuous-control visual manipulation. Controlled experiments across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoboFQE produces accurate discounted-return estimates and preserves policy rankings even on long-horizon manipulation tasks where video world-model evaluators are degraded by autoregressive prediction errors. Ablation experiments show that pretrained vision encoders substantially outperform from-scratch alternatives, particularly on long-horizon tasks, and that learned terminal success annotation enables evaluation without ground-truth reward labels with only slight reduction of accuracy.
tldr: RoboFQE introduces a rollout-free evaluator for visual robot policies that estimates discounted returns from offline trajectories using fitted Q-evaluation, a pretrained vision foundation model, and learned terminal success annotation, avoiding simulator/world-model prediction errors.
tldr_zh: RoboFQE提出了一种无部署的视觉机器人策略评估方法，利用离线轨迹、拟合Q评估、预训练视觉基础模型和学习到的终端成功标注来估计折扣回报，避免了模拟器或世界模型的预测误差。
summary_zh: 在部署机器人策略之前进行评估，通常需要借助真实环境执行、仿真器或学习得到的世界模型来生成新的轨迹。这类基于轨迹展开的方法对基础设施提出了较高要求；同时，仿真器和世界模型评估器还面临预测误差在评估时间跨度内累积放大的问题。在本文中，我们研究将离线策略评估作为基于轨迹展开的机器人策略评估方法的一种替代方案。具体而言，我们提出了RoboFQE评估器，它能够从离线机器人轨迹中估计目标策略的折扣期望回报，且无需估计行为策略的密度。该方法将拟合Q评估与预训练的视觉基础模型以及学习得到的终端成功标注相结合，以弥合标准离线策略评估基准与连续控制视觉操作任务之间的差距。在仿真和真实世界操作任务的受控实验中，RoboFQE表现出能够生成准确的折扣回报估计，并在长时程操作任务中保持策略排序，而视频世界模型评估器在此类任务中则会因自回归预测误差而性能下降。消融实验表明，预训练的视觉编码器在性能上显著优于从零训练的替代方案，尤其是在长时程任务中；同时，学习得到的终端成功标注能够在无真实奖励标签的情况下进行评估，且仅带来轻微的精度损失。

title: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
summary: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.
tldr: GTP proposes a model-based framework that treats a generative model as a proposal distribution for action sequences, enabling efficient trajectory-level planning by sampling and refining candidates with learned dynamics, reward, and value models, and demonstrates strong performance in continuous control and long-horizon manipulation.
tldr_zh: GTP 提出了一种基于模型的框架，将生成模型视为动作序列的提议分布，通过使用学习到的动态、奖励和价值模型对候选序列进行采样和优化，实现高效的轨迹级规划，并在连续控制和长期操作任务中表现出色。
summary_zh: 在线决策面临着高效推理与长时程推理之间的矛盾。基于价值的方法依赖短时程自举，限制了长期信息的传播，而轨迹优化方法虽显式规划，却需在每个决策步骤求解高维优化问题。我们提出了生成式轨迹规划（GTP），一种基于模型的框架，通过学习一个生成模型作为动作序列上的提议分布来解决这一矛盾。GTP并非从零开始优化序列，而是从扩散先验中采样候选序列，并利用学习得到的动力学、奖励和价值模型对其进行优化，从而实现高效的轨迹级推理。在连续控制和长时程操作任务中，GTP匹配或超越了最先进的无模型、扩散策略和基于模型的基线方法，并在强基线方法性能下降的领域中保持稳定。我们的结果表明，生成模型的最佳理解方式并非作为策略，而是作为用于规划的结构化提议分布，这为将生成建模与基于模型的决策相结合提供了新的视角。

title: Perception Beyond the Visible: Incompleteness-Aware Scene Understanding for Robot Autonomy
summary: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.
tldr: The paper presents a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding in robot autonomy, addressing occlusions, novel objects, and sensor degradation through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, and uncertainty-guided fusion, with future directions toward belief-centric 4D representations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个面向机器人自主性的不完整性感知场景理解研究愿景，通过非模态感知、语义占用预测和不确定性引导融合来解决遮挡、新物体和传感器退化问题，并展望了信念中心4D表示的未来方向。
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人自主性要求从部分且有噪声的观测中推理世界状态。然而，许多感知系统仅建模可见场景区域，依赖固定的语义类别，并假设传感器测量可靠。这些假设在遮挡、遇到新颖物体及传感器退化的情况下均会失效。本文提出了一种面向不完整性感知的场景理解研究愿景。我围绕三个基本挑战组织这一愿景：证据不完整、知识不完整以及传感器可靠性不完整。我探讨了通过非模态感知、语义占用预测、开放世界场景理解、标签高效学习及不确定性引导的多模态融合来应对这些挑战的研究贡献。基于这些贡献，我概述了面向以信念为中心的4D场景表示的未来研究方向。这些表示旨在联合建模几何、语义、运动及不确定性。我还讨论了主动感知和安全适应策略，使机器人能够通过交互降低不确定性。目标在于开发经过校准且可操作性的场景表示，以支持动态开放世界环境中的可靠自主性。

title: CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7$^\circ$), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at https://petreric.github.io/CALM/.
tldr: CALM presents a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning controller for cooperative aerial manipulation, using shared parameters, goal estimation, extended state observers, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward to improve tracking of a moving ground robot with a basket.
tldr_zh: CALM提出了一种用于协作空中操纵的去中心化多智能体强化学习控制器，通过共享参数、目标估计、扩展状态观测器和预期编队偏航前馈，提高了对移动地面机器人的跟踪性能。
summary_zh: 协作式空中操控在风力、负载运动以及噪声目标广播条件下具有较大难度，因为多架无人机通过共享负载相互耦合。本文提出了CALM（协作式空中学习操控），这是一种用于空中操控器的分散式控制器，能够携带吊篮并跟踪移动的地面机器人。CALM将基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）训练的共享参数多智能体强化学习策略，与目标估计、每架无人机扩展状态观测器、吊篮质量估计以及预测性编队偏航前馈相结合。预测性编队偏航前馈利用估计的目标运动，在位置误差产生之前旋转编队，从而在不增加净指令力的情况下减少吊篮偏航滞后。扰动条件评价器支持集中式训练，而执行过程保持分散。在保留轨迹上，CALM的平均位置和姿态误差均低于所有评估基线，包括匹配机械臂基线（7.68厘米对比10.95厘米，3.3°对比4.7°）、缆绳悬挂方案以及两种基于模型的控制方法。在未知的全信息路径退化情形下，CALM在统计上依然与机械臂基线相当或更优。视频见https://petreric.github.io/CALM/。

title: I2O2I-Nav: A Benchmark with a Modular Agent for Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor-to-Indoor Navigation
summary: Service and delivery robots often need to complete long-horizon navigation missions spanning indoor and outdoor environments. Existing embodied navigation benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated stages or partial cross-domain journeys, providing limited support for assessing how heterogeneous navigation capabilities compose under continuous execution. We introduce I2O2I-Nav, a physics-enabled benchmark of 20 real-world composite scenes spanning over 115,000 square meters across multiple buildings and floors, with aligned 3DGS rendering and collision geometry. Its three-level evaluation progresses from independent primitives to two-stage compositions and complete four-stage I2O2I missions. Each stage starts from its predecessor's actual endpoint, while stage-conditional metrics track completion and localize failures along the mission. We further propose the MODULAR-Agent that coordinates frozen navigation policies through completion verification, stage handoffs, and bounded recovery. Evaluation across 1,374 episodes highlights the difficulty of continuous composition. The MODULAR-Agent achieves 40.5-76% success on individual primitives, but full I2O2I success remains low. Compared with a fixed policy chain using the same underlying policies, it more than doubles success on both Indoor-to-Outdoor (I2O) and Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I), while improving full-mission success from 1.15% to 4.02%. Stage-wise analysis shows that the MODULAR-Agent enables more missions to reach the final object-navigation stage, where conditional success remains low, revealing challenges in both long-horizon stage execution and completion decisions.
tldr: I2O2I-Nav introduces a physics-enabled benchmark and a modular agent for long-horizon indoor-to-outdoor-to-indoor navigation, evaluating composed navigation capabilities across 20 real-world scenes and 1,374 episodes, showing that modular coordination improves success over fixed policy chains though full mission success remains challenging.
tldr_zh: I2O2I-Nav 提出了一个物理启用的基准测试和一个模块化智能体，用于长时程室内到室外再到室内导航，在20个真实场景和1374个回合中评估组合导航能力，表明模块化协调相比固定策略链提升了成功率，但完整任务成功率仍然较低。
summary_zh: 服务与配送机器人通常需要完成跨越室内外环境的长时间导航任务。现有具身导航基准主要评估独立阶段或部分跨域行程，难以全面支持异构导航能力在连续执行中的组合评估。为此，我们提出I2O2I-Nav，一个基于物理引擎的基准，涵盖20个真实世界复合场景，总面积超过115,000平方米，跨越多个建筑和楼层，并配有对齐的3DGS渲染与碰撞几何。其三级评估体系从独立基本技能逐步推进至两阶段组合任务，最终覆盖完整的四阶段I2O2I任务。每个阶段均从前一阶段的实际终点出发，阶段条件指标用于追踪完成情况并定位任务中的失败点。我们进一步提出MODULAR-Agent，通过完成验证、阶段交接和受限恢复机制协调冻结的导航策略。在1,374个回合上的评估凸显了连续组合的难度。MODULAR-Agent在单项基本技能上的成功率为40.5%-76%，但完整的I2O2I任务成功率仍然较低。与使用相同底层策略的固定策略链相比，MODULAR-Agent在室内到室外（I2O）和室外到室内（O2I）两个阶段上的成功率均提升了一倍以上，并将完整任务成功率从1.15%提升至4.02%。分阶段分析显示，MODULAR-Agent使更多任务能够到达最终的目标物体导航阶段，但该阶段的条件成功率依然偏低，揭示了长时间阶段执行与完成决策方面的双重挑战。

title: Cross-Embodiment Affordance Transfer for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework that translates human-annotated object affordances into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on robot geometry and constraints, improving manipulation planning by addressing the mismatch between human and robot affordances.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个框架，将人类标注的物体可供性转换为基于机器人几何和约束的可执行可供性预测，通过解决人类与机器人可供性不匹配的问题来改进操作规划。
summary_zh: 机器人操控系统通常从人工标注的数据集中学习物体可供性，这些数据集反映的是人类手部的交互可能性，而非特定机器人的物理约束。例如，人类标注者认为可抓取的物体表面区域，对于机器人而言可能在几何上不可达或机械上不可行，然而这种不匹配却很少被明确处理。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一个框架，将人类可供性标注转化为以机器人物理属性为条件的机器人可执行可供性预测。该网络基于物体的三维点云和编码机器人几何形状及约束条件的描述符，预测物体表面哪些区域对机器人而言物理可执行。模型使用人工标注的可供性信息以及仿真中多次采样尝试的机器人执行结果进行训练，其中执行结果决定了哪些区域对机器人可执行。评估在家庭物体数据集上进行，使用了UR5e机械臂上的两种平行夹爪配置。该框架优于未接收机器人信息的模型。实验结果表明，可供性预测必须以机器人为条件，仅靠人工标注不足以学习机器人可执行的可供性表征。

title: Assessing the Quality of Concrete Scenarios Generated from Scenario Classes for Automated Driving
summary: A scenario-based development approach has become state of the art for automated driving systems. Once a set of scenario classes covering the operational design domain is available, concrete scenarios are generated from these scenario classes, e.g., to be used for hazard analysis and risk assessment or for the system's verification and validation. For such applications, a high diversity among the generated concrete scenarios is paramount. The question arises how the quality of collections of concrete scenarios can be assessed in such a setting. In this work, we aggregate scenario distance measures into so-called quality functions that quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections in the context of automated driving. In particular, we consider the case where scenario classes are formalized as constraint systems and the associated concrete scenario space is not explicitly known. Based on a set of desired properties we construct candidates for such quality functions and give proofs for their property fulfillment. To show the practical relevance of quality functions, we perform a variety of experiments in the context of an abstract scenario-based virtual verification toolchain for automated driving systems. More specifically, we use quality functions to compare the effectiveness of variation methods for sampling, examine the choice of different scenario distance measures, and investigate the effects of temporal aspects on concrete scenario collection quality.
tldr: This paper introduces quality functions that aggregate scenario distance measures to quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections for automated driving, with proofs and experiments in a virtual verification toolchain.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了通过聚合场景距离度量来量化自动驾驶具体场景集合多样性的质量函数，并在虚拟验证工具链中进行了实验验证。
summary_zh: 基于场景的开发方法已成为自动驾驶系统的最新发展水平。一旦获得覆盖操作设计域的一组场景类别，便从这些场景类别中生成具体场景，例如用于危害分析与风险评估，或用于系统的验证与确认。在此类应用中，所生成具体场景之间的高度多样性至关重要。由此引发的问题是如何在这种背景下评估具体场景集合的质量。在本研究中，我们将场景距离度量聚合为所谓的质量函数，用以量化自动驾驶背景下具体场景集合的多样性。特别地，我们考虑了场景类别被形式化为约束系统且相关具体场景空间并非显式已知的情况。基于一组期望属性，我们构建了此类质量函数的候选形式，并对其属性满足性给出了证明。为展示质量函数的实际应用价值，我们在自动驾驶系统抽象场景基虚拟验证工具链的背景下进行了多种实验。具体而言，我们利用质量函数比较不同采样变异方法的有效性，考察不同场景距离度量的选择，并研究时间因素对具体场景集合质量的影响。

title: RESTA: Time-Scaling Augmentation for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning commonly rely on costly demonstrations recorded in one task direction and at one temporal resolution. We propose Reversal and Stride-based Trajectory Augmentation (RESTA), which exploits time-scaling data augmentation to improve data efficiency through trajectory reversal and temporal resampling. Trajectory-reversal augmentation reverses and relabels demonstrations between paired tasks with opposite objectives, reusing recorded rollouts without additional environment interaction. Because contact-rich manipulation is not exactly reversible, we treat reversal as an approximate paired-task prior rather than a physical symmetry. Temporal-stride augmentation varies observation and action sampling strides and conditions the policy on the resulting offsets, enabling fixed or randomized temporal schedules. Experiments across 16 paired bimanual manipulation tasks show that trajectory reversal is particularly effective in the low-data regime and that temporal-stride augmentation improves success under randomized temporal schedules. With 25 and 50 independently collected demonstrations per task, RESTA achieves 78.4% and 85.2% average success, respectively, matching or exceeding baselines trained with twice as many demonstrations (77.3% and 85.4%). These results show that RESTA can improve data efficiency in robot imitation learning.
tldr: This paper proposes RESTA, a time-scaling data augmentation method combining trajectory reversal and temporal stride resampling to improve data efficiency in robot imitation learning, achieving performance comparable to baselines trained with twice the demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RESTA，一种结合轨迹反转和时间步长重采样的时间缩放数据增强方法，以提高机器人模仿学习的数据效率，在仅用一半示范数据的情况下达到与基线相当的性能。
summary_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的机器人操控策略通常依赖于在单一任务方向和单一时间分辨率下记录的昂贵演示数据。我们提出了一种基于反转与步长的时间轨迹增强方法（RESTA），利用时间缩放数据增强，通过轨迹反转和时间重采样来提高数据效率。轨迹反转增强在具有相反目标的任务对之间反转并重新标记演示，无需额外的环境交互即可复用已记录的轨迹。由于接触丰富的操控并非严格可逆，我们将反转视为一种近似的配对任务先验，而非物理对称性。时间步长增强通过改变观测和动作的采样步长，并基于由此产生的偏移量对策略进行条件化，从而实现固定或随机的时序调度。在16个配对的双臂操控任务上的实验表明，轨迹反转在低数据场景下尤为有效，而时间步长增强在随机时序调度下能提升成功率。在每项任务仅使用25条和50条独立采集的演示数据时，RESTA分别达到了78.4%和85.2%的平均成功率，匹配或超过了使用两倍演示数据训练的基线方法（分别为77.3%和85.4%）。这些结果表明，RESTA能够有效提升机器人模仿学习中的数据效率。

title: MARTS: A Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying of Diseased Tomato Plants in Greenhouses
summary: Broadcast spraying remains the dominant method of disease control in greenhouse tomato production, yet it treats healthy and diseased tissue alike, exposes workers to hazardous aerosols, and depends on operator skill. This paper presents MARTS (Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying), a low-cost robotic platform that closes the loop from plant-level disease detection to leaf-localised spray delivery in commercial greenhouses. MARTS integrates a Clearpath Husky A200 mobile base, a UR5 manipulator, a novel modular spraying end-effector built around a single 12 V micro-diaphragm pump, and a wrist-mounted Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D camera. Disease detection reuses our previously published Tomato Leaf Disease Vision Language Model (TLDVLM; Grounding DINO, SAM-2 and LoRA-tuned BLIP-2, 97.27% accuracy over 10 classes); this work focuses on actuation, control and system integration. A ROS pipeline lifts detections into 3D targets, generates collision-aware nozzle poses at a 120 mm stand-off using fitted leaf normals, and scales pump pulse duration to lesion area. Water-sensitive paper calibration showed a linear pulse-volume relationship (R^2 = 0.994). In MuJoCo simulation, an adaptive base-repositioning strategy achieved 100% coverage of 18 waypoints with a maximum orientation error of 1.1 deg. Deployed at the SILAL commercial greenhouse (Al Ain, UAE) on cherry tomatoes under natural infection, MARTS treated 312 diseased leaves in 12 autonomous trials with 92.4% targeting success, 18.7 mm mean spray-centre error, 6.1% adjacent-leaf overspray, and a 71% reduction in pesticide volume versus broadcast spraying. Mean cycle time was 4.8 s per leaf, and the spraying subsystem costs USD 412, 6-10x lower than comparable systems, showing that accurate leaf-level targeting is achievable on commodity hardware.
tldr: MARTS integrates a Clearpath Husky and UR5 with a low-cost spraying end-effector and a VLM-based detection pipeline to perform leaf-localized targeted spraying of diseased tomato plants in commercial greenhouses, achieving high targeting accuracy and a 71% reduction in pesticide volume.
tldr_zh: MARTS将Clearpath Husky和UR5与低成本喷洒末端执行器及基于VLM的检测管道集成，在商业温室中对患病番茄植株进行叶片级精准喷洒，实现了高命中率和71%的农药减量。
summary_zh: 在温室番茄生产中，广谱喷施仍是病害防治的主导方式，但该方法对健康与染病组织一视同仁，使作业人员暴露于有害气溶胶中，且效果高度依赖操作者技能。本文提出MARTS（模块化精准喷施农业机器人）——一种低成本机器人平台，可在商业温室中实现从植株级病害检测到叶片局部喷施输送的闭环作业。MARTS集成Clearpath Husky A200移动底盘、UR5机械臂、基于单个12 V微型隔膜泵的新型模块化喷施末端执行器，以及腕部安装的Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D相机。病害检测复用本团队此前发表的番茄叶部病害视觉语言模型（TLDVLM；采用Grounding DINO、SAM-2及LoRA微调BLIP-2，10类病害分类精度达97.27%）；本研究重点聚焦于执行机构、控制与系统集成。ROS管线将检测结果映射至三维目标，利用拟合叶片法向量在120 mm工作距离处生成碰撞感知的喷嘴位姿，并根据病斑面积调节泵脉冲持续时间。水敏纸标定结果表明脉冲-喷量呈线性关系（R² = 0.994）。在MuJoCo仿真中，自适应底盘重定位策略实现了18个路径点的100%覆盖率，最大方位角误差为1.1°。在阿联酋艾因市SILAL商业温室的自然感病樱桃番茄上部署试验中，MARTS在12次自主试验中处理了312片染病叶片，靶向成功率为92.4%，平均喷施中心误差为18.7 mm，相邻叶片过喷率为6.1%，农药用量较广谱喷施减少71%。单叶平均作业周期为4.8 s，喷施子系统成本为412美元，较同类系统低6–10倍，证明在通用硬件上即可实现精准的叶片级靶向喷施。

title: Breaking the Average: Overcoming Convergent Defaults in Robotic Manipulation via Diagnostic Chain-of-Thought and Structured Guidance
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, such as $π_{0.5}$, have demonstrated impressive generalization capabilities by scaling behavior cloning across massive datasets. However, these models frequently suffer from distributional convergence, a phenomenon where the policy regresses to "safe" but suboptimal mean behaviors due to mode averaging in the training data. This often results in generic grasp strategies, Convergent Defaults, that fail in constrained or long-tail scenarios. In this work, we propose a novel framework to identify and correct these behaviors without parameter updates. We introduce a three-stage methodology: (1) Probing for Defaults, identifying task-specific mode collapse; (2) Diagnostic Root Cause Analysis, utilizing the VLA's latent reasoning capabilities to verbalize the logic behind suboptimal actions; and (3) Structured Guidance Injection, where concrete, distinct alternatives are encoded into reusable "Lens Prompts" that shift the sampling distribution. We validate this approach using $π_{0.5}$ in ManiSkill3 simulation environments. We hypothesize that our method outperforms vanilla $π_{0.5}$ and standard Chain-of-Thought prompting by effectively breaking convergent defaults in complex manipulation tasks.
tldr: The paper proposes a training-free framework to identify and correct 'convergent defaults' in VLA policies by probing for mode collapse, using latent reasoning for root cause analysis, and injecting structured 'Lens Prompts' to shift the sampling distribution, validated in ManiSkill3 simulations with π0.5.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个无需训练更新的框架，通过探测模式崩溃、利用潜在推理进行根因分析和注入结构化的“透镜提示”来识别并纠正VLA策略中的“收敛默认行为”，并在ManiSkill3模拟环境中使用π0.5进行验证。
summary_zh: 近期开发的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，如 \(π_{0.5}\)，通过在大规模数据集上进行行为克隆的扩展，展现出令人瞩目的泛化能力。然而，这些模型常常受到分布收敛问题的影响，即由于训练数据中的模态平均，策略会回归到“安全”但次优的平均行为。这一现象往往导致通用抓取策略——即“趋同默认”——在受限或长尾场景中失效。在本研究中，我们提出一种新颖的框架，在不更新参数的情况下识别并纠正这些行为。我们引入三阶段方法论：（1）默认行为探测，识别任务特定的模态崩溃；（2）诊断性根因分析，利用VLA模型的潜在推理能力，将次优行为背后的逻辑进行语言化表达；（3）结构化引导注入，将具体且截然不同的替代方案编码为可重用的“镜头提示”，以改变采样分布。我们使用 \(π_{0.5}\) 在ManiSkill3仿真环境中验证了该方法。我们假设，该方法能够有效打破复杂操作任务中的趋同默认，其性能优于原始 \(π_{0.5}\) 和标准链式思维提示方法。

title: Locomotion with Online Awareness of Dynamics for Precision Footholds
summary: Unknown payloads alter robot dynamics and make precise contact execution difficult when foothold margins are small. We present LOAD, a perceptive locomotion framework that combines explicit inertial estimates with implicit dynamics features for narrow-beam traversal. Separate recurrent modules infer torso inertial changes and task-relevant history from proprioception, while a height-map teacher is distilled into a depth-based student. We extensively evaluate LOAD and its variants in simulation and on hardware across beam widths and payload configurations. The results show that implicit dynamics features accelerate training, while explicit inertial estimation further improves traversal success; combining both enables LOAD to approach the performance of a privileged policy supplied with ground-truth inertial parameters. Hardware experiments demonstrate traversal with unilateral payloads of 6 kg on a 10 cm beam and 9 kg on a 15 cm beam, and an evenly distributed 11 kg payload on a 15 cm beam. These results support combining physical estimates and history features for precision locomotion under unknown loads.
tldr: This paper presents LOAD, a perceptive locomotion framework that combines explicit inertial estimates with implicit dynamics features from recurrent modules to improve narrow-beam traversal under unknown payloads, validated in simulation and on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LOAD，一种感知运动框架，结合显式惯性估计和循环模块的隐式动力学特征，以提高未知载荷下窄梁穿越的成功率，并在仿真和硬件上验证。
summary_zh: 未知载荷会改变机器人动力学特性，并在立足点余量较小时使精确接触执行变得困难。我们提出LOAD，一种感知运动框架，将显式惯性估计与隐式动力学特征相结合，用于窄梁穿越。分离的循环模块从本体感觉中推断躯干惯性变化及任务相关历史信息，同时将高度图教师模型蒸馏为基于深度图像的学生模型。我们在仿真和硬件上，针对不同梁宽和载荷配置，对LOAD及其变体进行了广泛评估。结果表明，隐式动力学特征加速了训练，而显式惯性估计进一步提高了穿越成功率；两者结合使LOAD能够接近具备真实惯性参数的特权策略的性能。硬件实验展示了在10厘米梁上携带6千克单侧载荷、在15厘米梁上携带9千克单侧载荷，以及在15厘米梁上均匀分布11千克载荷的穿越能力。这些结果支持将物理估计与历史特征相结合，以实现未知载荷下的精确运动。

title: GLST: Global-Local Spatio-Temporal Memory Decomposition Framework for Online Chained-Goal Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation in real-world environments often requires long-horizon operation under partial observability and evolving goals. Existing mapless navigation approaches predominantly assume fixed goals throughout an episode, limiting applicability to practical scenarios where goals change online during execution. We study online chained-goal navigation, where goals evolve through existing-goal redirection or new-goal emergence without explicit transition signals. Under this setting, we find navigation may require either continued exploration or strategic revisitation, creating conflicting memory requirements. We propose Global-Local Spatio-Temporal Belief Learning (GLST), a memory-decomposition framework that separates latent beliefs into global-local spatial and long-short temporal representations for long-horizon reasoning. We further introduce goal-conditioned rewards to balance exploration and exploitation under evolving goals. Extensive experiments in simulation across diverse terrains demonstrate improved chained-goal navigation performance over baselines. Real-robot experiments using the Spot quadruped further validate our memory decomposition framework.
tldr: GLST introduces a memory decomposition framework separating global-local spatial and long-short temporal latent beliefs, coupled with goal-conditioned rewards, to improve online chained-goal navigation under evolving goals in simulation and on a real Spot robot.
tldr_zh: GLST提出了一种将潜在信念分解为全局-局部空间和长-短期时间表示的记忆分解框架，并结合目标条件奖励，在仿真和真实Spot机器人上提升了在线链式目标导航的性能。
summary_zh: 现实环境中的自主导航通常需要在部分可观测和动态变化目标条件下进行长时程操作。现有的无地图导航方法大多假设整个任务周期内目标固定不变，这限制了其在目标在线动态变化的实际场景中的适用性。本文研究了在线链式目标导航问题，其中目标通过既有目标重定向或新目标涌现而演化，且无显式转换信号。在该设定下，我们发现导航可能既需要持续探索，又需要策略性重访，从而产生相互冲突的记忆需求。我们提出全局-局部时空信念学习框架（GLST），这是一种记忆分解方法，将潜在信念分离为全局-局部空间表示和长-短时间表示，以实现长时程推理。我们进一步引入目标条件奖励，以在目标演化过程中平衡探索与利用。在多种地形的仿真实验中，该方法相较于基线方法在链式目标导航性能上有所提升。使用Spot四足机器人进行的真实机器人实验进一步验证了我们的记忆分解框架的有效性。

title: LAG-IO: Multi-IMU State Estimation for Legged Robots Using Factor Graphs
summary: Robust proprioceptive state estimation is crucial for legged robots, particularly in challenging environments where exteroceptive sensors are unreliable. While traditional leg odometry typically relies on a single body-mounted inertial measurement unit (IMU) fused with leg kinematics via an extended Kalman filter (EKF), such methods are vulnerable to linearization errors and hard-contact assumptions, leading to severe drift during slippage or dynamic locomotion.In this paper, we propose LAG-IO, a factor graph-based multi-IMU state estimation framework that tightly couples measurements from a main body IMU, multiple leg-mounted IMUs, and joint encoders within a sliding-window optimization. To handle non-stationary foot-ground interactions, we introduce a continuous probabilistic contact detection module based on kernel density estimation (KDE), which adaptively scales the covariance of zero-velocity update (ZUPT) factors. Furthermore, kinematic relative position factors are formulated to structurally anchor the independent leg inertial states to the robot's main body. Experimental results on a quadruped robot across various unstructured terrains demonstrate that, compared to existing baselines, LAG-IO achieves higher planar trajectory accuracy, reduces unobservable vertical divergence, and provides smoother trajectory transitions during unstable contacts, while maintaining competitive attitude observability.
tldr: LAG-IO introduces a factor graph-based multi-IMU state estimation framework for legged robots, tightly coupling body and leg-mounted IMUs with joint encoders and a probabilistic contact detection module to improve trajectory accuracy and robustness in challenging terrains.
tldr_zh: LAG-IO提出了一种基于因子图的多IMU状态估计框架，用于腿式机器人，通过紧密耦合机身和腿部IMU、关节编码器以及概率接触检测模块，提高了在挑战性地形下的轨迹精度和鲁棒性。

title: Learning Robot Policies for Whole-Body Mobility Assistance via Dynamic Human Motion Generation
summary: Robotic assistance for human mobility could benefit care recipients and reduce caregiver burden during physically demanding tasks such as Sit-to-Stand (STS) and Lift-and-Transfer (L&T). Learning robot policies for these whole-body assistive tasks is challenging: real-world data collection for human-robot interaction is costly and safety-critical, making simulation an attractive alternative. Prior work, however, typically treats the human as static or minimally responsive and thus fails to capture the cooperative nature of mobility assistance. We present a simulation-based framework for learning whole-body assistive robot policies. At its core is a human policy trained with an adversarial motion prior that produces realistic care-recipient motion in response to the robot's actions. A human-adaptive scripted controller interacts with this policy to collect diverse robot demonstrations at scale. From these demonstrations, we train 3D diffusion policies that map segmented human point clouds and robot joint positions to whole-body actions for a mobile manipulator, without relying on privileged human state at deployment. The resulting robot policies successfully perform both STS and L&T assistance in simulation. Preliminary experiments further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer for STS after fine-tuning on a small amount of real-world data. Videos are available on our project page: https://rchi-lab.github.io/human-gen-mobility-assistance/
tldr: This paper presents a simulation-based framework that uses a human policy trained with an adversarial motion prior to generate realistic care-recipient responses, enabling the learning of whole-body assistive robot policies for sit-to-stand and lift-and-transfer tasks via 3D diffusion policies, with initial sim-to-real transfer demonstrated.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个基于仿真的框架，利用对抗运动先验训练的人类策略生成逼真的护理对象响应，从而通过3D扩散策略学习全身辅助机器人策略，用于坐站和抬举转移任务，并初步展示了仿真到现实的迁移。

title: HelpMeOut: A Neuropsychology-Grounded Benchmark for Error-Aware Monitoring of Household Task Execution
summary: We introduce HelpMeOut, an embodied AI benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution. Existing embodied household benchmarks typically assume that humans execute tasks correctly, but this assumption does not hold for cognitively impaired persons or older adults whose everyday activities produce structured execution errors. To address this gap, HelpMeOut operationalizes research on everyday action errors into 20000 paired activity episodes, covering nine neuropsychologically motivated error categories. In each episode, agents observe a streaming human activity trajectory and must monitor whether the execution is unfolding correctly, diagnosing any structured errors as early as possible. We evaluate learned-monitor, symbolic, change-point, and frontier LLM prompting baselines. Results show that these methods perform poorly as error monitors, often missing when execution goes wrong. These results suggest a gap left by standard goal-inference and task-completion benchmarks, making HelpMeOut a testbed for error-aware assistive agents.
tldr: HelpMeOut introduces a benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution, targeting cognitively impaired or older adults, and evaluates several baseline monitors showing they perform poorly, highlighting a gap in assistive embodied AI.
tldr_zh: HelpMeOut 提出了一个用于错误感知家庭任务执行监控的基准，针对认知障碍或老年人，评估了几种基线监控器并显示其表现不佳，凸显了辅助具身AI的空白。

title: Towards a Systematic Study of Embodied System 2 over Full Task Execution Cycles
summary: An embodied brain, or System 2, must turn an abstract goal into actions while discovering relevant scene conditions and checking whether executed skills achieved their intended effects. Open-loop evaluations cannot test observations shaped by an agent's decisions, while some closed-loop evaluations provide limited evidence during execution or assume idealized skill outcomes. We introduce SCOPER, a suite for studying observation-grounded planning, execution, and recovery. SCOPER-bench combines high-level goals, ongoing visual observations, a shared rule-based System 1 for low-level actions, and controlled execution failures. Its construction and validation pipeline yields 870 tasks across BEHAVIOR and ProcTHOR, complemented by about 3,500 situated questions tied to the evaluated agent's execution. Benchmark results reveal difficulties in retaining scene evidence, monitoring progress, and recovering from unexpected outcomes. To address these difficulties, SCOPER-harness combines Evidence Memory and Progress Verification with a dynamic task agenda and bounded exploration, without additional model training. Across two evaluated open-source backbones and two simulators, the harness improves task success by 11.1-28.6%; a harnessed 9B model outperforms a directly executed 27B model on both simulators. In an offline next-action evaluation using observations from 200 real-robot demonstrations, the harness also improves full-call accuracy by 14.7% and 15.3%. SCOPER provides a setting for diagnosing and improving embodied reasoning throughout a complete task execution cycle.
tldr: This paper introduces SCOPER, a suite for evaluating and improving embodied System 2 reasoning across full task execution cycles, including planning, execution, and recovery in simulators and real-robot demos, demonstrating significant improvements with a harness of evidence memory and progress verification.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SCOPER，一个用于评估和改进完整任务执行周期中具身系统2推理的套件，涵盖模拟器和真实机器人演示中的规划、执行与恢复，并通过证据记忆和进度验证显著提升了性能。
summary_zh: 具身大脑，或称系统2，必须将抽象目标转化为具体行动，同时发现相关场景条件，并检验已执行的技能是否达成了预期效果。开环评估无法测试由智能体决策所塑造的观察结果，而某些闭环评估在执行过程中仅能提供有限的证据，或假设技能成果理想化。我们引入了SCOPER，一个用于研究基于观察的规划、执行与恢复的套件。SCOPER-bench结合了高层次目标、持续视觉观察、共享的基于规则的初级动作系统1，以及可控的执行故障。其构建与验证流程在BEHAVIOR和ProcTHOR上生成了870项任务，并辅以约3500个与被评估智能体执行过程相关的情境化问题。基准测试结果揭示了在保留场景证据、监控进展以及从意外结果中恢复方面的困难。为解决这些困难，SCOPER-harness将证据记忆与进度验证相结合，并引入动态任务议程和有限探索，无需额外模型训练。在两个评估的开源骨干模型和两个模拟器中，该套件将任务成功率提升了11.1%至28.6%；在两个模拟器上，配备该套件的9B模型均优于直接执行的27B模型。在利用200次真实机器人演示观察进行的离线下一步动作评估中，该套件还将全调用准确率分别提升了14.7%和15.3%。SCOPER为在整个任务执行周期中诊断和改进具身推理提供了一个测试环境。

title: Code2Worlds-2: Physically Plausible Agent Harness for Embodied World Simulation
summary: Recent coding large language models (LLMs) can synthesize dynamic 4D worlds from natural language, but the resulting content remains a visual artifact. It lacks physical semantics such as the collision geometry, mass, friction, inertia, and joint structure, required to enable it to simulate the physical world, and its dynamics are scripted to look plausible rather than designed to execute. What is needed is an executable world: one that a physics engine can load and step, resolving contact physically. We present Code2Worlds-2, an extension of Code2Worlds that turns 4D world generation into an embodied world simulation. We keep the original dual-stream generation pipeline intact and append two modules. First, a SimReady Scene Compiler that turns a generated visual scene into a simulator-compatible representation: it assigns collision meshes via convex decomposition, estimates physical attributes with a vision-language model, infers a lightweight support graph, instantiates the engine's contact, friction, and dynamics constraints, and applies a gravity settling pass, before exporting the scene as MuJoCo MJCF. Second, a Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner that implements an automated agent harness-a compile, simulate, critique and refine loop-that converts visual dynamics into executable rigid and articulated dynamics and evolves the physical settings rather than only the code, replacing the purely visual motion critic with a simulator critic that inspects penetration depth, collision pairs, stability, contact forces, joint limits, and robot reachability. We further propose SimCode4D, a state-based benchmark with five task templates for evaluating embodied simulation. Experiments on SimCode4D and across natural, indoor, industrial, urban, and service scenes show that Code2Worlds-2 produces physically plausible, simulator-compatible, and robot-interactable scenes.
tldr: Code2Worlds-2 converts LLM-synthesized 4D worlds into physics-simulator-compatible scenes by adding a SimReady Scene Compiler and a Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner, enabling embodied world simulation with robot interaction.
tldr_zh: Code2Worlds-2 通过添加 SimReady 场景编译器和仿真器在环 4D 细化器，将 LLM 合成的 4D 世界转换为物理模拟器兼容的场景，实现具身世界模拟和机器人交互。
summary_zh: 近期编码大型语言模型（LLMs）能够从自然语言合成动态4D世界，但生成的内容仍仅是视觉产物，缺乏物理语义，如碰撞几何、质量、摩擦力、惯性和关节结构等，这些属性对于模拟物理世界至关重要；其动态效果为脚本化呈现，旨在视觉上逼真，而非面向实际执行。所需的是一个可执行的世界：能够被物理引擎加载并进行逐步推进，以物理方式解决接触问题。我们提出Code2Worlds-2，作为Code2Worlds的扩展，将4D世界生成转化为具身世界模拟。我们保留原有的双流生成管线不变，并附加两个模块。首先，SimReady场景编译器将生成的视觉场景转换为模拟器兼容的表示：通过凸分解分配碰撞网格，利用视觉语言模型估计物理属性，推断轻量级支撑图，实例化引擎的接触、摩擦和动力学约束，并应用重力沉降过程，随后将场景导出为MuJoCo MJCF格式。其次，模拟器在环4D精炼器实现了一个自动化智能体框架——即编译、模拟、批判和精炼循环——将视觉动态转化为可执行的刚性及关节动力学，并演化物理设置而非仅修改代码，用模拟器批判器取代纯视觉运动批判器，检查穿透深度、碰撞对、稳定性、接触力、关节限制及机器人可达性。我们还提出了SimCode4D，一个基于状态基准测试，包含五种任务模板，用于评估具身模拟。在SimCode4D以及自然、室内、工业、城市和服务场景上的实验表明，Code2Worlds-2生成的场景在物理上合理、与模拟器兼容且可供机器人交互。

title: ATOM: Abstract Transition and Option Modeling - Experience-Informed Hierarchical Navigation
summary: We propose ATOM (Abstract Transition and Option Modeling), a hierarchical navigation framework that combines higher-level graph planning with reusable lower-level option policies for efficient repeated navigation in large-scale 3D environments represented by hierarchical structures such as 3D scene graphs (3DSGs). ATOM operates on a hierarchical graph representation, implemented using, for instance, the Rooms and Places layers of a 3DSG, where each directed abstract transition is associated with a navigation option. For each transition, ATOM computes and stores a reusable option policy along with its state-dependent cost-to-go. Across repeated navigation tasks, ATOM maintains a smoothed empirical distribution over option initiation states and uses it to progressively refine the corresponding abstract transition cost. Ablation studies show that ATOM reduces cumulative repeated-planning time by 97.5% relative to a monolithic MDP baseline while maintaining trajectories within approximately 7% of a Global Places A* shortest-path reference. Experience-informed refinement further reduces abstract transition-cost estimation error by 10.3%. Physical experiments validate ATOM on an F1Tenth vehicle, successfully completing all five navigation queries with 43% of inter-region option executions reusing previously generated solutions.
tldr: ATOM presents a hierarchical navigation framework integrating graph planning with reusable option policies, validated in 3D scene graphs and on an F1Tenth vehicle, significantly reducing repeated planning time while maintaining trajectory efficiency.
tldr_zh: ATOM提出了一种结合图规划与可复用选项策略的分层导航框架，在3D场景图和F1Tenth车辆上验证，显著降低重复规划时间并保持轨迹效率。
summary_zh: 我们提出ATOM（抽象转移与选项建模），这是一种分层导航框架，结合了高层图规划与可复用的低层选项策略，以在由三维场景图（3DSGs）等分层结构表示的大规模3D环境中实现高效的重复导航。ATOM基于分层图表示运行，例如使用3DSG的“房间”和“场所”层实现，其中每个有向抽象转移都与一个导航选项相关联。对于每次转移，ATOM计算并存储一个可复用的选项策略及其依赖状态的目标代价。在重复导航任务中，ATOM维持对选项起始状态的经验分布进行平滑更新，并利用该分布逐步优化相应的抽象转移代价。消融研究表明，与整体MDP基线相比，ATOM将重复规划累计时间减少了97.5%，同时保持轨迹与全局场所A*最短路径参考的偏差约在7%以内。经验驱动的细化进一步将抽象转移代价估计误差降低了10.3%。物理实验在F1Tenth车辆上验证了ATOM，成功完成了全部五次导航查询，其中43%的区域间选项执行复用了先前生成的解决方案。

title: Act4R: Action-conditioned 4D reconstruction for kinematics-free control
summary: Precise control of movement across various robotic embodiments is a longstanding challenge. Modeling complex robotic structures requires significant time, dedicated sensors, and manual labeling. Recent advancements in 4D representation learning offer an interesting alternative: can we leverage 4D features lifted from 2D observations to densely map a robot's spatial movement based on the action signal? To this end, we propose Act4R, a framework that builds on 3D foundation model to predict a robot's 3D scene flow with any given action. Act4R introduces a Spatial-Action Encoder, which encodes the current 2D robot state and its action signals into embeddings that represent future robot state in 3D. Then, both the current and future spatial embeddings are decoded into point maps to estimate action-conditioned scene flow. To effectively learn the mapping between action and future state, Act4R introduces spatial-action fusion in its transformer-based encoder, and a spatial alignment loss that guides the encoder for future flow prediction. After training on some samples of a given embodiment, Act4R can perform inverse control by optimizing the signal to achieve the desired scene flow. We evaluate Act4R on a public real-world dataset and synthetic data collected in simulator. Experiments on various robotic platforms show that Act4R outperforms the previous SoTA in scene flow prediction. Our method also performs better in inverse control, both on the action accuracy metric and in closed-loop control in simulation.
tldr: Act4R introduces an action-conditioned 4D reconstruction framework that predicts a robot's 3D scene flow from 2D observations and action signals, enabling inverse control for kinematics-free control across various embodiments.
tldr_zh: Act4R提出了一种基于动作条件的4D重建框架，从2D观测和动作信号预测机器人的3D场景流，从而实现无运动学逆控制，适用于多种机器人形态。
summary_zh: 对多种机器人形态实现精准运动控制一直是一项长期挑战。对复杂机器人结构进行建模需要耗费大量时间、专用传感器以及人工标注。近期4D表示学习的进展提供了一种有趣的替代思路：我们能否利用从2D观测中提取的4D特征，基于动作信号对机器人的空间运动进行密集映射？为此，我们提出了Act4R框架，该框架基于3D基础模型，预测机器人在给定任意动作下的3D场景流。Act4R引入了一种空间-动作编码器，将当前2D机器人状态及其动作信号编码为表示机器人未来3D状态的嵌入表示。随后，当前和未来的空间嵌入均被解码为点图，以估计基于动作条件的场景流。为了有效学习动作与未来状态之间的映射关系，Act4R在其基于Transformer的编码器中引入了空间-动作融合机制，并设计了空间对齐损失函数，以引导编码器进行未来流预测。在给定机器人形态的若干样本上完成训练后，Act4R可通过优化信号实现逆控制，从而达到期望的场景流。我们在公开的真实世界数据集及仿真器中采集的合成数据上对Act4R进行了评估。在多种机器人平台上的实验表明，Act4R在场景流预测方面优于现有的最先进方法。此外，在动作精度指标以及仿真中的闭环控制方面，我们的方法在逆控制任务中也表现更优。

title: Smoothness Ranks Skill, Not Success: An Audit of Published Trajectory-Smoothness Curation Metrics Under Episode-Length Controls
summary: Trajectory smoothness has been proposed as a cheap, training-free signal for curating imitation-learning demonstrations, most recently by rinse, which introduces Spectral Arc Length (SAL) and a contact-aware Trajectory-Envelope Distance (TED). We test whether these published metrics survive episode-length controls on real robomimic data. On can/mh, SAL separates better from worse operators with AUROC 0.952, but episode length alone achieves 0.957, and inside a duration-matched band SAL falls to 0.628 while raw mean jerk, the baseline rinse argues against, rises to 0.896. The confound replicates on square/mh. On can/mg, where every episode is exactly 150 steps, SAL is at chance (0.454) and TED is inverted (0.376) against task success, while jerk reaches 0.706. Training GMM behavior-cloning policies on each metric's curated subset (10 seeds), curating by TED costs roughly a third of downstream success relative to random selection of the same size (0.240 vs. 0.360, p=0.0001, surviving Bonferroni correction), while SAL and jerk are indistinguishable from not curating. Under a diffusion policy TED still ranks worst, though its deficit is not resolvable at five seeds, and jerk becomes significantly better than both baselines, so the curation decision does not transfer unchanged across the two policy configurations we tested. Inspecting trajectories shows why TED inverts: successful manipulation requires sustained high-deviation motion through contact, while failure is low-amplitude hovering that a smoothed envelope follows closely.
tldr: This paper audits trajectory-smoothness curation metrics for imitation learning and finds they are confounded by episode length, failing to predict task success and sometimes reducing downstream policy performance.
tldr_zh: 本文审计了用于模仿学习的轨迹平滑度筛选指标，发现这些指标受回合长度混淆，无法预测任务成功，有时还会降低下游策略性能。
summary_zh: 轨迹平滑度已被提出作为一种廉价且无需训练的信号，用于筛选模仿学习示范数据，最近由rinse方法引入，该方法采用谱弧长（SAL）和接触感知的轨迹包络距离（TED）。我们检验这些已发表的指标是否在真实robomimic数据上经过回合长度控制后依然有效。在can/mh任务中，SAL能以AUROC 0.952区分较优与较劣的操作者，但仅凭回合长度即可达到0.957；在时长匹配的区间内，SAL降至0.628，而原始平均加加速度——即rinse所反对的基线方法——升至0.896。这一混淆现象在square/mh任务中重复出现。在can/mg任务中，所有回合恰好为150步，SAL的表现与随机猜测无异（0.454），TED相对于任务成功呈反向关系（0.376），而加加速度达到0.706。使用各指标筛选的子集训练高斯混合行为克隆策略（10个随机种子），相较于相同规模的随机选择，按TED筛选会使下游成功率损失约三分之一（0.240对0.360，p=0.0001，经Bonferroni校正后仍显著），而SAL和加加速度与不筛选无显著差异。在扩散策略下，TED仍排名最差，但其劣势在五个种子的条件下无法明确分辨，且加加速度显著优于两种基线方法，因此筛选决策在我们测试的两种策略配置之间不能不变地迁移。检查轨迹数据可揭示TED反向的原因：成功的操作需要持续的接触状态下的高偏差运动，而失败则是低振幅的悬停，平滑包络能紧密贴合这种运动。

title: MIRROR: Reflecting Hidden Symmetries from Offline Robot Interaction Data
summary: Symmetry-aware robot policy learning requires coupled observation-action transformations. For pixel observations, even simple physical symmetries can induce complex, viewpoint-dependent image transformations that are difficult to specify by hand. Existing symmetry-aware methods often rely on representations with predefined transformations, requiring preprocessing tailored to the sensing setup and task. We introduce MIRROR, a framework that learns how a known symmetry group operates jointly on observations and actions in partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) from offline interaction data. MIRROR couples these transformations through adversarial tuple matching over one-step transition tuples, while explicit group-consistency regularization penalizes violations of the group-operation axioms. On four Robosuite tabletop manipulation tasks, MIRROR achieves the lowest aggregate error on three of four symmetry-quality metrics, including a 61% reduction in compatibility error (which measures consistency under transformation composition) relative to an adapted LaLiGAN baseline. Using the learned transformations in frame-averaged behavior cloning (BC) yields higher mean success rates than vanilla BC on all four tasks, increasing average success from 80.48% to 85.12%, with per-task gains up to 9.66 percentage points. We also repeat symmetry discovery and policy training in simulation with heightmap and segmentation-mask observations, then deploy the resulting policy zero-shot on a real Kinova GEN3 arm. Project page: https://pomdp-mirror.github.io.
tldr: MIRROR learns how known symmetry groups act on observations and actions in POMDPs from offline robot data via adversarial tuple matching and group-consistency regularization, improving data efficiency and robustness of frame-averaged behavior cloning for manipulation, with zero-shot transfer to a real robot.
tldr_zh: MIRROR 从离线机器人数据中学习已知对称群在观察和动作上的联合作用，通过对抗性元组匹配和群一致性正则化，提升了帧平均行为克隆在操作任务中的数据效率和鲁棒性，并实现零样本迁移到真实机器人。
summary_zh: 对称感知的机器人策略学习需要观测-动作的耦合变换。对于像素观测而言，即使是简单的物理对称性也可能引发复杂的、依赖视角的图像变换，而这些变换难以人工指定。现有的对称感知方法通常依赖于具有预定义变换的表示形式，需要针对具体传感设置和任务进行专门预处理。我们提出了MIRROR框架，该框架能够从离线交互数据中学习已知对称群如何在部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中联合作用于观测和动作。MIRROR通过单步转移元组上的对抗性元组匹配来耦合这些变换，同时通过显式的群一致性正则化来惩罚违反群运算公理的行为。在四个Robosuite桌面操作任务中，MIRROR在四项对称性质量指标中的三项上取得了最低的总误差，其中在兼容性误差（衡量变换组合下的一致性）上相较改进的LaLiGAN基线降低了61%。将学习到的变换用于帧平均行为克隆（BC）后，在所有四个任务上的平均成功率均高于原始BC，平均成功率从80.48%提升至85.12%，单项任务最高提升达9.66个百分点。我们还使用高度图和分割掩码观测在仿真中重复进行对称性发现和策略训练，然后将所得策略零样本部署到真实的Kinova GEN3机械臂上。项目主页：https://pomdp-mirror.github.io。

title: ClearNav: Perception-Aligned Quadrotor Flight Using Differential-Physics
summary: Autonomous quadrotor flight in cluttered environment is an key capability for tasks like inspection and search. Navigation policies trained in simulation and transferred to hardware can fly at high speed in open space, but they can still collide as obstacle clearance shrinks. We attribute most of these collisions to a single mechanism, namely motion in directions the onboard camera does not observe. Heading that is not aligned with the direction of travel and lateral excursion during obstacle avoidance both carry the vehicle toward obstacles outside its field of view. We introduce ClearNav, a navigation policy trained with two reward terms that constrain motion to the observed direction, a forward-looking heading target and a penalty on lateral velocity. A third term penalizes speed near obstacles so that an obstacle entering the field of view remains avoidable. In simulation, across 18 held-out scenarios with 2304 paired flights per policy unseen in training, ClearNav improves success by 6.8 points, cuts the collision rate by 65% relative to the state of the arts, and flies at maximum 5m/s. For the proximity term alone under matched commanded speeds, the collision reduction still holds at 70%. The effect is significant on static scenes and consistent in direction on moving obstacles, though not significant there at the suite level, showing that safer flight in clutter is possible even on the limited sensors and compute of small drones. We also validate our navigation policy in a real-world cluttered environment, showing that it enables the quadrotor to navigate through the cluttered environment successfully and safely.
tldr: ClearNav proposes a quadrotor navigation policy with reward terms that enforce forward-aligned heading, penalize lateral velocity, and reduce speed near obstacles, reducing collisions in cluttered environments in simulation and real-world tests.
tldr_zh: ClearNav 提出了一种四旋翼导航策略，通过奖励项强制航向与飞行方向一致、惩罚横向速度并在障碍物附近降低速度，从而在仿真和真实环境中减少碰撞。
summary_zh: 自主四旋翼飞行器在杂乱环境中的飞行是巡检和搜索等任务的关键能力。在仿真环境中训练并迁移至硬件的导航策略能够在开放空间中高速飞行，但随着障碍物间隙缩小，仍可能发生碰撞。我们将大多数此类碰撞归因于单一机制，即飞行器沿机载相机未观测方向运动。机头朝向与飞行方向不一致，以及避障过程中的侧向偏移，都会使飞行器朝向视野之外的障碍物移动。我们提出ClearNav，一种导航策略，训练时引入两项奖励项以约束运动沿观测方向进行，包括前视机头朝向目标和侧向速度惩罚。第三项奖励项在障碍物附近施加速度惩罚，使得进入视野的障碍物仍可被规避。在仿真中，跨越18个训练中未见过的留出场景，每个策略包含2304次配对飞行，ClearNav将成功率提升了6.8个百分点，相较于现有最优方法将碰撞率降低了65%，并实现最高5 m/s的飞行速度。仅就接近项而言，在匹配指令速度条件下，碰撞率降低仍保持在70%。该效果在静态场景中显著，在动态障碍物上方向一致，但在整体场景集水平上不够显著，这表明即使在小型无人机有限传感器和计算资源下，杂乱环境中的安全飞行仍是可行的。我们还在真实世界的杂乱环境中验证了导航策略，结果表明该策略能使四旋翼飞行器成功且安全地穿越杂乱环境。

title: Evaluating Long-Horizon Robot Planning under Uncertainty
summary: Household robots must successfully navigate im-perfect circumstances, both in their internal models and the external world. We introduce a benchmark of seven long-horizon household tasks in Habitat that vary initial robot memory and environment configurations. We evaluate adaptations of ReAct, VLM-TAMP, and Tru-POMDP within a shared execution framework across 90 tasks-environment-memory combinations, totaling 1,350 episodes. Our evaluation measures task success, partial completion, and action efficiency, along with rule-based analysis of execution traces. ReAct achieves the highest overall task success (45.3%) and completion (71.7%), while having accurate initial memory does not consistently yield the highest performance for every planner. We identify recurring placement errors, precondition errors, and redundant actions through trace analysis. These findings highlight differences in how the evaluated planners use initial knowledge and respond to uncertainty.
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark of seven long-horizon household tasks in Habitat to evaluate different robot planners under uncertainty, finding that ReAct achieves the highest success rate but accurate initial memory does not always benefit performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文在Habitat中提出了一个包含七个长时程家庭任务的基准，用于评估不同机器人在不确定性下的规划器，发现ReAct成功率最高，但准确的初始记忆并不总是带来最佳性能。
summary_zh: 家庭机器人必须能够在内部模型和外部世界均不完美的情况下成功导航。我们引入了一个包含七项长期家庭任务的基准测试，该测试在Habitat环境中进行，涉及不同的初始机器人记忆和环境配置。我们在一个共享执行框架内，对ReAct、VLM-TAMP和Tru-POMDP的适配版本进行了评估，覆盖90种任务-环境-记忆组合，总计1，350个回合。我们的评估衡量了任务成功率、部分完成度及行动效率，并结合基于规则的执行轨迹分析。ReAct实现了最高的整体任务成功率（45.3%）和完成度（71.7%），而拥有准确的初始记忆并不总是能为每个规划器带来最优性能。通过轨迹分析，我们识别出反复出现的放置错误、前提条件错误和冗余动作。这些发现凸显了所评估的规划器在利用初始知识和应对不确定性方面的差异。

title: Improving Policy Learning from Delayed Interventions
summary:
In this work, we explore the idea of expert intervention delays in human-supervised robotic systems for imitation learning system. Previous works in imitation learning have primarily examined the impact of suboptimal experts, where the expert policy makes mistakes, but assumed expert interventions occur immediately after errors are made. Although delayed expert intervention can be viewed as a form of noise that might improve policy robustness, our results show that learning from delayed expert interventions is overall less effective than learning from non-delayed expert interventions; delayed expert interventions are less effective at demonstrating error avoidance behaviors.
  To address this, we propose Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), which learns a cost function based on where and when the expert intervenes, combined with limited information about the extent of intervention delays provided by the expert. This cost function is then used to infer additional supervision for states without expert data, guiding the policy to avoid states that would likely trigger interventions. We evaluate our method, Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), on simulated environments and show that it outperforms other methods that do not account for intervention delays.
tldr: The paper studies the effect of delayed expert interventions in imitation learning for robotic systems, showing it is less effective than immediate intervention, and proposes LfDI, a method that learns a cost function from delayed interventions to provide additional supervision and improve policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人模仿学习中专家干预延迟的影响，表明延迟干预不如即时干预有效，并提出LfDI方法，通过从延迟干预中学习代价函数来提供额外监督，从而改进策略学习。
summary_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了人类监督机器人系统中，模仿学习框架下专家干预延迟的概念。以往关于模仿学习的研究主要聚焦于次优专家的影响，即专家策略可能出现错误，但假设专家在错误发生之后立即实施干预。尽管延迟的专家干预可视为一种可能增强策略鲁棒性的噪声形式，我们的研究结果显示，从延迟的专家干预中学习总体上不如从非延迟干预中学习有效；延迟的专家干预在展示错误规避行为方面效果欠佳。为应对这一问题，我们提出了延迟干预学习（LfDI）方法，该方法基于专家进行干预的位置和时间，结合专家提供的关于干预延迟程度的有限信息，来学习一个成本函数。随后，该成本函数被用于为缺乏专家数据的状态推断额外的监督信号，引导策略避开可能触发干预的状态。我们在模拟环境中对我们的方法——延迟干预学习（LfDI）——进行了评估，结果表明它优于其他未考虑干预延迟的方法。

title: ReForesight: Occlusion-Robust Re-Identification and Future Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Semantic Mapping
summary: Robots sharing walkways need to know where people will be, yet semantic occupancy maps show only where they are. We present ReForesight, an open-source ROS 2 toolkit that adds instance-level future occupancy and re-identification after occlusion to a particle-based semantic mapping pipeline. A 36.6k-parameter MLP predicts each tracked person or vehicle up to 3 s ahead, guarded by a Kalman fallback and a stationary gate, and the object's own points are moved to the forecast pose, forming a "ghost" point cloud in the map frame without an occupancy decoder. An optional tracker re-associates objects after occlusion using keypoint descriptors the pipeline already computes and a metric 3D gate. On four held-out CODa sequences, the MLP lowers the mean 3 s final displacement error from 0.728 m (Kalman) to 0.662 m and beats a similar-size GRU (0.692 m) on every sequence, at 0.04 ms per instance on one CPU core. Code, all models, and a ROS-free demo are released; field demonstrations use an outdoor cleaning robot.
tldr: ReForesight is a ROS 2 toolkit that adds real-time instance-level future occupancy prediction and re-identification after occlusion to semantic mapping for robots in shared walkways, improving trajectory forecasting for tracked people and vehicles using a lightweight MLP.
tldr_zh: ReForesight 是一个 ROS 2 工具包，为共享人行道中的机器人语义地图增加实时实例级未来占用预测和遮挡后重新识别，使用轻量级 MLP 改进对行人和车辆的轨迹预测。
summary_zh: 共享步行空间的机器人需要知道人们将要去往何处，而语义占用地图仅能显示他们当前所在的位置。我们提出了ReForesight，一个开源的ROS 2工具包，它在基于粒子的语义建图流程中增加了实例级未来占用以及遮挡后的重新识别功能。一个36.6k参数的MLP可预测每个被追踪的行人或车辆未来最多3秒的位置，并以卡尔曼滤波回退和静止门控作为保障，同时将对象自身的点移动到预测位姿，从而在地图坐标系中形成“幽灵”点云，无需占用解码器。可选的追踪器利用该流程已有的关键点描述符和度量3D门控，在遮挡后重新关联对象。在四个保留的CODa序列上，MLP将平均3秒最终位移误差从0.728米（卡尔曼）降低至0.662米，并在每个序列上均优于参数规模相近的GRU（0.692米），单个CPU核心上每实例处理耗时0.04毫秒。代码、所有模型以及一个不依赖ROS的演示均已发布；实地演示采用了户外清洁机器人。

title: Physical SLAM: Physics-aware Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping
summary: To reconstruct a predictive 4D representation of the physical world from monocular video captured by a moving camera, we jointly reconstruct dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infer their underlying physical dynamics. This paper proposes \emph{Physical SLAM}, a physics-aware method for constructing 4D Gaussian fields of deformable objects and predicting their future state when subjected to external actions, given a sequence of RGB-D images. Our method separates the scene into a static background Gaussian field for camera localization and a dynamic object Gaussian field driven by a spring--mass physical model of elastic deformation, inertia, and damping. To integrate visual observations with physical dynamics, we introduce virtual observation forces that gradually pull simulated surface nodes toward observed depth points, avoiding abrupt replacement of simulated node positions. Meanwhile, the physical parameters of the spring--mass model are updated from simulation errors aggregated over the full reconstruction observation window, enabling the reconstructed dynamics to align with observations. To couple appearance, geometry, and physics, we further design a physics-aware Gaussian transformation and surface alignment strategy, where dynamic Gaussians are transformed along the deforming physical surface of the spring--mass model and constrained to remain aligned with the surface during rendering-based optimization. The resulting representation supports observed-frame rendering and action-conditioned simulation, extending SLAM maps to describe how deformable objects respond to manipulation. On the PhysTwin benchmark, our method improves reconstruction and prediction PSNR over PhysTwin by 10.4\% and 11.0\%, respectively. On the TUM RGB-D benchmark, it reduces average camera tracking error by 20.6\%, improves SSIM by 3.6\%, and reduces LPIPS by 8.3\% compared with 4DGS-SLAM.
tldr: Physical SLAM jointly reconstructs dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infers their underlying physics from monocular video, using a spring-mass model with virtual observation forces to enable action-conditioned future-state prediction for deformable objects. It improves reconstruction, prediction, and camera tracking accuracy over prior SLAM baselines.
tldr_zh: Physical SLAM 从单目视频中联合重建动态高斯辐射场并推断其物理动力学，利用弹簧-质量模型和虚拟观测力实现可变形物体在外部作用下的未来状态预测，在重建、预测和相机跟踪精度上优于现有SLAM基线。
summary_zh: 为了从运动相机拍摄的单目视频中重建物理世界的预测性4D表示，我们联合重建动态高斯辐射场并推断其底层的物理动力学。本文提出\textbf{Physical SLAM}，一种物理感知方法，用于构建可变形物体的4D高斯场，并在给定RGB-D图像序列时预测其在外部作用下的未来状态。我们的方法将场景分离为用于相机定位的静态背景高斯场和由弹性变形、惯性和阻尼的弹簧-质量物理模型驱动的动态物体高斯场。为了将视觉观测与物理动力学整合，我们引入了虚拟观测力，逐步将模拟表面节点拉向观测到的深度点，避免对模拟节点位置的突然替换。同时，弹簧-质量模型的物理参数根据整个重建观测窗口内聚合的模拟误差进行更新，从而使重建的动力学与观测保持一致。为了将外观、几何和物理耦合起来，我们进一步设计了物理感知的高斯变换和表面对齐策略，其中动态高斯沿弹簧-质量模型的变形物理表面进行变换，并在基于渲染的优化过程中保持与表面对齐。由此产生的表示支持观测帧渲染和动作条件仿真，将SLAM地图扩展为描述可变形物体对操作的响应。在PhysTwin基准上，我们的方法在重建和预测PSNR上分别比PhysTwin提高了10.4\%和11.0\%。在TUM RGB-D基准上，与4DGS-SLAM相比，平均相机跟踪误差降低了20.6\%，SSIM提高了3.6\%，LPIPS降低了8.3\%。

title: Value-Preserving Action Quantization
summary: Search-based policy learning, such as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), offers the flexibility to trade runtime computation for data efficiency and adaptation to novel environments. For robot learning, however, applying search requires discretizing the continuous action space and associated dynamics, typically through action quantization. While reconstruction-based quantization is sufficient for representing the continuous action space alone, policy learning additionally requires the quantized actions to preserve their effects on future states and values. We show that such requirement is not necessarily captured by action reconstruction error. Instead, we prove that the error in the value function resulting from action quantization is tightly bounded by the reconstruction error of state reachability under the quantized actions. Based on these results, we propose value-preserving action quantization (VAQ), which quantizes actions by preserving state reachability. We further combine VAQ with MCTS (VAQ-MCTS) as a value-preserving, search-based policy learning framework for behavioral cloning. Using a wide range of object pushing tasks as a controlled benchmark, we evaluate VAQ-MCTS against state-of-the-art behavioral cloning methods. VAQ-MCTS matches or exceeds their performance under standard settings, while substantially improving data efficiency and robustness to heterogeneous demonstrations, while enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel environments. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of VAQ-MCTS, completing all 30 real-world object pushing trials with only 10 minutes of demonstration data.
tldr: This paper introduces value-preserving action quantization (VAQ), which quantizes continuous actions for search-based robot policies by preserving state reachability rather than reconstruction error, and combines it with MCTS (VAQ-MCTS) for behavioral cloning, demonstrating improved data efficiency, robustness, and zero-shot adaptation in object pushing tasks on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出价值保持的动作量化（VAQ），通过保持状态可达性而非重建误差来量化连续动作，并将其与MCTS结合（VAQ-MCTS）用于行为克隆，在物体推挤任务中展示了更高的数据效率、鲁棒性和零样本适应性，并在真实硬件上完成30次试验。
summary_zh: 基于搜索的策略学习，如蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），提供了灵活的交易运行时计算以换取数据效率和适应新环境的能力。然而，对于机器人学习而言，应用搜索需要对连续动作空间及相关动态进行离散化处理，通常通过动作量化来实现。虽然基于重建的量化足以单独表示连续动作空间，但策略学习还要求量化后的动作保持其对未来状态和值的影响。我们表明，这一需求不一定能通过动作重建误差来捕捉。相反，我们证明，由动作量化引起的值函数误差，在量化动作下紧密地由状态可达性的重建误差所界定。基于这些发现，我们提出了保持值的动作量化（VAQ），该方法通过保持状态可达性来量化动作。我们进一步将VAQ与MCTS结合（VAQ-MCTS），作为一种保持值的、基于搜索的策略学习框架，用于行为克隆。利用一系列物体推动任务作为受控基准，我们将VAQ-MCTS与最先进的行为克隆方法进行了评估。在标准设置下，VAQ-MCTS的表现与它们相当或更优，同时显著提高了数据效率和对异构演示的鲁棒性，并能实现对新环境的零样本适应。硬件实验进一步证明了VAQ-MCTS的有效性，仅用10分钟的演示数据便完成了全部30次真实世界的物体推动试验。

title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
summary: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.
tldr: MMTA is a tri-modal benchmark (time series, text, vision) spanning robotics, driving, and other domains, and TimeOmni-v is a multimodal LLM with a time-series encoder and forecasting head that improves performance and efficiency.
tldr_zh: MMTA是一个跨机器人、驾驶等领域的三模态（时间序列、文本、视觉）基准，TimeOmni-v通过专用时间序列编码器和预测头提升了长视频分类与推理效率。
summary_zh: 时间序列分析在多模态场景中的研究日益增多，然而大多数基准测试仅将时间信号与文本或由同一信号衍生的可视化结果进行配对。这留下了这样一个问题：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否将时间序列与真实世界的视觉证据相整合？我们引入了MMTA（多模态时间分析），这是一个三模态任务基准，涵盖时间序列、文本和视觉之间多样的跨模态互补模式。MMTA覆盖九个领域——机器人、自动驾驶、人类行为、制造业、AR辅助、医疗健康、推荐系统、金融和气候——采用视频+时间序列及图像+时间序列两种布局，测试集包含3，524个样本，涵盖分类和预测任务。该基准将异构的真实世界数据源标准化为共享模式，并配有领域特定提示、来源文档以及成功加权指标，该指标同时惩罚错误答案和生成失败。对八种开源和专有MLLMs的评估揭示了一个共同的瓶颈：将时间序列表示为文本会产生非常长的令牌序列，并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，尤其在长视频场景中更为突出。随后，我们提出了TimeOmni-v，一种多模态大语言模型扩展，配备专门的时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知令牌布局以及预测头。TimeOmni-v提高了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率，表明MMTA不仅揭示了表示和基础对齐的失败，还推动了有针对性的模型设计。

title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.
tldr: World-T3 introduces a camera-controlled video world model with test-time training memory that uses recursive least-squares updates to maintain spatial consistency in long-horizon generation, and distills an autoregressive model into a few-step generator for real-time interactive generation.
tldr_zh: World-T3 提出了一种带测试时训练记忆的相机控制视频世界模型，通过递归最小二乘更新保持长时程生成的空间一致性，并蒸馏自回归模型为少步生成器以实现实时交互生成。
summary_zh: 近期在视频世界模型领域的进展使得生成逼真的交互环境成为可能，然而长时程生成对视觉记忆提出了根本性需求：在模型持续生成的过程中，先前观察到的世界必须保持一致。现有的自回归方法往往隐式依赖生成模型自身来保留此类信息，导致超出有效上下文范围后出现空间记忆衰减。我们提出了World-T3，一种带有测试时训练记忆的摄像机可控视频世界模型，该模型将过去的观测整合到专用模型参数中。为了稳健地更新这一记忆，我们提出了一种递归最小二乘规则，通过在线姿态键控记忆更新逐步吸收新的视觉特征。我们的TTT记忆通过摄像机姿态从快权重状态中读出先前观察到的场景特征，从而在滚动长度不限的情况下，以恒定存储和单步计算实现一致的生成。为了支持具备该稳健记忆的实时交互式生成，我们进一步通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器。在长时程重访基准测试中，World-T3将重访PSNR从13.52 dB提升至18.31 dB，并将绝对旋转误差从3.344降至1.075，两项指标均优于最强基线，同时在单块NVIDIA B200 GPU上以1280×704分辨率维持20.6 FPS的生成速度。

title: Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.
tldr: Plan-Bench is a benchmark with 699 curated samples across 16 subclasses to evaluate high-level reasoning and multi-step planning of VLMs in embodied worlds, independent of action execution. The evaluation of 28 VLMs shows significant room for improvement, with the best model achieving 75% accuracy and scaling trends indicating larger models show potential as planners.
tldr_zh: Plan-Bench 是一个包含 699 个样本、跨越 16 个子类的基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在具身世界中独立于动作执行的高层推理和多步规划能力。对 28 个 VLM 的评估显示仍有很大提升空间，最强模型准确率为 75%，缩放趋势表明更大模型展现规划潜力。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视觉感知和空间推理方面展现出强劲性能，引发了将其用作具身智能高层规划器的日益浓厚的兴趣。然而，物理任务要求模型整合空间信息、对时间状态进行推理，并在各种约束条件下生成多步骤计划，这引发了一个问题：当前视觉语言模型能否在脱离执行的情况下可靠地支持此类推理与规划。我们提出了Plan-Bench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在具身世界相关的高层推理和多步骤规划能力的基准，同时隔离动作执行的影响。该基准涵盖三个互补维度，涉及16个子类和699个精选样本。对28个视觉语言模型的大量评估显示其仍有提升空间，即使最强模型也仅达到75.0%的准确率。我们进一步发现，模型规模的扩增通常能提升这些能力。消融研究还表明，较大模型作为高层规划器的潜力日益显现。总体而言，Plan-Bench提供了一个轻量级探针，用于评估视觉语言模型在具身环境相关的推理与规划能力，并评估其作为物理任务决策者的潜力。我们的基准和代码可在 https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench 获取。

title: MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration
summary: Spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents navigating and interacting with the physical world. As observations arrive incrementally, agents must reason in a streaming manner.
